jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Come Fuel the Explosive Growth of a Rapidly Expanding Specialty Practice

Total Spine & Orthopedics is growing fast. New physicians, new services, new locations, and a brand that’s ready to be seen. We’re looking for a creative, results-obsessed Digital Marketing Specialist to help tell our story and put our physicians in front of the patients who need them.

This isn’t a “post-and-pray” social media role. You’ll own campaigns from idea to impact: running ads, shooting and editing video, building content that educates and inspires, and proving it all with real numbers. If you love having a camera in one hand, an analytics dashboard in the other, and a seat at the table where growth decisions get made, this is your role.

We want someone who brings fresh ideas, takes ownership, and gets energized by building something.

What You’ll DoDrive Patient Growth

* Build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns that bring in qualified patient leads
* Own SEO and local search, including Google Business Profiles across multiple locations
* Boost our visibility across traditional search *and* AI-powered search platforms
* Monitor and strengthen physician reputations on Google, Healthgrades, and other healthcare platforms
* Track every lead, conversion, and dollar so we know exactly what’s working

Create Content People Actually Want to Watch

* Run our Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other channels using Zoho Social
* Plan monthly content calendars packed with education, physician spotlights, practice news, and campaigns
* Film, photograph, edit, and produce physician interviews, educational videos, patient testimonials, and reels
* Design sharp, on-brand graphics that make us look as good as the care we deliver
* Use AI tools to create smarter and faster

Build the Brand Everywhere

* Coordinate website updates, blogs, landing pages, and SEO content
* Create and send monthly newsletters through Mailchimp or similar platforms
* Design digital and print materials: brochures, rack cards, flyers, and physician promotional pieces
* Lead marketing launches for new physicians, services, locations, and community events
* Develop campaigns that grow physician referral relationships and community presence

Think Strategically, Report Clearly

* Shape marketing strategy that directly supports our growth goals
* Analyze performance in Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and other tools
* Deliver monthly reports with clear results and smart recommendations
* Partner with leadership, physicians, staff, and outside vendors
* Keep all marketing HIPAA-compliant and aligned with patient consent and healthcare advertising rules

What You BringRequired

* 2+ years of hands-on digital marketing experience
* Proven success with Google Ads, SEO, and social media campaigns
* Strong photography, videography, and editing skills; you can produce professional content on your own
* Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, CapCut, or similar tools
* Experience with Google Analytics, Google Business Profiles, and performance tracking
* Excellent writing, communication, and project management skills
* Self-starter who can juggle multiple projects and hit deadlines
* A portfolio showing your digital marketing, video, and creative work
* Ability to travel occasionally between our Melbourne and Orlando offices for shoots and events

Bonus Points

* Healthcare or medical practice marketing experience
* Familiarity with spine, orthopedic, or interventional pain services
* Experience with Zoho Social, Mailchimp, and website CMS platforms
* Knowledge of local SEO, AI search visibility, and reputation management
* Hands-on use of generative AI for marketing and content
* Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare marketing compliance

Why You’ll Love It Here

* **Real impact.** Your work directly drives patient growth, and you’ll see the results.
* **Creative ownership.** Bring your ideas; we’ll give you room to run with them.
* **Momentum.** We’re growing, and this role grows with us.
* **Mission.** Every campaign helps patients find relief, restore function, and get back to the life they love.

**About Us:** Total Spine & Orthopedics is a multidisciplinary practice specializing in spine care, orthopedic surgery, interventional pain management, and foot and ankle care. We combine advanced treatment options with personalized care, and we’re building a team as ambitious as our vision.

**Ready to help us grow? Apply with your resume and portfolio.**

Pay: $48,000.00 - $52,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Director of Marketing

DEPARTMENT: Marketing

SUPERVISED BY: Chief Executive Officer

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Marketing. is responsible for planning and end-to-end execution of marketing, advertising and promotional campaigns.

This position develops advertising strategy and plans over oversee its execution, including paid social and search campaigns, setting and monitoring advertising budgets, and campaign performance across search and social platforms (i.e. Meta, Google, YouTube, Amazon and LinkedIn) with the primary goal to achieve sales, leads and engagement goals, maximize return on ad spend (ROAS), and align ad operations with broader business objectives.

This position will be the lead Administrator for Google and Meta ads, HubSpot and Amazon Vendor Central.

This is an onsite position. There is no option for remote or hybrid work. This is not an entry level position.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITES INCLUDE:

Plans, designs, implement and project manages marketing campaign strategy

* Responsible for implementation of a high-performing marketing strategy to improve business performance across on and offline channels

* Works closely with sales, publishing, program and business development to set strategy, design and implement proactive, goal driven marketing campaigns.

* Develops engaging marketing campaigns that are relevant and relatable to the target audience to love and choose our programs, products and services first.

* Develops, monitors and adjusts as needed annual and on-going marketing campaigns,

* Collaborates with CEO and CFO to establish a marketing campaign budget. Manages and distributes funds across channels like digital, social, print, and paid ads

* Ensures that marketing campaigns have a unique identity and that they are developed with the intention to achieve or exceed the campaign goals.

* Research target demographics and market trends to shape messaging.

* Ensures every campaign touchpoint matches the core brand identity

* Chooses the right platforms (SEO, email, events, PR) for the product and target market.

* Provides direction for a departmental culture that is nimble and flexible (growth mindset) so as to quickly adapt and improve strategies and activities based upon quality data and feedback.

* Leads the production of high-quality catalogues and other print and digital sales materials. Responsible for the collaboration needed to ensure the editorial and design direction for all Marketing materials are accurate, consistent and internally vetted prior to release

* Oversees the curation and management of marketing assets.

* Responsible for and oversees regular marketing research and measuring the success of a campaign with an emphasis on analysis, insight, and recommended action.

* Conducts ongoing evaluation of the effectiveness of campaigns and sets expectations improvement changes based upon data analysis and feedback.

* Ensures that marketing plans and activities are understood as an investment and each plan has a clearly identified expected return on the investment

* Regularly reports on campaigns results with ROI insights.

Marketing Asset Management (MAM)

* Designs and oversees a system and process to store, organize, approve, distribute, track, optimize and share marketing and promotional content and files (i.e. logos, photos, videos, and templates) through an asset's entire lifecycle.

* Ensures all users knows how the MAM system works and use it to keep brand styles correct and do not use old or wrong files.

* Defines metadata schemes, file naming rules, and folder and file structures and naming convention.

* Enforces brand guidelines and quality controls across all media.

* Oversees user permissions, security controls, and platform access tiers.

* Developing and leading a multidisciplinary team to achieve strategic goals and deliver a measurable result

* Creating best practices and using insights to develop and implement marketing plans across the business

* Responsible for ensuring all print and digital marketing materials are branded appropriately and free of grammatical errors, easy to read and process, well-designed and presented with integrity and consistency.

Guides the Use of AI in marketing

* Understands and teach others to us AI to automate bidding, target high-intent audiences, and scale creative asset generation.

* Skilled in tools like Google Ads Performance Max and in automating social platforms real-time adjust budgets and combining ad components to optimize return on ad spend.

* Understands how to leverage Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager to manage automated pacing and return on ad spend (ROAS).

* Know how AI uses first-party data and lookalike modeling to identify high-intent buyer personas and can successfully apply that knowledge for audience segmentation.

* Familiarity with native features of Google Performance Max and Meta Advantage+ and knows the limits and strengths of automated campaign setups.

* Aligns AI-generated ad promises with relevant website page experience.

Website

* Works closely with CEO and website administrator to direct the design, launch, and ongoing updates of the corporate website.

* Oversees excellent implementation of all website content and navigation.

* Works closely with website administrator, finance and other organizational leaders to plan, build, and optimize Google paid search campaigns to drive website traffic, generate leads, and maximize return on ad spend.

* Ensures websites SEO is maximized, the webpages are elegantly designed, easy to navigate, sensibly organized on the established taxonomy and that the established taxonomy is improved is frequently updated and inspiring.

* Collaborates with CFO and CEO on the development and e-commerce functions of CRS's websites and on content development and design.

* Oversees media relations, has a regular press release schedule, and provides tools for customers to complete their own press release.

jobs.title: Marketing Director for RGL Group
jobs.description:
**NOW HIRING: DIRECTOR OF MARKETING**
=====================================

**RGL Group | Orangetheory Fitness · Anytime Fitness · VIO Med Spa**

**Location:** Long Island, NY; travel between locations required

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Reports To:** RGL Group Ownership

**Base Salary:** $85,000–$110,000, plus performance-based bonuses with the opportunity to earn over $125,000 in total annual compensation

**HELP US BUILD THE BRANDS. GROW OUR COMMUNITIES. DRIVE RESULTS.**
------------------------------------------------------------------

RGL Group operates a growing portfolio of fitness and wellness businesses across Long Island, including multiple Orangetheory Fitness studios and VIO Med Spa locations. We’re looking for a Director of Marketing to lead growth across our brands and support the launch of new locations and businesses.

You’ll work directly with ownership as part of RGL Group’s leadership team, overseeing marketing across Orangetheory Fitness, Anytime Fitness, and VIO Med Spa. This role combines strategy, team leadership, and hands-on execution to generate qualified leads, grow memberships and service bookings, and build lasting customer relationships.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**
----------------------------------

### **Marketing Strategy & Performance**

* Develop marketing strategies, budgets, and campaign calendars for each brand and location.
* Drive customer acquisition, referrals, and retention through paid advertising, social media, email, SMS, and local marketing.
* Track lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates, and return on marketing spend to improve results.
* Work with location teams to strengthen lead capture, CRM workflows, follow-up, and booking conversion.

### **Team Leadership & Content**

* Build and lead dedicated marketing teams for each brand by identifying and developing talent within our existing teams.
* Set clear priorities, schedules, and performance expectations, and coordinate agencies, vendors, and freelancers.
* Guide content and promotional materials that showcase our locations, services, teams, members, and culture.

### **Community Engagement & Partnerships**

* Build relationships with local businesses, employers, schools, influencers, and community organizations.
* Develop corporate wellness partnerships, referral programs, community events, and local promotions.
* Equip location teams to execute campaigns and identify opportunities for cross-brand collaboration.

### **New Location & Business Launches**

* Lead marketing for new locations and businesses, from pre-launch planning through grand opening.
* Develop launch campaigns, introductory offers, local partnerships, and community awareness.
* Establish digital channels, lead capture, follow-up workflows, and reporting.

### **Brand Standards & Responsible Marketing**

* Maintain each brand’s distinct voice and follow applicable franchise standards and approval processes.
* Coordinate national and regional campaigns with local execution.
* Partner with VIO medical leadership on service-related content, accurate messaging, client privacy, and appropriate written consent for photos and testimonials.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
-------------------------

* 5+ years of marketing experience, with demonstrated results in customer acquisition, lead generation, or business growth.
* Experience managing budgets, evaluating campaign performance, and delivering digital and local marketing campaigns.
* Experience leading employees, agencies, freelancers, or brand ambassadors.
* Ability to set strategy, execute campaigns, and manage priorities across multiple brands and locations.
* Clear communication, strong follow-through, and a collaborative approach to working with ownership and location teams.

**Preferred experience:** Multi-location or franchise businesses; fitness, aesthetics, wellness, hospitality, or other membership or appointment-based businesses; new-location launches; CRM and marketing automation.

**WHY JOIN RGL GROUP?**
-----------------------

Work directly with ownership, contribute as part of the leadership team, and shape the growth of three distinct fitness and wellness brands. You’ll have the opportunity to develop talent, strengthen community connections, and see the impact of your work across established locations and new businesses.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
---------------------------

**Base salary: $85,000–$110,000 per year**, depending on experience and qualifications, plus performance-based bonuses with the opportunity to earn **over $125,000 in total annual compensation**.

Benefits include:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Free memberships at our fitness locations
* Heavily discounted services at VIO Med Spa
* Travel reimbursement

**READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?**
----------------------------

Apply with your resume and a brief example of a marketing initiative you led, including your role and the results.

*RGL Group is an equal opportunity employer.*

VIO Med Spa is an age-defying, beauty and wellness medical spa that provides unparalleled and innovative services for all who want to retain that youthful look and feel without engaging in invasive procedures.  
VIO Med Spa is driven to help all \look amazing and feel great\. This is achieved through a commitment to first understanding our guest's needs and their self-beautification goals prior to making and service recommendations. We then build a treatment plan that is specific to the guest in front of us.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**\*\*About the Role**
----------------------

\*\*

Rack Industries is seeking an experienced, results-driven

\*\*Digital Marketing Manager

\*\* to oversee and execute our digital marketing efforts. This individual will be responsible for managing paid advertising campaigns, email marketing, lead generation, and performance reporting.

We are looking for someone who is highly analytical, organized, and capable of independently managing multiple marketing channels while continuously identifying opportunities to increase leads, improve conversion rates, and maximize return on investment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Google Ads, Google Local Services Ads (GLSA), Meta advertising, email marketing automation, and marketing analytics.

**\*\*Key Responsibilities**
----------------------------

\*\*

### **\*\*1. Paid Media Management**

\*\*

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, and remarketing.
* Oversee Google Local Services Ads (GLSA), including lead monitoring, budget management, and optimization.
* Develop, launch, and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.
* Manage advertising budgets across all paid channels to maximize lead volume and return on ad spend.
* Conduct ongoing A/B testing of ad creatives, messaging, audiences, and landing pages.
* Monitor cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and overall campaign profitability.

### **\*\*2. Email Marketing & Automation**

\*\*

* Develop and execute email marketing campaigns focused on customer retention, reactivation, and lead nurturing.
* Build and manage automated email and SMS workflows.
* Segment customer databases to deliver targeted messaging.
* Develop campaigns that encourage repeat business, service appointments, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Monitor email performance, including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and attributed revenue.
* Continuously optimize automation workflows to improve customer engagement and retention.

### **\*\*3. Lead Generation & Tracking**

\*\*

* Oversee lead generation across Google, Meta, and other digital marketing channels.
* Ensure accurate lead tracking, attribution, and reporting across advertising platforms and CRM systems.
* Monitor lead quality and work with the sales team to improve conversion rates.
* Identify opportunities to increase qualified leads while reducing acquisition costs.
* Troubleshoot tracking issues involving Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, and CRM integrations.

### **\*\*4. Marketing Reporting & Analytics**

\*\*

* Create and maintain weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Develop dashboards that provide visibility into advertising spend, lead generation, sales performance, and ROI.
* Track key performance indicators, including:

  + Cost Per Lead (CPL)
  + Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  + Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  + Lead-to-Customer Conversion Rate
  + Revenue Generated by Marketing Channel
  + Email Marketing & Automation Revenue
* Analyze campaign performance and present actionable recommendations to leadership.
* Ensure marketing data is accurate and consistent across reporting platforms.

### **\*\*5. Marketing Strategy & Optimization**

\*\*

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with company revenue and growth goals.
* Identify opportunities to expand lead generation and improve customer retention.
* Collaborate with internal departments to align marketing campaigns with operational capacity and sales goals.
* Manage campaign calendars, promotional initiatives, and advertising launches.
* Continuously evaluate campaign performance and implement improvements.

**\*\*Qualifications**
----------------------

\*\*

\*\*Required:

\*\*

* 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or paid media management.
* Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Experience with Google Local Services Ads (GLSA).
* Strong understanding of lead generation, conversion tracking, and marketing attribution.
* Experience building and managing email marketing campaigns and automated workflows.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and make strategic decisions.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of marketing performance.

\*\*Preferred:

\*\*

* Experience marketing for home service businesses, HVAC, electrical, or related service industries.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or similar CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with customer retention marketing and SMS automation.
* Experience managing significant monthly advertising budgets.
* Experience building marketing dashboards and automated reports.

**\*\*What We're Looking For**
------------------------------

\*\*

We want someone who can do more than simply manage advertising accounts. We are looking for a digital marketer who understands how marketing impacts actual business revenue.

The right candidate will take ownership of our marketing channels, proactively identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate reporting, and consistently work toward generating more qualified leads and revenue for Rack Electric.

\*\*Success in this role will be measured by lead generation, advertising efficiency, customer acquisition, retention performance, and overall marketing-driven revenue growth.

\*\*

Basic Research is a Salt Lake City-based health and beauty company behind brands including SeroVital and Novex Biotech. Our products are sold direct to consumer, on Amazon, and at major retailers nationwide. We’re building a lean, in-house performance team that moves fast, tests constantly, and lets the data decide.

  

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an Amazon & E-commerce Marketing Manager to lead the overall strategy and growth of SeroVital and Novex Biotech on Amazon, and to own the Novex Biotech Shopify store. You’ll own the plan, the results, and the standards behind every listing and product page, so that our products are easy to find, convert well, and stay in stock.

You’ll partner closely with our Amazon Ads Manager, who runs Amazon paid media day to day. You set the direction (growth goals, priority products, promotions, and budget focus), and the two of you work together on how ads, organic ranking, and listing content drive results. You’ll also work hand in hand with our Head of Performance on traffic to the Novex site, with Operations on forecasting and inventory, and with our creative team on images, video, and content.

This role is a good fit for someone with 5+ years of Amazon and e-commerce experience at a consumer brand or agency, who has owned channel strategy and growth targets, has run a Shopify store, knows what great listings and product pages look like, and is comfortable leading across teams.

* Plan and run site deals and offers: sitewide sales, bundles, discount codes, free-shipping thresholds, gift-with-purchase, upsells and cross-sells, and holiday and seasonal promotions, protecting margin along the way.

* Grow and manage subscriptions (e.g., Recharge or Shopify subscriptions), including offers, retention, and reducing cancellations.

jobs.title: FRC - Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This is not a role for someone who wants to run campaigns from behind a dashboard. This is a role for someone who wants to sit across from a business owner and show them exactly where their money is leaking — and how to plug it.

As FRC Marketing Strategist, you are the digital strategy expert for clients in our Fractional Revenue Consulting (FRC) program: business owners doing $1M to $25M a year who are ready to scale. You audit their marketing strategy, landing pages, and CRM automation, then deliver clear, prioritized, revenue-focused recommendations they can act on immediately.

This role is built for a Marketing Manager-level professional ready to shift from managing marketers to managing clients. You bring the full-stack expertise. We bring the clients, the platform, and the 10X standard.

If you want to play it safe, this isn't your role. If you want to drive measurable results for owners who are all in, this position is for you.

**What You'll Own**

**Client Strategy Sessions**

* Lead 50- to 60-minute consultative strategy sessions with business owners. Present findings in plain, confident language that drives decisions.
* Build trust fast and turn every session into a clear action plan the client can execute.

**Marketing Strategy Audits**

* Audit end-to-end marketing strategy: positioning, offer, audience, channel mix, and budget allocation.
* Develop full-funnel digital strategies across paid media, SEO, email and SMS, social, and content.

**Landing Page & Funnel Audits**

* Audit landing pages and funnels for message, offer, user experience, tracking, and conversion.
* Recommend specific tests that move conversion rates, not just opinions.

**CRM & Automation Analysis**

* Analyze CRM automation flows — triggers, follow-up sequences, pipelines, and lead routing — in HighLevel (OMNI) and other platforms.
* Find the missed revenue hiding in broken or missing automations and show the client how to capture it.

**Ad Spend Performance**

* Review cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend. Recommend adjustments that put dollars where they produce results.

**Reporting & Accountability**

* Document every client session in the CRM.
* Report weekly to the Director of Fulfillment on client progress, retention risks, and expansion opportunities.

**What It Takes**

**The Experience**

* 6+ years of full-stack digital marketing experience across paid media, SEO, email, social, content, and analytics. Marketing Manager-level experience qualifies.
* Proven experience advising or managing marketing for small and mid-sized businesses in a client-facing, consulting, or agency setting.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze a marketing strategy, landing page, and CRM automation flow and explain findings clearly.
* Hands-on HighLevel CRM experience, including workflows and pipelines.
* Strong command of analytics and reporting, including GA4, ad platform analytics, and CRM dashboards.
* A track record of measurable gains in lead volume, conversion rate, or cost per acquisition.
* Working knowledge of email and SMS consent requirements (TCPA, CAN-SPAM) as they apply to marketing automation.

**The Mindset**

* **Client-First.** Your client's results are your results. You own the outcome, not just the recommendation.
* **Clarity.** You turn complex data into simple, confident direction a business owner can act on today.
* **Urgency.** You find the gap, call it out, and drive the fix — fast.
* **Presence.** You command the room with owners who have built real businesses and earn their trust quickly.
* **Commitment.** You're all in on the mission and willing to do what it takes to win.

**How We Measure Success**

* Client retention and renewal rates
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication
* Measurable client gains in leads, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition
* Quality and completeness of strategy, landing page, and automation audits

**10X Total Rewards**

We invest in people who invest in themselves. Full-time team members receive:

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Paid Time Off that grows with your tenure
* 401(k) with company match
* Employee Assistance Program through Mutual of Omaha
* Pet insurance through MetLife for your 10X pets
* Company-paid wellness initiatives through BeyondMed
* Full access to more than $250,000 in Cardone educational resources across Sales, Operations, People, Finance, and Marketing
* The opportunity to earn additional income through our employee sales program (see HR Review Notes)

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply is a strategic, commercially focused role responsible for developing and advancing supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations' position in the luxury travel marketplace. Serving as the primary marketing account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, this position connects meaningful partner relationships with innovative marketing opportunities, measurable commercial outcomes, and sustainable revenue growth.

At the intersection of supplier relationship management, marketing strategy, and commercial development, the Marketing Account Manager – Supply leads partner discovery, annual co-op marketing planning, customized campaign recommendations, presentations, negotiations, and ongoing account engagement. By understanding each partner's objectives, commercial priorities, booking patterns, and destination needs, this role develops thoughtful marketing strategies that create mutual value while reinforcing Classic Vacations' luxury positioning and commitment to its Travel Advisor community.

The role also plays an important collaborative part in supporting Classic's European supplier marketing initiatives. Working alongside the Europe Supply team, the Marketing Account Manager contributes marketing expertise, campaign proposals, pricing and deliverable guidance, presentation development, execution coordination, and performance reporting. This partnership ensures European marketing initiatives benefit from consistent marketing expertise while maintaining clear regional relationship ownership within the Europe Supply organization.

Beyond relationship management, the Marketing Account Manager owns assigned co-op revenue goals, marketing pipeline development, forecasting, contractual coordination, and the successful transition of partner commitments into executable marketing campaigns. Working closely with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance, this role ensures supplier investments translate into well-coordinated initiatives that support advisor engagement, supplier production, and Classic's broader commercial objectives.

This is a relationship-driven, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on bringing people, ideas, and opportunities together. Success requires commercial curiosity, creativity, strong organizational discipline, trusted partnerships, and the ability to influence outcomes across departments through clarity, collaboration, accountability, and shared purpose.

Why This Role Matters

At Classic Vacations, our supplier partnerships are more than business relationships. They are an essential part of how we create extraordinary travel experiences, strengthen our value to Travel Advisors, and bring exceptional destinations, properties, and experiences to life. Behind every successful marketing campaign is an opportunity to connect the right partner, the right message, and the right audience in a way that creates lasting value.

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply helps transform those opportunities into meaningful commercial results. By developing thoughtful, customized co-op marketing strategies, this role ensures that our supplier partners are not simply purchasing advertising placements. **Experience**: 5+ years of related marketing experience, ideally within CPG, beverage, food, lifestyle or another fast-moving consumer brand

The Protein Spot | Boise, Idaho | Full-Time

Help Build the Next Great Protein-Focused Food Brand

The Protein Spot is entering an exciting new chapter.

We’ve built a brand centered around convenient, high-quality, protein-focused food that supports active lifestyles. Now, we’re preparing to grow beyond our corporate locations and expand through franchising.

We’re looking for a creative, ambitious, hands-on Marketing Manager who wants to help build something from the ground up.

This isn’t a position where you’ll inherit a massive marketing department or spend your days sitting in meetings. You’ll have the opportunity to own our marketing strategy, execute campaigns, grow our brand presence, and help create the marketing systems that will support The Protein Spot as we scale.

We’re looking for someone who can think strategically on Monday and execute on Tuesday.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Brand Growth

* Develop and manage quarterly and annual marketing plans aligned with company growth objectives.
* Build and execute promotional calendars, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.

* Track campaign performance and continually improve results.

Franchise Marketing Systems

* Help develop a standardized marketing playbook for future franchisees.
* Create repeatable marketing calendars, campaign templates, and brand assets.
* Establish processes that allow local operators to execute effective marketing while maintaining brand consistency.
* Collaborate with leadership as we build our franchise support infrastructure.

* Developed and executed local marketing campaigns across our corporate locations.

This is an opportunity to get involved at a pivotal stage of growth.

You’ll work directly with company leadership, have meaningful ownership over your work, and help shape how our brand shows up in the market.

As The Protein Spot expands, so will the marketing function and the opportunities for the person who helps build it.

Send your resume along with examples of marketing campaigns, social content, or brands you’ve helped grow.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Director
jobs.description:
nicity is a health intervention company. We connect people with the products, the app, and the community that together can genuinely change their health — starting with our yerba maté formulated to support fasting and a fibre drink that slows carb absorption at mealtime, brought together in the Feel Great program. Our customers don't just buy a supplement; they start a program that reshapes how they eat, how they feel, and how they live. That means the experience we build — from the first page someone lands on, through checkout, into the app, and across every week after — is what determines whether a customer actually transforms their health or drifts away.  
  
About the Role  
We're hiring a Director of Growth to own the entire e-commerce funnel, acquisition *and* retention - from a customer's first visit through checkout, first-purchase activation, and long-term repeat revenue. You'll lead two initiatives (Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle) and be accountable for how they work as one system rather than two silos handing customers back and forth.  
  
This is a builder-operator role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone with hundreds of reps running structured experiments, who reads a funnel like a P&L, and who has personally shipped the tests, not just approved someone else's roadmap. You'll set the growth strategy and then implement it.  
  
We are in the middle of redefining our tech stack, and you’ll collaborate directly with the Director of Product and Tech Leads to make sure your team has the tools it needs to succeed.  
  
What You'll Own

* The full funnel, as one number. Conversion, AOV, activation, repeat rate, and customer LTV — one connected model, not a web metric and an email metric that never meet. You'll know exactly where visitors drop off across the entire lifecycle and why.
* A high-velocity testing program. Build and run the experimentation engine across landing pages, product pages, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle email/SMS. Prioritize by expected impact, ship weekly, and hold the team to a real read on what won and what didn't. Our traffic comes with high built-in intent rather than from paid ads — so tests have to be designed for the volume and audience we actually have.
* First-purchase acquisition. Maximize the yield of every visit: page experience, offer structure, and first-purchase conversion. Our customers arrive with intent already established, so the job is to convert that intent — not manufacture it.
* Retention and lifecycle. Oversee our email/SMS team, onboarding, activation into the Feel Great app, re-order, winback, and reactivation. Grow repeat revenue and LTV as deliberately as first-purchase conversion.
* The promo and launch calendar. Ship the site pages, offers, and lifecycle flows behind product launches and promotions, coordinating timelines across marketing and design.
* Instrumentation and truth. Own tracking and reporting so the whole company sees the same funnel weekly, and turn it into a visible, prioritized hypothesis backlog. Bring the qualitative "why" — reviews, support tickets, surveys, session replays — because we can't lean on paid-channel data for audience insight.
* The team. Manage, coach, and raise the bar for the employees on the team (currently 4 people across Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle); hire to fill gaps; set the operating cadence (weekly test reviews, roadmap, reporting).

  

What We're Looking For

* 6+ years in growth, CRO, lifecycle, or e-commerce, with 2+ years leading people — ideally at a high-performing DTC or subscription brand.
* A serious testing track record: you can talk through dozens of specific experiments you designed, the hypotheses, and what you learned when they lost.
* Full-funnel range — you've owned or worked hands-on across *both* acquisition/CRO and retention/lifecycle, not just one side.
* Fluency in the numbers: you build your own analysis, size opportunities before you test them, and understand statistical significance well enough to not fool yourself. SQL a strong plus; GA4/analytics and an experimentation tool (Optimizely, VWO, Convert, or similar) expected.
* Comfortable in the tools of the funnel — enough HTML/CSS to unblock a test, and hands-on experience with an ESP/lifecycle platform (Iterable, Klaviyo or similar).
* A leader who stays close to the work — sets direction and still reads the test results line by line.
* Genuine interest in metabolic health, fasting, or wellness is a plus, not a requirement.

  

Nice to Have

* Experience with affiliate-, influencer-, or referral-driven e-commerce (where attribution is different and on-site experience matters more).
* Shopify or comparable platform depth.
* Subscription/re-order or app-activation experience — moving people into a connected digital product, not just re-selling a SKU.
* Experience building a testing culture on a team, not just running tests yourself.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Outcomes**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.
* Translate the opportunity pipeline into account-based campaigns aimed at specific agency program offices, contracting activities, OSDBU offices, and large-prime teaming partners.
* Position STI Federal’s tribally owned status, socioeconomic designations, and differentiators in market-facing messaging that supports set-aside, direct-award, and teaming strategies where applicable.

* Capture, qualify, and log all event leads and contacts in the CRM within 48 hours of each event, and coordinate disciplined post-event follow-up with Business Development.

jobs.title: Search Engine Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are hiring an SEO Specialist to improve client search rankings, strengthen local visibility, and help websites attract relevant organic traffic. You'll review website performance, identify technical and content issues, manage local search listings, and use campaign data to guide ongoing improvements.

This role is suited to someone with at least two years of SEO experience who can work methodically, write clear recommendations, and understand that meaningful search improvements take time. You'll be expected to monitor campaigns consistently, respond promptly when problems arise, and report results accurately without making promises the data cannot support.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Audit client websites to identify technical SEO issues, content gaps, indexing problems, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop practical optimisation plans based on website audits, keyword research, and client objectives.
* Manage local business listings, check profile accuracy, and monitor customer reviews.
* Research keywords and search intent to identify opportunities for new pages and existing content improvements.
* Prepare clear content briefs outlining page objectives, target keywords, search intent, and recommended content structure.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and other relevant SEO performance indicators.
* Use Google Search Console and appropriate SEO tools to investigate changes in performance and identify potential issues.
* Review page titles, meta descriptions, internal links, headings, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Track campaign progress and prepare reports explaining performance changes, completed work, and recommended next steps.
* Investigate ranking declines, traffic changes, indexing issues, and other problems that may affect campaign performance.
* Keep campaign records, audit findings, and performance data accurate and organised.
* Respond promptly to client and team enquiries, particularly when a campaign requires investigation or corrective action.
* Communicate progress, concerns, and realistic expectations clearly to the relevant stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* **At least 2 years of professional experience in SEO.**
* Practical knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimisation, and local SEO.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console and relevant SEO research, auditing, and tracking tools.
* Understanding of keyword research, search intent, website indexing, and organic search performance.
* Good writing skills and the ability to prepare clear content briefs and optimisation recommendations.
* Ability to interpret ranking and traffic data and explain what the figures do—and do not—demonstrate.
* Strong attention to detail when auditing websites, checking business listings, and reviewing performance reports.
* A methodical approach to investigating technical issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks or campaigns at once.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to provide timely, accurate updates.
* Patience and consistency when managing campaigns where results develop over time.

**What to Expect in the Role**

You'll be expected to track SEO activity carefully, check your findings before reporting them, and communicate honestly about campaign performance. When rankings or traffic change unexpectedly, you should investigate the possible causes and explain what is known, what remains uncertain, and what action is recommended.

SEO requires ongoing attention rather than one-time fixes. We value consistent optimisation, realistic expectations, and prompt communication when a technical issue or campaign concern needs attention.

**Working Arrangements**

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Location:** 135 Henry St, Dayton, Ohio 45403  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your current Resume. Highlight your SEO experience, website auditing skills, familiarity with Google Search Console, and work with local search campaigns. Include examples of SEO projects you've supported and the performance indicators you used to evaluate progress.

jobs.description:

---------------

The role partners closely with Business Development, Marketing, IT, Corporate Training, operating subsidiaries, and leadership to turn data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable action to drive revenue growth.

jobs.title: SEO Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
You will support the lead on SEO and GEO strategy for a portfolio of agency clients, supporting delivery from first audit to reporting. This is a hands-on role for a strategist who can move between keyword research, technical fixes, AI search visibility and one that would grow into more client-facing involvement as your skillset advances. You will be the supporting strategist on retainer accounts, while being mentored by your lead strategist. Delivery and cross collaboration with PR, paid, social and creative teams is crucial, so search is considered as a part of the larger strategy in place. Clients span B2B and B2C, national and local, and regulated and consumer industries, so curiosity and adaptability matter as much as any single tool.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**On-page SEO and content strategy**

* Build content strategies that earn qualified organic traffic and turn it into leads, sales or bookings, not just clicks.
* Map keywords to the right content type and intent, and plan multiple pieces across different areas of a site so each one has a clear job in the buyer journey.
* Recommend on-page changes and page-template updates that give important pages room for richer, more useful content.
* Use internal linking, topical depth and site context to strengthen the pages that matter most.
* Plan content for national, regional or local footprints based on each client's industry and service area, including location pages and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Spot content decay and cannibalization, and decide when to refresh, consolidate or retire a page.

  
**Technical SEO**

* Support technical SEO audits and provide findings and data to be turned into a prioritized roadmap based on impact, effort and business value.
* Familiar with the value of Core Web Vitals, structured data, and clean URL and folder architecture in terms clients and developers both understand.
* Own the fundamentals with precision: title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, canonicals, redirects, XML sitemaps and robots.txt.

**GEO and AI search visibility**

* Connect GEO work to the SEO fundamentals it depends on, including crawlability for AI crawlers, structured data, and content that is easy to extract and cite.
* Analyze which sources AI platforms cite in a client's category (owned pages, earned media, reviews, forums, directories) and build strategy around that mix.
* Research the prompts and questions real buyers ask across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Claude.
* Stay current on how AI search changes and translate what's new into practical recommendations, without chasing hype.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Report organic and AI search results in business terms: pipeline, revenue, leads, bookings or enrollments, depending on the client.
* Use keyword intent and the buyer journey to explain complex targeting strategies in plain language.
* Able to present reporting outcomes to internal teams, and willing to attend client reporting sessions as a means for rapport building.

**Client leadership and delivery**

* Fully accountable to SEO retainer delivery as the direct support to client strategy leads.
* Manage workload, hours and timelines across several accounts so work stays on budget and on schedule.
* Work in partnership with other supporting strategists, fostering a team environment and interdependency with one another.
* Spot growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new-business audits.

  
**What you bring**  
**Must-haves**

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with at least 1 in an agency or multi-client environment.
* A track record of organic growth you can explain with real numbers and the business impact behind them.
* Working fluency in Semrush (or Ahrefs), Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and GA4.
* A clear, curious point of view on how AI is changing search.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with Profound or another GEO/AI visibility platform (Semrush AI Toolkit, Peec AI, Otterly or similar).
* Local SEO and listing management tools such as Yext, BrightLocal or Uberall.
* Familiarity with digital PR or link earning.

You don't need to check every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of the must-haves, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
**What you’ll get:**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Remote and hybrid working flexibility
* A wellness subsidy
* A manager who provides consistent 1:1 check-ins, feedback, and growth opportunities
* Culture-building events and cross-team collaboration
* Career advancement opportunities within a growing agency
* A strong emphasis on work-life balance

  
**What you’ll be a part of:**

* An established and still growing agency that values creativity and collaboration.
* A global team of experts who support each other and strive to achieve excellent results for clients.
* A culture that promotes diversity, work-life balance, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  
**Where will you work?**  
Anywhere in the U.S. We're a remote-first workplace with optional in-office days in Boston, Chicago, Detroit, LA, Nashville, New York, Portland, Washington DC, and more.  
  
**Anticipated Salary:** $70,000 - $85,000  
Compensation is based on experience and depending upon workplace location.  
  
**To Apply:**  
Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary in $US Dollars.  
  
While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to those with whom we have a greater interest.  
  
**About FINN Partners:**  
Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has become one of the fastest growing independent public relations agencies in the world. With 1,300 professionals globally, FINN provides clients with access and capabilities in North America, Europe and Asia. FINN Partners clients are also supported through longstanding partner age

To be considered for our freelance roster, please submit:

* A portfolio with three to five relevant writing samples.

Tell us what you do best, what kinds of projects excite you, and why you’d be a great fit for Zora Digital.

We look forward to discovering what we can create together.

jobs.title: Paid Media Lead
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

jobs.description:
UTTR is looking for a **part-time Paid Media Specialist** with 3–5 years of experience to manage, optimise, and grow paid digital marketing campaigns across multiple B2B client accounts.

You’ll work with B2B SaaS and technology companies, managing campaigns across platforms such as LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other relevant channels. You’ll collaborate with campaign managers, designers, RevOps specialists, and clients to ensure paid media activity drives meaningful business results.

We’re looking for someone who is analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of campaigns from strategy and setup through optimisation and reporting.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

### **Campaign Management**

* Manage paid media campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
* Plan and execute campaign launches, including targeting, budgets, bidding, tracking, and creative coordination.
* Manage multiple client accounts and ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with business goals.
* Monitor campaign performance, budget pacing, and delivery, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
* Develop and implement paid media strategies based on client objectives and target audiences.

### **Performance & Optimisation**

* Analyse campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.
* Optimise campaigns across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, budgets, keywords, and landing pages.
* Plan and manage A/B tests across audiences, messaging, creative, and landing pages.
* Track key metrics such as CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.
* Identify trends and opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and performance.

### **Analytics & Reporting**

* Use HubSpot, CRM platforms, GA4, and advertising platforms to analyse campaign performance.
* Connect paid media results with leads, pipeline, and broader business outcomes.
* Build and maintain campaign reports and dashboards for internal teams and clients.
* Communicate performance insights, challenges, and recommendations clearly.
* Use Looker Studio or similar reporting tools where applicable.

### **Collaboration**

* Work closely with designers, RevOps specialists, campaign managers, and clients.
* Participate in client meetings and communicate campaign performance and recommendations.
* Stay up to date with advertising platform changes and paid media best practices.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve account and campaign performance.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years of hands-on paid media experience, ideally in an agency or B2B marketing environment.
* Strong experience with one or more platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, or Microsoft Ads.
* Experience managing campaign budgets and making data-driven optimisation decisions.
* Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, targeting, bidding, conversion tracking, and attribution.
* Experience with GA4, HubSpot, CRM platforms, or similar marketing technology.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities independently.
* Comfortable working cross-functionally and directly with clients.
* Proactive mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Advanced English (C1).

You don't need to have experience with every platform listed above. We're looking for someone with a strong paid media foundation who can confidently manage campaigns and continue developing their expertise across channels.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Google Ads, Meta, or LinkedIn certifications.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS or technology companies.
* Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting tools.
* Familiarity with attribution tools or B2B marketing technology.
* Experience connecting paid media performance to pipeline and revenue.
* Experience presenting campaign performance directly to clients.

**Working Hours**
-----------------

This is a **part-time, fully remote role** with working hours agreed upon in advance.

We're fully remote, and you can work from anywhere. However, you'll need consistent overlap with EST, CST, MST, or PST business hours for team collaboration and occasional client meetings.

**Why Work at UTTR?**
---------------------

* **Global flexibility:** Work from anywhere as part of a fully remote team.
* **Cultural diversity:** Work with a diverse, globally distributed team.
* **Diverse tech clients:** Work with a variety of startups and technology companies.
* **Grow your expertise:** Manage real B2B campaigns and deepen your skills across paid media, analytics, and performance marketing.

*Please be aware that legitimate UTTR recruitment communications will come from an* ***@uttr.com*** *email address. Any offers or candidate interviews originating from other email domains should be treated as potential phishing attempts and do not represent UTTR LLC.*

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Growth Marketing Manager**
============================

**Location:** Remote (United States)

**About Numa**
--------------

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a **Growth Marketing Manager** to own qualified inbound and drive predictable pipeline growth. You'll be responsible for the channels that generate demand, including paid media, search, answer engines, partner programs, lifecycle marketing, and landing pages.

This role requires someone who can move between strategy and execution, build a consistent testing cadence, and use data to make decisions about where to invest. You'll work closely with the Marketing Lead and Sales leadership to forecast results, improve conversion, and turn marketing demand into qualified meetings.

We're a lean, AI-native team. You'll have the autonomy to build your own workflows, experiment with new tools, and use AI agents to make growth programs more efficient and scalable. Success means owning your number, understanding what's driving it, and consistently finding ways to improve it.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop and execute a growth strategy to increase qualified inbound and achieve pipeline targets
* Own monthly forecasting and reporting for qualified inbound, working closely with marketing and sales leadership
* Manage paid acquisition across search, social, and community channels, including budget allocation, targeting, creative, and campaign optimization
* Run weekly experiments across landing pages, offers, forms, audiences, and messaging to improve conversion
* Own the path from first touch to held meeting, including speed to lead, scheduling, reminders, and nurture programs
* Improve Numa's visibility across traditional search and AI-powered answer engines
* Turn partner launches, conferences, and roadshows into qualified leads and booked meetings
* Define funnel stages and attribution with Sales, maintain accurate reporting in HubSpot, and ensure pipeline metrics align with CRM data
* Build and optimize AI agent workflows, sequences, dashboards, and queries to automate repetitive work and improve execution
* Maintain a consistent experiment log, communicate results, and use performance data to guide future investments

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 4 to 6 years of experience in growth marketing or demand generation, including at least 2 years directly owning a lead or pipeline target
* A data-driven approach to decision-making, with the ability to build reports, write queries, analyze funnel performance, and distinguish meaningful signals from noise
* A strong experimentation mindset. You test frequently, learn quickly, and know when to stop investing in underperforming campaigns
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot and paid acquisition platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn
* Experience improving conversion across the marketing funnel, from initial engagement through booked and held meetings
* The ability to forecast performance, explain results, and make clear recommendations to marketing and sales leadership
* Strong execution skills and the ability to prioritize progress, measurement, and iteration over perfection
* An AI-native approach to work, using AI tools and agents to build workflows, automate tasks, and improve efficiency
* The ability to operate independently, take ownership of results, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Experience at a startup or high-growth technology company where you built a marketing channel or program from the ground up
* Experience marketing to automotive dealerships or another vertical where individual accounts represent significant business value
* Experience running partner or channel marketing programs
* Working knowledge of answer engine optimization (AEO)

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Consistently grow qualified inbound quarter over quarter while maintaining lead quality and Sales' confidence in the pipeline
* Increase the percentage of booked meetings that become held meetings
* Maintain accurate funnel reporting and attribution that aligns with CRM data
* Establish a steady cadence of experiments that produce clear learnings and measurable conversion improvements
* Build scalable growth programs and AI-powered workflows that improve marketing efficiency

**Why Join Numa**
-----------------

* We believe in everyone's growth
* Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000
* Help bring category-defining AI technology to an industry undergoing significant change
* Join a high-growth organization with opportunities to make a meaningful impact and grow your career

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Base salary: $120,000 - $150,000
* Equity package
* Flexible PTO
* Health, dental, and vision benefits
* 401(k) plan

At Numa, you'll have the opportunity to build the growth engine behind technology that's transforming the automotive industry. If you enjoy taking ownership, experimenting to find what works, and turning data into measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
*At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.*

*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity*

**The Role**

We're looking for a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and scale the programs that turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. This role owns demand generation end-to-end — email nurtures, paid media (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads), content syndication, webinars, and organic social presence — while contributing to overall messaging strategy and brand direction.

This is a high-ownership, execution-focused role for someone who's equally comfortable optimizing a paid search account, building a nurture sequence, and keeping our social channels sharp day to day. You'll set demand gen campaign strategy and ensure it stays aligned with FourKites' broader narrative by partnering across Marketing, Product, and Sales.

**What You'll Do**

**Demand Generation Strategy & Campaigns**

* Lead the growth and pipeline strategy: design and execute an integrated plan across paid, content, social, and lifecycle programs, with the roadmap and budget to hit awareness, conversion, and pipeline targets.
* Build and manage always-on and campaign-specific nurture programs including drip sequences, segmentation, and A/B testing, in coordination with sales development.
* Own end-to-end execution for webinars tied to active demand gen campaigns (platform administration, promotion, registration, and follow-up).
* Draft first-pass content supporting demand gen campaigns — landing pages, campaign emails, ad copy, and gated assets — for review and refinement.

**Programs & Partnerships**

* Own content syndication, third-party promotions, and paid placements end-to-end — from vendor selection and contracting through asset delivery, lead handoff with marketing ops and SDRs, and performance tracking.
* Build and maintain campaign planning templates and calendars that keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on timing, assets, and channels.

**Paid Media & Search**

* Own strategy, execution, and ongoing optimization of Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, including keyword strategy, bid management, audience targeting, and budget allocation across funnel stages.
* Own quarterly keyword planning — competitive gap analysis, tiered keyword strategy, and forecasting to inform budget conversations.
* Maintain and refresh our ICP and target persona/title lists each half or after major launches, feeding both paid and account-based targeting.

**Social Media**

* Own day-to-day management of FourKites' social channels with agency support on execution: copywriting on 2-3 posts weekly, final QA on all posts and graphics, community moderation, and photo/asset sourcing.
* Serve as the go-to resource for internal teams looking to get social content published, ensuring everything meets brand and voice standards.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Director, Corporate Marketing on campaign strategy for nurture and webinar programs.
* Partner with content, PR, and product marketing to align demand gen campaigns with major company moments (product launches, positioning shifts, analyst events).
* Partner with marketing operations on analytics and reporting infrastructure — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per opportunity, and channel-level ROI — so performance data is reliable and accessible across campaigns.
* Own continuous improvement across all campaigns: regularly test, measure, and iterate on targeting, messaging, and spend allocation based on performance data, rather than treating campaigns as set-and-forget.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience in enterprise SaaS. Experience in supply chain, logistics, or transportation technology and AI agents is a plus.
* Hands-on email marketing experience, including building nurture sequences, managing segmentation, and reporting on engagement and conversion.
* Direct, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns, from strategy through execution and optimization is preferred.
* Experience owning a webinar program (platform administration, promotion, and reporting) is a plus.
* Comfort managing organic social channels day to day, including community moderation and content QA.
* Strong project management instincts — comfortable building and maintaining the templates, processes, and calendars that keep a marketing team organized.
* A collaborative style; you'll work closely across Sales, Marketing, and Product and need to bring people along rather than execute in a silo.
* Comfort working with data to track performance — you don't need to build dashboards yourself, but you should be fluent enough in the numbers to know what to test next.
* Strong writing skills — clear, human copy for campaigns and social, even if long-form content isn't your primary focus.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 90 days: you'll have taken ownership of the paid media, social media, and webinar programs, be fluent in current campaign performance and ICP targeting, and have a working rhythm established with the Director, Corporate Marketing on nurture and webinar strategy.

By month six: you'll be running demand gen campaigns independently end-to-end, have a content syndication program live and generating qualified leads, have improved reporting visibility into pipeline sourced by channel, and have tightened up campaign planning processes for the broader marketing team.

**Company Description**

Hyperquake is an independent creative strategy, branding, and experience design marketing agency founded in 1986, with locations in Cincinnati, Salt Lake City, and Brooklyn. We specialize in strategic innovation, branded experiences, and scaling organizations for growth, working with companies ranging from small startups to global enterprises. Hyperquake builds ambitious brands and experiences for those eager to activate a vision.

This is a full-time role for a Sr. Director of Growth Marketing, Media & Analytics located in Cincinnati, OH. Reporting directly to the Managing Director of Brand Building, this individual will lead Hyperquake's media and analytics team, currently composed of 7-8 employees plus contractors/freelancers.

The role requires both strategic leadership and hands-on execution. The Sr. Director will set vision and direction for growth marketing across paid social, search, display, print, OOH, and programmatic channels, while ensuring analytics rigor is embedded in every campaign. They will manage and develop the team, but also stay close to the work—reviewing plans, optimizing campaigns, refining reporting, and ensuring excellence in delivery.

* Set overall strategy for paid media and analytics across a range of client engagements.

* Partner with the Managing Director of Brand Building to align media and analytics with broader brand and growth initiatives.

* Experience managing budgets, vendor partnerships, and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. The Marketing Director is responsible for the planning, coordination and implementation of all marketing and communication efforts. This position is responsible for implementing policy decisions, in conjunction with their supervisor. The Marketing Director is responsible for coordinating all marketing and communication efforts, including coordination of all internal and external communication, ensuring brand compliance, community relations and collaborations with community agencies to achieve the goals of the Akron Area YMCA. All activities are done to further the YMCA Mission.

  

**OUR CULTURE:**  
Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Marketing and Communication:** Develop and implement strategic marketing plan(s) to achieve Association's short-and long-term goals to support sales and revenue objectives. Research, analyze and monitor financial, technological, and demographic factors to capitalize on market opportunities. Plan, create, and coordinate advertising and promotional activities, including but not limited to: print, online, video and other electronic media, and direct mail. Implement and coordinate website, social media and other digital communication strategies to expand visibility and increase member and community engagement across all digital platforms. Track/report web traffic trends.
* **Public Relations:** Plan and implement public relation strategies, policies and procedures. Field and direct responses to all media-related inquiries. Research and write copy for the Akron Area YMCA's promotional materials. Develop and maintain good contacts and relationships with local media outlets. Ensure that YMCA-related communications do not compromise the Akron Area YMCA's tax-exempt status. Create positive and proactive internal and external communication.
