jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. You will translate product positioning and messaging into actionable, full-funnel growth strategies and high-converting marketing campaigns. * Continuous Feedback Loop: Proactively engaging with field marketing and solutions teams to assess growth opportunities, actively solicit feedback on campaign performance, and rapidly iterate on tactics.

Segmentation & List Development:

* Audience Segmentation: Working with database marketing to build, refine, and maintain granular target lists derived from Verizon customer base analytics
* List Enrichment & AI Capabilities: Utilizing internal customer databases and AI resources to size the addressable market and develop targeted campaign lists.

You are a highly collaborative, data-driven, and execution-oriented marketer who excels at hitting aggressive revenue targets. You know how to translate product capabilities into actionable demand campaigns.

As Asset Management and Asset Servicing continue to evolve their digital marketing and demand generation capabilities, this role will play a key part in building a more connected, automated, and measurable approach to audience engagement. The position will support the design and execution of marketing automation programs, including campaign orchestration, nurture journeys, lead management, segmentation, testing, and performance optimization. The role partners with marketing, sales and business stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, data-driven marketing programs using Marketo, Salesforce and connected platforms. Define campaign KPIs, create reporting and analyze performance across delivery, engagement, conversion, lead quality, client activity and business contribution; recommend optimization opportunities.

* Extensive hands-on experience using Marketo to build, test, deploy and optimize email, landing page, form, event, webinar, nurture, triggered and multi-channel programs
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud or Salesforce Financial Services Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics including campaign structure, lead and contact management, reporting and sales handoff processes.

* Strong data management skills, including data quality review, field mapping, normalization, deduplication, consent management and governance
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent structured communication skills and the ability to explain marketing automation, CRM and data concepts clearly to business and technical stakeholders

With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Commerce7: We believe that above price and product, the number one reason why a consumer chooses a brand is customer experience. Customer experiences that are customer-centric lead to loyalty, customer happiness, and ultimately drive sales and profit. Our mission at Commerce7 is to empower wineries with the tools and insights needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences and succeed in DTC.

As the **Demand Generation Manage**r at Commerce7, you'll own the pipeline engine for new winery acquisition: building and running the campaigns, outbound programs, and paid strategies that attract, engage, and convert qualified wineries onto the platform. You'll operate inside the Create/Capture/Convert (3C) demand gen framework, working closely with Sales to hit pipeline and demo targets, and with RevOps to act on the attribution and performance data they provide. You bring structure and accountability to demand gen execution — planning campaigns with precision, working from shared pipeline reporting, and continuously improving performance based on what converts.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

*Pipeline & Funnel Growth*

* Own new-logo pipeline and demo targets in partnership with Sales, building on the existing demo funnel and bottoms-up funnel models.
* Manage target account and whitespace campaigns from list-building through conversion.
* Use RevOps-provided attribution and pipeline reporting to identify what's working and reallocate effort accordingly (this role acts on the data, RevOps owns the underlying architecture)

*Demand Generation & Campaigns*

* Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns, covering lead generation, brand awareness, and product adoption.
* Own Commerce7's paid acquisition strategy, collaborating with external vendors on budgets, targeting, assets, and ongoing optimization.
* Run outbound and account-based programs against defined target lists, including sequencing and messaging.
* Owns email as a core channel (strategy, calendar, segmentation, performance), with content/copy support from Content.

*Customer Stories & Proof*

* Partner with the content role to prioritize which customer stories, testimonials and use cases get built, based on active campaign and target account needs - the content team builds the flywheel and this role puts it into motion.
* Activate proof assets across campaigns, outbound sequences and sales enablement to drive conversions
* Feed campaign performance and prospect objections back to the content function to inform what gets built next

*Social & Community Engagement*

* Set organic social strategy and content calendar direction; day-to-day posting can be delegated across the marketing team.
* Support a lightweight LinkedIn engagement approach for Sales and Success, focused on feature adoption rather than a full thought-leadership program.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Align with VP of Sales on pipeline targets, funnel health, and demo goals.
* Partner with Product Marketing on go-to-market initiatives, launches, and campaigns.
* Collaborate with Events Marketing Manager to extend event impact through pre- and post-event campaigns.
* Work with RevOps function to ensure campaign performance is tracked accurately and attribution data informs planning.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Pipeline & Funnel Ownership: Comfortable owning demo/pipeline targets and working from funnel and attribution data to guide campaign decisions.
* Outbound & ABM: Experience running target-account or whitespace campaigns, including list-building, sequencing, and messaging.
* Strategic Campaign Planning: Ability to design and execute multi-channel campaigns that drive lead generation, brand awareness, and product adoption.
* Digital Marketing & Paid Acquisition: Proficient in managing paid strategies and optimizing performance across digital channels.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Skilled in working across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Partnerships to align messaging and initiatives.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
* 5+ years marketing experience, focus on demand gen/campaigns/digital
* Outbound or ABM program experience strongly preferred
* Marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot) and analytics tool experience
* Strong written/verbal communication
* Cross-team collaboration ability, especially with Sales
* B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience preferred

**Salary Range: $90,375 - $104,000 CAD**

* Medical
* Extended Health and LTD plan
* Dental
* Vision
* RRSP (with employer match)
* Health Spending Account

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager II - Power Utilities
jobs.description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.

Power utilities and renewable energy are important growth markets for nVent, creating opportunities to connect customers with solutions from across our Electrical Connections portfolio. In this highly visible role, you will develop and implement integrated marketing strategies that bring together business priorities, customer needs, and nVent’s capabilities to drive awareness, engagement, demand generation, and growth across power utilities, renewables, and industrial markets.

  

**\*\* This is a full-time, direct-hire position with a hybrid work schedule of four days per week on-site in Solon, OH. \*\***

  

**WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE IN THIS POSITION:**

* Develop and lead integrated marketing plans that support growth objectives across assigned verticals/markets.
* Translate product and business priorities into integrated vertical marketing programs, messaging, campaigns, content, and customer experiences that connect nVent's solutions with the needs of priority audiences.
* Lead demand generation initiatives across digital marketing, content marketing, webinars, social media, events, email marketing, and sales enablement channels to generate engagement, marketing-qualified leads, and pipeline growth.
* Own vertical-specific content strategies, including thought leadership, industry education, customer success stories, solution guides, landing pages, and sales enablement tools.
* Serve as the marketing lead for priority vertical trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry programs, shaping the audience strategy, messaging, content, and solutions highlighted to strengthen engagement and lead generation.
* Collaborate with Digital Marketing and Content teams to enhance vertical web experiences, improve search visibility, and optimize customer journeys across the buying process.
Monitor and analyze campaign, content, event, and pipeline performance metrics to optimize investment decisions, improve results, and communicate marketing impact to key business partners.  

  

**YOU HAVE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field.
* Ideally 10+ years of B2B marketing experience with increasing responsibility across integrated marketing, demand generation, industry or vertical marketing, partnership marketing, or related work.
* Experience developing annual marketing plans and translating business objectives into integrated marketing programs and campaigns.
* Understanding of the customer journey, demand generation, lead nurturing, customer acquisition, segmentation, and marketing performance measurement.
* Experience using CRM and marketing automation tools such as Salesforce, Marketo, or similar platforms.
* Experience coordinating marketing initiatives across a complex, global organization, partnering with teams such as product management, sales, and marketing to develop and guide programs across regions.
* Industrial manufacturing, technical B2B, electrical infrastructure, utilities, or other complex technical market experience preferred.
* Ability to travel approximately 10-15%.

**WE HAVE:**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

  + nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
  + Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com .

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

  + Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

* Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

  + Innovative & adaptable
  + Dedicated to absolute integrity
  + Focused on the customer first
  + Respectful and team oriented
  + Optimistic and energizing
  + Accountable for performance

* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.

jobs.description:
**Blast Cleaning Technologies, Inc. (BCT) is proud to be the leader in shot blast innovation! We are dedicated to our customers, resulting in continuous company growth year over year.**

**Why Work at BCT?**

**Highly Competitive Pay, Benefit Plans, & 401K:** We pay for skill **AND** talent. We offer a full range of comprehensive benefits & 401K employer match 50% up to 6%.

**Medical Insurance:** 90% of Insurance Premiums are covered by BCT!!! Low deductibles, ZERO coinsurance, & extensive provider networks to utilize.

**Generous PTO & Paid Holidays:** Take advantage of our generous PTO plans and many paid U.S. holidays.

**Casual Work Environment:** Enjoy a casual dress code and friendly workplace.

**Historic Location:** Work in our over $2 million investment in upgrades and refurbishment at our historic West Allis location.

**Innovation:** Work for a company that continuously invests back into the business and the employees. With our cutting-edge foundry being a prime example of true innovation.

**Amenities:** Enjoy free coffee, popcorn, summer cookouts, and more!

**Continuous Education:** Venture in your future with our tuition reimbursement program and our variety of investments in your continued learning.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Brand Specialist is a self-starter that keeps projects on track and on time within LifeStraw’s marketing department. This is a generalist, execution-focused role: you own the intake system, the project tracker, and contribute to building out new campaign assets and sales enablement materials. In addition to being a core contributor on the marketing team, you also serve as the primary point-of-contact to sales. You are the glue; you help the two teams stay aligned and ensure sales requests are actioned appropriately in the marketing project pipeline.

You'll report to the Senior Brand Manager and work daily with Creative, Content & Social, and the Sales team across Outdoor, Retail, Amazon, International, and Institutional channels.

**What You Own**

* **Marketing Execution**

* Develop and repurpose high-quality campaign content, including blog posts, website content, email campaigns, and social media

* Assist in running surveys to collect consumer feedback and producing an analysis of findings
* Support a regular cadence of marketing reporting to share performance data internally with key stakeholders

* Produce light graphic design in Canva, including social media graphics, email banners, event promotions, infographics, and branded collateral

* **Project Management & Request Intake (Asana)**

* Own the Asana workspace: project templates, task structure, custom fields, due dates, dashboards, and user onboarding.
* Own the shared marketing request tracker and the master marketing and sales calendar in Asana: launches, campaigns, promos, retail resets, and trade shows.
* Own the marketing request intake form and triage queue. Route every incoming request from Sales, Ecommerce, and internal stakeholders to the right owner with a due date attached and confirm receipt to the requester.
* Check every creative brief for completeness before it reaches Creative. Chase the missing information down yourself rather than passing an incomplete brief along.
* Serve as the intake gatekeeper for ad-hoc or under-briefed requests, ensuring they follow the intake process before reaching Creative.
* Maintain and enforce SOPs for creative briefs, timelines, approval workflows, and file handoff.
* Run the weekly cross-functional sync with Sales and Marketing: agenda, notes, action items, follow-up.

* **Digital Asset Management (Bynder)**

* Own our Bynder DAM end to end uploads, naming conventions, metadata tagging, collections, and user permissions.
* Serve as the first responder on all asset requests from Sales, Ecommerce, retail partners, PR, and creators.
* Process new creative into the DAM once approved, correctly tagged by product, channel, and campaign, so the right file is easy to find.
* Track asset usage rights and expirations (talent, photography, licensed imagery) and flag anything approaching expiry to the Sr. Brand Manager.
* Build and share curated collections and links for retail partners, distributors, and press, and retire outdated assets so the wrong pack shot never ships.

* **Sales Enablement Library**

* Own the sell sheet, sales catalogue, one-pager, and trade show materials library, keeping it current and organized by channel.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Brand Manager to ensure launch kits include all sales-facing deliverables on schedule.
* Track which materials each Sales channel is using and flag gaps.

**What You Execute (Supporting the Marketing Team & Sr. Brand Manager)**

*Day-to-day support work where you execute against direction set by the Sr. Brand Manager and channel leads.*

* **Social publishing support:** Assist with scheduling organic social posts to the content calendar, load captions and assets, and compile weekly engagement reporting.
* **Retailer & Amazon content upkeep:** Load and refresh copy, imagery, A+ content, and video on Amazon and retailer portals, and flag outdated or missing content for fix.
* **Reporting & dashboard upkeep:** Maintain the weekly and monthly marketing performance recap in the established template: pull numbers from Amazon, retail POS, GA, email, and social into the format leadership already uses. You compile and maintain accurately and on time; the Sr. Brand Manager and VP set direction and interpret strategic implications.
* **Event & trade show logistics:** Manage the operational detail on trade shows and events: booth collateral, printed materials, sample and product shipments, giveaway inventory, shipping deadlines, packing lists, and post-show reconciliation.
* **Sample & seeding coordination:** Coordinate product samples and seeding shipments for press, creators, and Sales, and keep the tracking log current.

**What We're Looking For**

* A doer. You roll up your sleeves and jump in to help get marketing projects across the line.
* Organized and process-oriented. You keep a tracker updated without being asked twice.
* Reliable follow-through. You chase missing information until you get it, and you tell people when a date is going to slip before it slips.
* Detail oriented on the things that carry the brand: file names, image resolution, pricing accuracy, claim language, and version control.
* Comfortable being the connective tissue between Sales, Creative, and Marketing without needing to set anyone's strategy.
* Interest in consumer brands, sustainability, or outdoor/humanitarian markets a plus.

**Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in marketing coordination, brand operations, or project management at a consumer brand.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
* Hands-on experience with a project management tool (Asana preferred; Monday.com, Wrike, Trello, or Smartsheet considered), including building projects and templates, not just completing assigned tasks.
* Hands-on experience with a digital asset management platform (Bynder preferred; Brandfolder, Widen, Canto, or similar considered).
* Working proficiency in Canva, including building from and managing brand t

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Pallas Textiles
jobs.description:
At KI, we believe knowing our customers helps us serve them better. We listen. We observe. We understand that each customer has unique needs. So, we pride ourselves on helping our customers make smart furniture decisions by offering expert advice, design options and personalized solutions. Since 1941, we’ve positioned KI as the furniture company that best understands the furniture industry and is committed to providing customers with the smart solutions. By targeting specific markets with solutions for business furniture, university furniture, educational furniture, healthcare furniture and government furniture, we can quickly respond to our customers’ unique needs – including the choice to procure furniture according to what fits their ordering and fulfillment process. That’s why we say we offer far more than furniture. We’re Furnishing Knowledge.
  
  
Job Overview
  
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Brand Manager for our Pallas Textiles division who will work from KI’s Corporate Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. This position is responsible for shaping and elevating the Pallas brand through strategic marketing, compelling storytelling, and innovative product positioning. This role develops and executes integrated marketing initiatives that bring textile collections to life, translating design inspiration, color stories, and brand vision into meaningful customer experiences. Working closely with the VP of Pallas, design, sales, and cross-functional teams, the Brand Manager drives brand strategy, product launches, portfolio positioning, and marketing campaigns that strengthen brand awareness, support business growth, and deepen engagement within the commercial design community. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and creative marketer who thrives at the intersection of design, branding, and relationship-driven collaboration.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring the Pallas brand and collections to life through compelling storytelling, visual content, and customer experiences.
* Lead the creation of marketing campaigns, product launches, and content strategies across digital, print, social, and industry channels.
* Partner closely with designers to translate collection inspiration, color stories, and creative vision into impactful market positioning and brand narratives.
* Drive the development of product imagery, catalogs, sales tools, and branded marketing materials that support customer engagement and sales growth.
* Own and evolve the Pallas brand strategy, ensuring a consistent and distinctive brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
* Collaborate with sales, leadership, operations, and external partners to align marketing initiatives with business objectives and product launches.
* Transform customer, sales, and market insights into compelling product positioning and portfolio strategies that strengthen market relevance.
* Lead major brand initiatives from concept through execution, managing timelines, priorities, resources, and deliverables.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging design influences to identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and continuously refine strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and market impact.

What you Need to Succeed
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field.
* 5-7 year’ experience in marketing, brand management or related role, preferably in the design/creative industry.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies that drive business growth.
* Strong leadership and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Creative thinker with a keen eye for design and detail.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools, content management systems, graphic design software, and analytics platforms.

What KI Offers You
  

* Participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): As an employee, you will have stock ownership in the company.
* Competitive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for your well-being.
* A 401(k) Plan with Company Match: A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
* Paid Vacation, Sick Days, & Holidays: Time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones.
* Wellness Resources: Access to an on-site fitness center, fitness reimbursement program, and on-site nurse.
* Onsite Cafe: Enjoy a full breakfast and lunch menu right at work.
* Employee Product Discounts: Special pricing on company products.
* Educational Reimbursement Program: Support for degree programs and certifications.
* Full Benefits Package: Includes life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Apply today!
  
  
KI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Type: [Full-Time]**

**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and creative Marketing Coordinator to join our team. This individual will oversee the development and execution of marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and drive customer engagement. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the culinary industry. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will take on creative director responsibilities, guiding the overall visual and thematic direction of marketing materials and content.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Strategic Planning**

* **Market Research**: Analyze industry trends, customer preferences, and competitor strategies. Conduct surveys or focus groups to gather insights.
* **Target Audience Identification**: Define customer personas based on demographics, psychographics, and dining behaviors.
* **Marketing Goals**: Establish short-term and long-term marketing objectives (e.g., increase brand awareness, boost sales by X%, launch a new menu).

**2. Brand Management**

* **Brand Development**: Ensure brand consistency across all restaurant locations. Create brand guidelines for logos, colors, and tone of voice.
* **Reputation Management**: Monitor online reviews and social media presence. Engage with customers and address their concerns promptly.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* **Website Management**: Optimize the restaurant group’s website for user experience and SEO. Ensure menus, locations, and promotions are updated.
* **Social Media Strategy**: Develop a content calendar for platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Post engaging content, including behind-the-scenes, promotions, and user-generated content.
* **Email Marketing**: Create newsletters to inform customers about upcoming events, new dishes, and special offers. Segment the audience for personalized campaigns.

**4. Content Creation**

* **Visual and Written Content**: Produce high-quality content for various platforms, including blog posts, social media updates, videos, and promotional materials. Ensure all content aligns with brand voice and strategy.
* **Creative Development**: Lead the creative direction for marketing materials, including ad videos and detailed flyers. Collaborate with designers, videographers, and copywriters to create compelling content that resonates with the target audience.

**5. Promotional Campaigns**

* **Seasonal Promotions**: Plan and execute seasonal campaigns (e.g., holiday specials, summer menus). Collaborate with chefs to create unique offerings.
* **Loyalty Programs**: Develop a loyalty program to encourage repeat business. Use customer data to tailor rewards and promotions.
* **Events and Collaborations**: Organize events, such as tastings, cooking classes, or partnerships with local businesses (e.g., breweries, farms).

**6. Advertising**

* **Media Planning**: Identify appropriate channels for advertising (online, print, radio). Allocate budget effectively.
* **Creative Development**: Oversee the production of compelling ads that resonate with the target audience, ensuring alignment with overall marketing strategy.

**7. Analytics and Reporting**

* **Performance Metrics**: Track KPIs such as customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value, and social media engagement.
* **Regular Reporting**: Prepare monthly/quarterly reports on marketing performance. Analyze what worked and what didn’t and adjust strategies accordingly.

**8. Collaboration and Team Management**

* **Cross-Department Collaboration**: Work closely with the culinary team to ensure promotions align with menu offerings. Collaborate with operations to maintain service quality during promotional periods.

**Example Campaign Ideas**

* **“Taste of the Month”**: Feature a different dish each month, highlighting local ingredients.
* **Social Media Challenges**: Encourage customers to post their dining experiences with a specific hashtag for a chance to win a gift card.
* **Community Involvement**: Partner with local charities for fundraising events, offering a percentage of sales on specific days.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Employee discounts at restaurant locations

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Brand Manager**

**Farmer Group | Cortland, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time, Exempt**

**Pay range:** $65,000 to $85,000 per year

**About Us**

Farmer Group is a fast-growing cannabis company and the home of five in-house brands: Florist Farms, Head & Heal, Blotter, Tune, and Hudson. We take pride in being a legitimate, well-run company in an industry where that's often missing, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized, collaborative Brand Manager to bring our brands to life. Reporting to the Brand Director, you'll turn brand priorities into well-run projects. You'll work closely with Sales, Creative, Product Development, and Production to deliver the materials and support our teams need.

The role combines marketing project management, brand content, retail merchandising, and vendor coordination. If you like bringing structure to a busy environment, communicate clearly, and see projects through from first brief to final delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll DoBrand Execution & Project Management**

* Lead brand initiatives and product launches, turning business needs into clear briefs, timelines, and deliverables
* Own the shared marketing calendar for launches, promotions, events, and merchandising, and plan around creative and production lead times
* Run multiple projects across teams. Keep owners, deadlines, and priorities visible, and flag blockers early
* Partner with Sales to develop marketing materials and sales tools that support our retail accounts
* Coordinate label copy and product information between the Print Shop and Creative so labels are approved on time
* Support Product Development as new products move toward launch
* Coordinate brand materials and logistics for trade shows, retail activations, and events
* Keep tasks, approvals, and handoffs current in Asana

**Content & Brand Assets**

* Write and coordinate product copy, strain descriptions, promotional emails, catalogs, and educational materials in each brand's voice
* Route creative, product information, and claims to the right reviewers before release
* Maintain an organized library of approved brand assets and media kits

**Retail Merchandising, Swag & Vendors**

* Write briefs for packaging updates, retail merchandising, swag, and staff merchandise
* Manage vendor relationships, balancing quality, cost, and timelines
* Oversee sourcing, samples, purchase orders, and delivery with Accounting and Warehouse
* Track merchandising inventory and keep retail guidance current for the Sales team

**Budget & Process**

* Track marketing spend against plan, report regularly, and recommend priorities to the Brand Director
* Build and improve the workflows, SOPs, templates, and checklists that keep execution consistent

**What You Bring**

* 5 to 7+ years of progressive brand marketing experience in CPG or a similar consumer products industry, including at least 3 years directly managing a brand or portfolio of brands

* A track record of building or growing brands, with specific examples of your decisions and their business impact
* Experience leading product launches from positioning through creative, sales coordination, and post-launch evaluation
* Experience with retail channels, including packaging development, merchandising, and trade marketing
* Experience writing creative briefs and directing creative teams, with good judgment about whether work meets brand goals

* Clear written and verbal communication

jobs.title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
About InSeng Taekwondo

InSeng Taekwondo is a premier Olympic-style Taekwondo school located in downtown Boulder, Colorado. Led by world-class instructors with Olympic and USA National Team coaching experience, we offer high-quality training for beginners, recreational students, and competitive athletes.

Our mission extends beyond martial arts. We believe in developing confident, disciplined, and resilient individuals who become leaders both inside and outside the ring.

In addition to our local programs, we actively participate in and host Taekwondo competitions, seminars, and training events throughout the United States.

We're looking for a creative, motivated individual to help share our story, grow our online presence, and introduce more people to our community.

About the Role

We're seeking a part-time Social Media & Marketing Coordinator to manage our social media presence, create engaging content, and support the growth of our school.

At a minimum, we're looking for someone who can visit our studio a few times per month to capture high-quality photos and videos, create engaging Instagram and Facebook content, and maintain a consistent social media presence.

For candidates with additional experience, this role offers the opportunity to take ownership of broader marketing initiatives, including lead generation, brand development, event promotion, and membership growth.

**We're open to candidates at different experience levels**, from talented student content creators to experienced marketing professionals.

Core Responsibilities — Social Media & Content Creation

* Visit our Boulder studio approximately 2–4 times per month to capture photos and videos of classes, training sessions, athletes, and events.
* Create engaging short-form videos, including Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other video content.
* Manage content creation, scheduling, and publishing across Instagram and Facebook, with opportunities to expand to additional platforms.
* Capture compelling moments that showcase our athletes, instructors, training environment, and community.
* Edit photos and videos into polished, engaging content that reflects our brand.
* Develop creative content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
* Create a balance of athlete highlights, training content, community stories, and promotional material.
* Help maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across our social media channels.
* Monitor social media performance and recommend opportunities to improve engagement and reach.

Travel & Event Coverage Opportunities

InSeng Taekwondo participates in and hosts competitions, training camps, and special events throughout the United States.

Depending on interest, availability, and experience, this position may include opportunities to travel with our team to:

* Capture photography and videography at national and regional Taekwondo competitions.
* Produce behind-the-scenes content featuring athletes, coaches, and tournament experiences.
* Create event recap videos, athlete highlights, and social media coverage.
* Help promote and document tournaments, seminars, and special training events.
* Gain hands-on experience with live sports content production and event marketing.

**Travel is not required for the core position**, but opportunities may be available for candidates interested in sports media, event production, and athletics.

Approved business travel expenses will be covered by InSeng Taekwondo, with compensation and travel arrangements discussed in advance.

Additional Opportunities — Marketing & Business Growth

For candidates with stronger marketing or business development experience, responsibilities may also include:

**Lead Generation & Membership Growth**

* Develop social media campaigns to attract prospective students and families.
* Create strategies that convert social media engagement into trial class bookings and new memberships.
* Assist with responding to and following up with prospective members.
* Track inquiries, trial bookings, and marketing conversions.
* Develop and manage paid advertising campaigns through Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, and other platforms.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

**Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies for InSeng Taekwondo.
* Strengthen our brand identity and messaging across online and offline channels.
* Create promotional campaigns for programs, tournaments, training camps, and community events.
* Design or coordinate flyers, advertisements, and other promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities for local partnerships, community outreach, and cross-promotions.
* Help grow awareness of our school and its programs within Boulder and surrounding communities.
* Develop marketing initiatives that support membership growth and event participation.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Experience creating engaging social media content through professional, personal, or academic projects.
* Ability to capture quality photos and videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Familiarity with Instagram and Facebook content formats, including Reels, Stories, and feed posts.
* Experience editing short-form videos.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar tools.
* Strong communication, creativity, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Availability to visit our Boulder studio several times per month.

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience managing social media accounts for businesses or organizations.
* Photography, videography, or graphic design experience.
* Experience covering sporting events or producing athlete-focused content.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social media advertising, or SEO.
* Experience with lead generation, customer relationship management, or marketing analytics.
* Experience developing marketing campaigns or brand strategies.
* Interest in fitness, athletics

* Develop and maintain marketing calendars, campaign plans, and promotional materials for all locations.
* Provide regular performance reports to the CFOO, including new patient volume trends, referral source analysis, digital marketing metrics, and campaign results.
* Coordinate internal communications, seasonal promotions, and announcements that support clinical team engagement and patient communication.

* Evaluate patients, identify physical impairments, and develop individualized treatment plans.

* Monitor patient progress, modify treatment plans as needed, and document care accurately in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.

**Job Description:**

Hai Hospitality is accepting applications for an experienced **Director of Growth and Digital Marketing** for our Home Office based in Austin, TX. We are an innovative and growing restaurant group, looking for individuals who are creative, ambitious, and passionate about food and people.

  
  

The Director of Growth and Digital Marketing leads measurable guest and revenue growth across Hai Hospitality’s multi-brand, multi-market portfolio. This role owns the growth strategy and performance of paid media, digital discovery, brand websites, online conversion, and marketing activity across third-party ordering platforms. The Director also leads the CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty function through agency support with the future to bring function in-house, connecting acquisition with repeat visits and guest value. This leader turns brand and business priorities into coordinated digital plans, builds clear measurement, and partners closely with Brand Management, Social, Creative Services, Operations, Finance, and agency partners.

  

Reports Directly to: Chief Brand Officer

  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Growth Strategy and Performance Marketing**

* Set the portfolio growth and digital marketing roadmap, translating annual brand plans, market priorities, and openings into measurable channel plans.

* Own paid and performance media strategy, budget allocation, agency/vendor direction, channel mix, audience strategy, testing, and optimization across search, paid social, and relevant platforms.

* Partner with the Head of Social and Content on creative inputs and trafficking for paid campaigns; Growth owns media investment, targeting, placements, testing, and results.

* Build a testing culture that improves incremental revenue, guest acquisition, conversion, return on ad spend, and cost efficiency; distinguish channel attribution from business incrementality where data allows.
  

**Web, search, and digital guest experience**

* Own the portfolio website roadmap and ongoing web redesign, new web launches, and ongoing management, including vendor direction, content publishing workflows, technical health, UX, accessibility, conversion, and online-ordering pathways.

* Lead SEO and local digital discovery strategy, including location pages, listings, review-platform visibility, and tools such as Marqii, establish standards and audit accuracy with Operations and restaurant teams.

* Work with Brand Managers and Creative Services to translate brand positioning and approved creative into useful, current digital experiences.
  

**CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty leadership**

* Lead the CRM, Lifecycle & Loyalty Efforts and agency relationship; set portfolio strategy, priorities, budget, service expectations, and measurement for guest data capture, segmentation, email/SMS, automation, retention, and loyalty.

* Ensure the day-to-day campaign execution, calendar coordination, list health, testing, automation, and loyalty program operations, in partnership with Brand Managers on brand voice, offers, and guest value.

* For Uchi’s 801 program, partner with the Uchi Brand Manager on proposition and brand experience and maintenance of the program.

* Connect acquisition and retention programs through a shared view of guest behavior, repeat rate, frequency, and lifetime value; maintain appropriate consent, data quality, and platform governance.
  

**Third Party and Off Premise Marketing and Leadership:**

* In partnership with Brand Managers, support the marketing and commercial partnership plan for third-party ordering and digital off-premise channels, including platform visibility, sponsored placements, digital merchandising, promotional plans, and marketing partner relationships.

* Analyze sales, traffic, conversion, promotion performance, and channel contribution; recommend investment and growth opportunities with Finance, Operations, and Brand Managers.

Partner with Operations as the accountable owner for delivery execution and economics.  



**Reporting and Optimization**

* Own growth and digital marketing budgets, forecasts, pacing, agency scopes, and vendor performance; coordinate with Finance and FP&A on consistent definitions and reporting.

* Create a concise performance scorecard for leadership and brand teams covering spend, attributed and incremental revenue where available, acquisition cost, conversion, web/search health, CRM contribution, and third-party channel marketing results.

* Turn analysis into clear actions, communicate performance and risks, and build repeatable planning and review rhythms across brands and markets.

* Manage the CRM function and agency partners through clear goals, feedback, prioritization, and accountability.
  

**DESIRED EDUCATION and QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in growth, performance, or digital marketing; experience leading multi-brand, multi-location, hospitality, restaurant, or consumer businesses strongly preferred.

* Demonstrated ownership of paid media budgets and measurable growth outcomes, with strong fluency in analytics, attribution, experimentation, and forecasting.

* Experience with website management, SEO/local search, digital conversion, online ordering or e-commerce, and agency/vendor management.

* Experience leading CRM or lifecycle teams and partnering across brand, creative, social, operations, and finance functions.

* Strong people leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills; able to translate complex performance data into clear recommendations.

* Experience in startup, lean, growth-oriented companies with proven results in building technology, systems, and marketing infrastructure.

* BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Adjunct Assistant Professor of Marketing
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

The Adjunct Assistant Professor of Marketing plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality marketing education to undergraduate and/or graduate students within an academic institution. This position is responsible for designing and delivering engaging course content that reflects current marketing theories, practices, and trends, thereby preparing students for successful careers in the marketing field. The role involves fostering a dynamic and inclusive learning environment that encourages critical thinking, creativity, and practical application of marketing concepts. Additionally, the professor will contribute to curriculum development and collaborate with faculty members to enhance the overall academic program. Ultimately, this position aims to inspire and equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to excel in the evolving marketing landscape while supporting the institution’s mission of academic excellence and student success.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a closely related field from an accredited institution.
* Demonstrated expertise in marketing principles and practices through academic or professional experience.
* Prior teaching experience at the college or university level is preferred but not mandatory.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with diverse student populations.
* Eligibility to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Doctoral degree (Ph.D. or DBA) in Marketing or a related discipline.
* Experience with online or hybrid course delivery platforms and instructional technologies.
* Professional marketing experience in industry sectors such as digital marketing, brand management, or market research.
* Record of scholarly activity or contributions to marketing research and publications.
* Experience mentoring students and supporting their professional development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and deliver course materials for marketing classes, including lectures, assignments, and assessments.
* Engage students through interactive teaching methods and provide timely feedback to support their academic growth.
* Stay current with marketing industry trends and integrate relevant real-world examples into the curriculum.
* Participate in departmental meetings and contribute to curriculum review and development processes.
* Maintain regular office hours to advise and mentor students on academic and career-related matters.

**Skills:**

The required and preferred skills are utilized daily to create an effective and engaging learning environment. Strong communication skills enable clear explanation of complex marketing concepts and foster meaningful interactions with students. Expertise in marketing theory and practice allows the professor to design relevant coursework that bridges academic knowledge with real-world application. Familiarity with instructional technologies supports the delivery of content in various formats, including in-person and online settings. Additionally, interpersonal and mentoring skills are essential for guiding students’ academic progress and career aspirations, ensuring they receive comprehensive support throughout their educational journey.

* Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.

* Advanced analytical, organizational, communication, and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

The position works closely with the QSR Portfolio Manager and collaborates across Sales, Innovation, Insights, Go-to-Market, Marketing Operations, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams. * Support development of a strategic approach to innovation, ensuring the pipeline is aligned with market trends, consumer insights, and AFH’s growth objectives.
* Lead Commercialization of key pipeline initiatives. This includes identifying opportunities, prioritizing projects, and managing the commercialization of new products in line with Kraft Heinz’s broader business objectives.

jobs.title: Amazon Brand Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Amazon Brand Manager with 3+ years of experience to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of client accounts and serving as the primary point of contact for each brand.

You will sit at the center of both execution and strategy. On a daily basis, you will oversee account performance, manage operational workflows, and coordinate with internal teams. At the same time, you will be responsible for identifying opportunities, solving problems, and helping guide long-term growth strategies.

This is a hands-on role that requires a strong understanding of how Amazon operates across both Seller Central and Vendor Central. Success in this position comes from attention to detail, ownership over outcomes, and the ability to translate data into clear, actionable direction.

**What You Will Do**

**Account Management and Client Communication**

* Own the day-to-day management of a portfolio of Amazon accounts across Seller Central and or Vendor Central
* Serve as the primary point of contact for each client, building strong and professional relationships based on trust and performance
* Lead weekly status calls, monthly business reviews, and quarterly strategy sessions
* Prepare structured agendas, present performance insights, and clearly communicate next steps and priorities
* Act as a strategic partner to each brand, ensuring alignment between business goals and Amazon execution

**Strategy and Growth Execution**

* Develop and execute account-level strategies focused on revenue growth, profitability, and long-term brand positioning
* Identify opportunities to improve organic ranking, conversion rates, and overall account efficiency
* Analyze category trends, competitive positioning, and search behavior to inform decision making
* Continuously test and refine strategies based on performance data and marketplace changes

**Listing Optimization and Content Management**

* Own listing quality across accounts, ensuring content has best-in-class standards
* Optimize titles, bullet points, product descriptions, and backend keywords based on keyword research and search performance
* Ensure listings are structured correctly at the parent and child level to maximize visibility and conversion
* Maintain consistency on brand messaging, visual identity, and product positioning

**Performance Tracking and Analysis**

* Monitor KPIs including revenue, sessions, conversion rate, Buy Box percentage, etc.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities early and take proactive action
* Use Amazon reporting and internal analytics to evaluate performance drivers
* Translate data into insights that inform both short-term and long-term actions

**Operations and Issue Resolution**

* Manage case logs and work directly with Seller or Vendor Support to resolve issues
* Handle listing suppressions, stranded inventory, and catalog errors
* Address brand registry concerns, policy violations, and account health risks
* Ensure inventory levels are aligned with demand to avoid stockouts
* Maintain clean and organized account structures to support scalability

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with internal teams including advertising, creative, catalog, etc.
* Ensure all initiatives are executed accurately and on time
* Provide clear direction and feedback to internal teams to improve output quality
* Align all efforts across departments to support unified account strategies

**Process and Documentation**

* Keep detailed documentation including SOPs, playbooks, and performance notes
* Build repeatable processes that improve efficiency and reduce errors
* Contribute to internal system improvements as Commerce Ink continues to scale
* Help establish best practices that can be applied across multiple accounts

**What We Are Looking For**

**Required**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon accounts in Seller Central, Vendor Central, or an agency environment
* Proven ability to manage multiple accounts at the same time without sacrificing quality or responsiveness
* Strong understanding of Amazon fundamentals including listing optimization, advertising basics, brand registry, and account health
* Ability to analyze data and translate it into actionable insights
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead client calls and present performance clearly and confidently
* Familiarity with third-party tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Pacvue, Sellozo, or similar platforms
* Working knowledge of Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance reports, and advanced business reporting
* Experience working in a fast-paced, client-facing agency environment

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### 

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

#### **Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

**You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

jobs.title: Marketing Analytics & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position:** Marketing Analytics & Operations Specialist

**Shift:** Hybrid

**Position Overview:**

ValvTechnologies is seeking a detail-oriented Marketing Analytics & Operations Specialist to help drive data-informed marketing and business decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing, sales, CRM administration, business intelligence, and analytics. The ideal candidate will consolidate marketing and sales data from HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics 365, transform complex datasets into actionable insights, and provide visibility into campaign performance, lead generation, account engagement, and revenue attribution.

The successful candidate will serve as a key resource for marketing reporting, dashboard development, ABM targeting, data quality management, and performance analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain recurring marketing performance reports.
* Analyze campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Measure funnel performance from inquiry through opportunity creation.
* Track and report on marketing-generated pipeline and revenue influence.
* Deliver insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
* Analyze and track Key Performance Indicators from our website and social media.

**CRM & Marketing Technology**

* Serve as a power user of HubSpot and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Monitor data quality, duplicates, lifecycle stages, and reporting accuracy.
* Create and maintain lists, segments, scoring models, and audiences.
* Work with our agency HubSpot partner.

**Dashboard & Business Intelligence Development**

* Design interactive dashboards and reporting tools.
* Build KPI scorecards that provide visibility into:
  + Lead generation
  + Conversion rates
  + Campaign performance
  + Pipeline contribution
  + Customer engagement
  + Forecasting
* Automate reporting where possible to improve efficiency.

**Account-Based Marketing (ABM)**

* Support identification of target accounts.
* Analyze account engagement and campaign performance.
* Develop reporting that measures ABM effectiveness.
* Partner with sales leadership to refine targeting strategies.
* Collaborate with our pipeline digital agency partner.

**Attribution & Performance Measurement**

* Analyze customer journeys and conversion paths.
* Help identify the most effective channels, campaigns, and content assets.

**Sales & Marketing Alignment**

* Collaborate with sales leadership to improve visibility into lead and opportunity progression.
* Assist with lead scoring.
* Support territory, industry, and account analysis.
* Provide ongoing insights to improve marketing and sales effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing operations, CRM administration, or business intelligence.
* Experience working with HubSpot and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 or comparable sales CRM platforms.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills.
* Experience creating dashboards and visualizing data.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power BI.
* Knowledge of marketing attribution models.
* Experience supporting Account-Based Marketing programs.
* Familiarity with B2B industrial manufacturing or technical sales environments.

As a **Marketing Automation & Operations Specialist for our Advanced Surgical division**, you’ll play a critical role in creating email campaigns of all types, building robust landing page experiences and coordinating campaign requests that support multi-channel marketing across the business.

In this role, you’ll help bring order and consistency to campaign execution. You’ll support intake, clarify requirements, track deliverables, coordinate handoffs, and ensure emails, journeys, landing pages, lists, and segments are built accurately, reviewed through the right checkpoints, deployed on time, and aligned to quality, compliance, data, and tracking standards.

This is a strong fit for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, process-minded, and comfortable creating structure where work is moving quickly. The right person will help teams stay aligned, reduce execution friction, and strengthen launch readiness across Advanced Surgical, and beyond.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Supports continuous improvement by identifying repeatable processes, reducing execution friction, and strengthening launch readiness across campaign teams.

**Job Requirements**

**Minimum Requirements**

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply is a strategic, commercially focused role responsible for developing and advancing supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations' position in the luxury travel marketplace. Serving as the primary marketing account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, this position connects meaningful partner relationships with innovative marketing opportunities, measurable commercial outcomes, and sustainable revenue growth.

At the intersection of supplier relationship management, marketing strategy, and commercial development, the Marketing Account Manager – Supply leads partner discovery, annual co-op marketing planning, customized campaign recommendations, presentations, negotiations, and ongoing account engagement. By understanding each partner's objectives, commercial priorities, booking patterns, and destination needs, this role develops thoughtful marketing strategies that create mutual value while reinforcing Classic Vacations' luxury positioning and commitment to its Travel Advisor community.

The role also plays an important collaborative part in supporting Classic's European supplier marketing initiatives. Working alongside the Europe Supply team, the Marketing Account Manager contributes marketing expertise, campaign proposals, pricing and deliverable guidance, presentation development, execution coordination, and performance reporting. This partnership ensures European marketing initiatives benefit from consistent marketing expertise while maintaining clear regional relationship ownership within the Europe Supply organization.

Beyond relationship management, the Marketing Account Manager owns assigned co-op revenue goals, marketing pipeline development, forecasting, contractual coordination, and the successful transition of partner commitments into executable marketing campaigns. Working closely with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance, this role ensures supplier investments translate into well-coordinated initiatives that support advisor engagement, supplier production, and Classic's broader commercial objectives.

This is a relationship-driven, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on bringing people, ideas, and opportunities together. Success requires commercial curiosity, creativity, strong organizational discipline, trusted partnerships, and the ability to influence outcomes across departments through clarity, collaboration, accountability, and shared purpose.

Why This Role Matters

At Classic Vacations, our supplier partnerships are more than business relationships. They are an essential part of how we create extraordinary travel experiences, strengthen our value to Travel Advisors, and bring exceptional destinations, properties, and experiences to life. Behind every successful marketing campaign is an opportunity to connect the right partner, the right message, and the right audience in a way that creates lasting value.

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply helps transform those opportunities into meaningful commercial results. By developing thoughtful, customized co-op marketing strategies, this role ensures that our supplier partners are not simply purchasing advertising placements. They are investing in purposeful campaigns that support their business objectives, reach Classic's Travel Advisor community, and contribute to measurable growth.

Equally important, this role brings clarity and accountability to the relationship between Supply and Marketing. With multiple destinations, suppliers, campaigns, timelines, and financial commitments moving simultaneously, success depends on everyone understanding the priorities, the expectations, and the outcomes we are working toward. The Marketing Account Manager creates that connection, helping teams move from individual responsibilities to coordinated execution.

The position also plays an important role in strengthening Classic's commercial discipline. By maintaining visibility into co-op revenue opportunities, forecasting commitments, coordinating contracts, monitoring campaign performance, and partnering with Finance on billing and reconciliation, the Marketing Account Manager helps ensure that strategic opportunities become accountable business results.

Consistent with Classic's commitment to organizational health, this role demonstrates how trust, clarity, and shared accountability strengthen performance. The Marketing Account Manager leads assigned supplier marketing relationships with confidence while partnering collaboratively with regional Supply leaders, particularly in Europe, where the role contributes specialized marketing expertise in support of established account ownership.

Ultimately, this position helps Classic Vacations create more than successful campaigns. It helps build stronger supplier relationships, more effective marketing investments, greater advisor engagement, and sustainable commercial growth. When our partners succeed, our Travel Advisors gain access to compelling opportunities, our organization becomes stronger, and the Classic® difference becomes even more meaningful.
