jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

**Data architecture & engineering**

* Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
* Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni) reconciled against Salesforce and finance data, and own the analytics behind monthly/quarterly business reviews and QBRs.
* Define and govern a single set of marketing metric definitions (MQL/MQA, SAL, pipeline sourced vs. influenced, CAC, ROI) and drive adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Set and maintain the marketing analytics roadmap: prioritize requests, balance ad hoc work against foundational builds, and communicate trade-offs.

**Data quality, governance & enablement**

* Establish data quality standards and automated checks across CRM, marketing automation, and the warehouse; fix root causes rather than patching symptoms.
* Ensure marketing data and AI use align with Smarsh data privacy, security, and governance requirements in partnership with Legal, Security, and IT.
* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

### **What will you bring?**

* 5+ years of experience in GTM, marketing, or revenue operations analytics, or business intelligence, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
* Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), including designing data models, not just querying them.
* Hands-on dbt experience building production-grade, tested, documented models.
* Experience building or governing a semantic or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni, or a BI-native equivalent).
* Experience with ELT and orchestration tooling (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, or similar).
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, campaign members) and Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform.
* Expert BI skills in at least one major platform (e.g., Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Omni, Hex), including governed, self-serve dashboard design.

jobs.description:
About Future Finance

Future Finance is building the next generation of financial media: a daily newsletter that makes markets, investing, economics, and wealth creation engaging, actionable, and easy to understand for a modern audience.

Our goal is simple: become a daily habit for ambitious professionals who want to become smarter investors and better-informed consumers of financial information.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).
* Load and schedule 5 paid newsletter campaigns per week on Beehiiv.
* Assist with scheduling 1–2 daily email broadcasts for Decentralized Masters.
* Upload provided copy, subject lines, preview text, images, and links.
* Ensure campaigns are sent to the correct audience segments at the correct times.
* Thoroughly QA emails before scheduling, including formatting, links, tracking, segmentation, and send settings.
* Maintain campaign calendars and trackers.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, or potential mistakes before campaigns go live.
* Assist with last-minute scheduling changes when needed.
* Schedule/segment SMS broadcasts as we roll out SMS campaigns

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who You Are

Attention to detail is the #1 priority for this role. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant supervision.

Key qualities:

* Excellent attention to detail: Catches mistakes in links, formatting, targeting, scheduling, Messaging (user experience), etc.
* Ownership and good judgment: Doesn't blindly follow instructions. Proactively flags anything that looks incorrect or unusual and asks questions when needed.
* Reliability: Consistently meets deadlines and ensures campaigns are ready on time.
* Organization: Can manage multiple brands, campaigns, and schedules without letting things slip.
* Ability to follow processes: Comfortable working with SOPs, checklists, and established workflows.
* Proactive communication: Flags blockers early rather than waiting until the last minute.
* Independent execution: Can take responsibility for recurring tasks after training.
* Tech-savvy and trainable: Comfortable learning new software and picking up tools quickly.

Experience Requirements

Prior experience with email marketing platforms is NOT required. We're happy to train the right person.

Experience with ActiveCampaign, Iterable, Beehiiv, or similar email marketing platforms is a plus, but what matters most is being detail-oriented, reliable, tech-savvy, and a fast learner.

What You Won't Be Responsible For

* Writing email copy or subject lines
* Developing email marketing strategies
* Creating offers or promotional campaigns

All copy, creative assets, and campaign instructions will be provided by the marketing team. Your role is to ensure everything is executed correctly.

Availability: Must be available and responsive between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) on working days to coordinate campaign scheduling, handle time-sensitive requests, and make any necessary adjustments.

 **Benefits**  
  
What do we offer

* Competitive salary
* Company offsites
* Remote work
* High ownership, high-impact role

You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

jobs.title: Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
jobs.description:
Designer - Brand & Marketing (Contract to Perm)
===============================================

About Assured Allies
--------------------

Aging well is both a health question and a financial one, yet most people are handed those challenges separately. At Assured Allies, we believe the only way to truly age well is to address both.

We partner with insurance carriers to help their policyholders stay healthier and more independent for longer. Our member program, NeverStop, delivers personalized coaching and simple daily actions that help people take an active role in their health and longevity.

We’re building for two very different audiences: adults in their 60s and 70s who are engaging with NeverStop, and the carrier executives, partners, and investors who work with Assured Allies. Our brands need to feel connected while speaking authentically to each audience.

That’s where you come in.

The Opportunity
---------------

We’re looking for a Brand & Marketing Designer to help define and own how both Assured Allies and NeverStop show up in the world.

On the NeverStop side, you’ll take an evolving brand foundation and extend it across everything outside the product experience—from the marketing website and campaigns to sales materials, email, social, and other member-facing communications.

For Assured Allies, you’ll help shape how the corporate brand evolves alongside NeverStop. You’ll work closely with Marketing and Corporate Development to establish where the two brands connect, where they should be distinct, and how they can feel like part of the same company without becoming interchangeable.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll design, build, and maintain the work yourself, including our marketing websites in Framer. You’ll also create the systems, templates, and standards that enable the broader team to produce high-quality, on-brand work without needing a designer for every request.

We’re particularly interested in someone who understands that designing for older adults requires thoughtful craft: excellent legibility, clarity, accessibility, and warmth—without relying on the clichés or condescension that too often appear in the category.

We’re open to starting with a contract or part-time engagement, with a clear path to full-time. We’re looking for a long-term design partner who wants to take meaningful ownership of the function, not a project-based agency relationship.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Own and evolve the **visual expression** of the Assured Allies and NeverStop brands across marketing and communications.
* Extend NeverStop’s brand system across websites, landing pages, sales materials, email, social, campaigns, and other marketing surfaces.
* Help define and develop the relationship between the NeverStop and Assured Allies brands.
* Design and maintain marketing websites and digital properties, primarily using Framer.
* Create high-quality sales decks, one-pagers, reports, presentations, campaign creative, and executive-facing materials.
* Partner with Marketing and Corporate Development on campaigns, storytelling, presentations, and other high-impact creative work.
* Collaborate with our product designer to ensure member-facing program content remains consistent with the broader NeverStop brand.
* Build and maintain a library of templates, guidelines, and design standards that enable teams to create on-brand materials independently.
* Establish efficient processes for managing multiple design requests and priorities across Marketing, Product, Corporate Development, and leadership.
* Use AI-assisted design and content tools thoughtfully to improve speed and efficiency while maintaining a high bar for quality and brand consistency.
* Bring strong visual and typographic judgment to everything you create.

What You'll Bring
-----------------

* 5+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or visual design, ideally within a technology-focused company.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating range across brand systems, websites and landing pages, presentations, reports, digital content, and campaigns.
* Experience building, evolving, or extending a brand system across multiple channels.
* Strong hands-on web design and implementation skills using a no-code platform such as Framer, Webflow, or a comparable tool. Direct Framer experience is a plus.
* The ability to work comfortably across both B2C and B2B audiences, adapting the visual language and storytelling to each.
* Strong visual, typographic, and systems-oriented design skills.
* Excellent judgment around brand consistency, especially when working across many contributors and touchpoints.
* Experience collaborating directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, resource-conscious environment.
* A thoughtful perspective on designing for older adults, with an appreciation for accessibility, legibility, clarity, and inclusive design.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve creative workflows and production efficiency, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where human craft matters most.
* A high degree of ownership—you’re comfortable identifying what needs to be done and taking it from concept through execution.

### Nice to Have

* Experience in health, wellness, longevity, healthcare, insurance, or a related space.
* Experience with video, motion design, or storyboarding.
* Experience as an early or solo designer at a startup or other resource-constrained environment.
* Experience working across multiple related brands or developing brand architecture.

Compensation & Location
-----------------------

This role is open to starting as a contract or part-time engagement, with a path to full-time based on mutual fit and business needs.

The role is remote within the U.S., with a preference for candidates in the Boston, MA area and consideration for candidates elsewhere on the East Coast.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
**Position Title**: Director, Marketing  
Location: Remote  
Reports To: VP, Marketing  
  
**About PMV Pharma**  
PMV Pharma is a precision oncology company dedicated to transforming the treatment of cancers driven by p53 mutations. Building on more than four decades of groundbreaking p53 research, we are advancing novel small molecule therapies designed to address significant unmet need for patients with cancer.  
  
As we prepare for our first commercial launch, we are building a team of entrepreneurial, collaborative leaders who are energized by the opportunity to help bring an important new therapy to patients and establish the foundation for PMV Pharma's future growth.  
  
**Position Summary**  
The Director, Marketing will play a pivotal role in shaping the U.S. launch of rezatapopt. Reporting to the Vice President, Marketing, this individual will lead healthcare professional (HCP) marketing strategy and execution, helping translate brand strategy into impactful customer engagement, educational initiatives, and launch-ready promotional programs.  
This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to help build commercial capabilities within a growing oncology company preparing for its first product launch. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, strong collaborator, and hands-on leader who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys turning plans into action.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**HCP Strategy & Launch Leadership**

* Lead development and execution of U.S. HCP marketing plans supporting launch readiness and commercialization.
* Drive customer insight generation, segmentation, and engagement strategies across key oncology stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve patient identification, biomarker testing, and treatment adoption.
* Translate market insights, clinical developments, and competitive intelligence into actionable commercial recommendations.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support launch planning, readiness, and execution.

  
**Brand & Customer Engagement**

* Lead development of disease-state and branded messaging, positioning, and promotional strategies.
* Drive creation and execution of HCP promotional campaigns and educational initiatives across personal and digital channels.
* Lead peer-to-peer education programs and other customer engagement activities.
* Partner with Sales to support field readiness and successful deployment of launch resources.
* Monitor performance and optimize programs using customer feedback and data-driven insights.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate closely with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Sales, Insights & Analytics, Regulatory, Legal/Compliance, and agency partners.
* Serve as a key marketing lead supporting launch readiness activities and milestone execution.
* Identify risks, solve problems proactively, and help establish scalable commercial processes as PMV Pharma prepares for commercialization.

  
**Qualifications**  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 8+ years of biopharmaceutical marketing experience, including oncology, hematology, and/or rare disease.
* Experience supporting a U.S. pharmaceutical product launch, including pre-launch planning and HCP strategy development.
* Experience developing HCP messaging, promotional campaigns, and customer engagement programs.
* Strong strategic, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence effectively in a matrix environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in biomarker-driven oncology and an understanding of genomic testing pathways.
* Experience contributing to a company's first commercial launch or commercialization within an emerging biotechnology organization.
* Demonstrated success operating in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where adaptability and ownership are critical.

**Travel:** Ability to travel for business meetings, customer engagements, congresses, and other company activities as needed.  
  
**Salary Range & Benefits**  
The expected salary range for this position is $195K to $250K, representing the potential low and high ends. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors such as experience, skillset, and performance. The salary range listed is just one component of our total compensation package. PMV Pharma also provides a competitive suite of benefits, including health care benefits (medical, prescription drugs, dental, and vision insurance), paid parental leave benefits and adoption assistance, a generous Paid Time Off program, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, rewards and recognition program, and much, much more.  
  
**Living the PMV Values**  
Success at PMV is measured not only by what we achieve, but also by how we achieve it. Employees are expected to:

* Put patients and science at the center of decisions.
* Demonstrate integrity, transparency, and accountability.
* Collaborate across functions with respect and professionalism.

jobs.description:
**A****BOUT ROOTSTOCK**

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.

Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

jobs.description:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.

Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

**Why This Role Exists**

Automotive retail is consolidating, and the groups leading it are choosing the partners they'll run on for the next decade. More of their research now starts inside AI answer engines, and KPA's growth is concentrated in those multi-rooftop groups and in clients who already trust us adding coverage. That calls for a deliberate growth model, not a busier campaign calendar.

This role sets that model. You'd own the vision and strategy for demand generation across the company: the go-to-market model Marketing, Sales, and Client Success run together, the playbook behind it, the plan and investment case for the pipeline number, and the multi-year build-out of the team, technology, and measurement that will carry it at scale. While the team help you run the engine, you decide what it's built to do, where it points, and how big it gets.

*If you've built a demand function before and want to design the next one from the model up, with the mandate to make it the way the whole company grows, this is it.*

**The Role**

The Director, Demand Generation owns KPA's demand strategy and marketing's contribution to lead pipeline and revenue. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer, sit on the marketing leadership team, and lead the demand team and its agency partners.

The mandate runs in order: make the funnel measurable, make the engine repeatable, then scale it. The team is lean, so you'll definitely be hands-on and in the trenches, and will stay close enough to the work to pressure-test it. But your leverage is the model, the people, and the decisions.

Success is measured in pipeline against the company plan, a funnel all commercial functions trust, and an engine that gets more efficient as it grows, with a clear answer to where the next dollar goes and where we should be consistently testing and learning.

**What You'll Do**

**Set the Vision and the Go-to-Market Model**

* Define KPA's demand generation vision and multi-year strategy, and turn it into an annual plan the company aligns to: targets, budget, channel mix, and capacity.
* Design the go-to-market model by segment: single-rooftop dealers, multi-rooftop groups, fleet and adjacent segments; new logo, account-based, and expansion. Decide which plays each gets and what each should return.
* Own the demand playbook as a company standard: the plays, the stage definitions, and the handoffs and service levels between Marketing and Sales (and Client Success). Codify it so it outlasts the current team.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product so every launch has a pipeline plan, not just an announcement.

**Own the Pipeline Number and the Investment Case**

* Own marketing's sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue targets and the forecast behind them. Report against them candidly - including when the number is short.
* Own the demand budget and make the case for it: reverse-funnel models, scenarios, and a defensible return on every line across channels, agencies, events, and technology.
* Represent marketing performance to the executive team and the board with numbers that hold up under questioning.

**Set the Measurement Standard**

* Decide KPA's funnel definitions (lead, MQL, SAL, SQL, opportunity) and attribution approach with Revenue Operations and Sales, align the organization, and hold every team to them.
* Move KPA from counting engagements to counting true net-new demand, and be candid with leadership about what changes when the denominator does.
* Define the reporting the business runs on (pipeline, velocity, CAC, CPL, and payback by segment, motion, and program) and the roadmap to a proper BI layer.

**Build the Engine to Scale**

* Write the multi-year build-out plan: team structure and hiring sequence, what we build in-house versus buy from agencies, and the order in which new capabilities are deployed.
* Set the marketing technology roadmap with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations: what the stack must do at twice our size, what we consolidate, and what we retire.
* Set the operating model for AI in demand gen, including where it helps compound output, where a person stays in the loop, and guardrails on accuracy, claims, brand voice, and data handling that a compliance company can defend.

**Lead the Account-Based and Expansion Strategy**

* Set the strategy for the multi-rooftop groups consolidating the market: tiering, named-account coverage with Sales, and one coordinated marketing and SDR motion against each account.
* Build the expansion strategy with Sales and Client Success. Growing coverage among the more than 15,000 clients who already trust KPA is the largest near-term growth lever we have.
* With the Product, Product Marketing, Consulting, and Revenue Operations, turn KPA's field and incident data into proof the market can see: what our consultants found and the outcomes we helped prevent, stated in numbers.

**Lead the Team and the Partnerships**

* Develop and retain a small team, starting with the Manager, Demand Generation and the Marketing Operations Manager. Set clear ownership, clear numbers, and a high bar for execution.
* Direct the agency roster as the strategy owner with the CMO: set the brief and t

Instrumental is growing, and we are looking for an SEO Specialist to help clients become more discoverable, measurable, and competitive across traditional and AI-powered search.

This is not a traditional marketing role. You will combine search strategy with hands-on technical implementation: auditing websites, improving organic visibility, configuring and validating analytics and conversion tracking, and helping clients understand how people find and engage with their businesses. You will also help clients adapt to AI-driven discovery through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), prompt tracking, and practical visibility measurement.

You will work closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities, make or coordinate improvements, and connect search performance to meaningful business outcomes. The work calls for curiosity, precision, sound judgment, and a willingness to explain technical topics in clear, useful language. Search is changing quickly; we value people who can experiment thoughtfully while keeping the fundamentals strong.

**Who We Are**
--------------

Instrumental is a digital sales and marketing agency based in Golden, Colorado and a proud Elite HubSpot Partner. We partner with growth-minded organizations to build scalable, data-driven marketing and revenue strategies within the HubSpot ecosystem.

We show up unapologetically on our own terms. We lead with authenticity, build real relationships, and deliver exceptional work. There is a bit of Western frontier energy in how we operate. We are self-made, trailblazing, and committed to doing things the right way.

We are not the loudest in the room, but we earn trust quickly. Whether partnering with a Fortune 500 company, a CMO, or a founder building something from scratch, we meet people where they are and lead with a human-first approach. We care deeply about the craft behind a well-built HubSpot solution and the artistry behind a well-told brand story.

Our work speaks for itself. We have earned more HubSpot Impact Awards than any other agency because we stay focused on what matters most, delivering meaningful results that drive real client success. At Instrumental, high standards and strong culture go hand in hand. We support each other, take ownership, and take pride in the impact we create together.

**Who You Are**
---------------

You show up as your authentic self, grounded, prepared, and ready to contribute.

You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and communicate proactively. You ask thoughtful questions, build trust easily, and look for ways to improve both your work and the team around you.

You adapt your approach to meet people where they are, whether working with founders or enterprise-level leaders, without losing your authenticity. You value both discipline and creativity, and you care about doing things the right way.

You are organized, reliable, and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of work. Most importantly, you care about your work, your team, and the impact you are making.

-------------------------

AI is part of how modern teams do great work.

At Instrumental, we expect a baseline of curiosity, initiative, and practical experimentation when it comes to AI. Our team members consistently look for ways to improve how work gets done, whether that means increasing velocity by reducing time to complete a task or elevating excellence by improving the quality, clarity, and usefulness of the outcome.

jobs.description:
At the N2 Company, our vision is "*to be the most respected franchise in the nation, to share stories that build community, and to provide meaningful work for our team".*

**About Us**

The N2 Company is America's leading publisher of community magazines. We're proud of our award-winning media brands – they reach millions of readers in nearly every state and help great businesses connect with ideal clients – but we're even more proud to provide supportive and fulfilling remote work opportunities for our people.

  

**About The Role**

We're looking for a Marketing Campaign Specialist to turn reader interest into meaningful conversations with our Readership Engagement Specialists. You'll create and manage email, text, and social media campaigns that encourage readers to get involved with their community magazines. From building targeted audiences and crafting messages to testing campaigns and tracking results, you'll help turn interest into booked meetings.

Reporting to the Director of Content Operations, you'll work closely with our readership engagement and content teams to coordinate campaigns, support publication needs, and find ways to improve results. Your focus will be generating interest and scheduling conversations, while reader interviews and advertising sales are handled by their respective teams.

This role is fully remote. Interviews for this opening will be conducted over the phone and via video calls. The salary for this position is $50,000-$60,000 annually.

**The Role in Action**

* Create and manage reader outreach campaigns across email, text, and social media using tools like Instantly.
* Organize reader lists by publication and audience while maintaining accurate contact records and honoring consent and opt-out requests.
* Write engaging campaign messages and follow-ups that clearly explain the opportunity and how readers can participate.
* Set up and test campaign schedules, links, forms, and booking pages to ensure everything works properly before launch.
* Track campaign performance and test different audiences, messages, and timing to improve responses and booked meetings.
* Connect interested readers with the right Readership Engagement Specialist and provide the details needed for timely follow-up.
* Work with readership engagement and content teams to review results and improve meeting attendance, reader fit, and story opportunities.
* Maintain campaign settings and documentation, troubleshoot routine issues, and coordinate with Technology or vendors when additional support is needed.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We're looking for someone who will hit the ground running with:

* Experience creating and managing email, text, or social media campaigns.
* Familiarity with Instantly or similar email outreach tools and the ability to learn new platforms.
* Strong writing skills and a basic understanding of audience targeting, campaign testing, and email deliverability.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, reviewing campaign results, and maintaining contact records.
* Attention to detail when managing data accuracy, consent requirements, and opt-out requests.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, communicate clearly with teammates, and troubleshoot common issues.

**Skills and Qualities that Set You Apart:**

* Put readers first with relevant, respectful invitations.
* Own the details and ensure campaigns are ready to launch.
* Keep improving through testing, tracking results, and trying new approaches.
* Support your teammates with clear, helpful handoffs.
* Take ownership of problems and follow through on solutions.

  

### **Benefits Designed with You in Mind**

#### **Health & Wellness**

* Full **health care coverage** for you and your family.
* Complimentary basic **dental coverage**.
* Access to a **licensed nutritionist** to support your health and wellness goals.
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** with complimentary mental health resources and additional support services.

#### **Financial Security**

* **401(k) plan with a company match** to help secure your financial future.
* **Financial planning services** to guide you in achieving your financial goals.
* $7,000 contribution toward the purchase of your first home through our **First-Time Homebuyer Program.**

**Paid Leave**

* **Paid time off**, including a paid, **week-long Holiday Break** each year.
* **Three-week paid sabbatical** after four years of service.
* **Paternal leave**, including twelve weeks of paid maternity leave and two weeks of paid paternity leave.

#### **Remote Work Support**

* **Monthly remote-work reimbursement** to assist with home office and internet expenses.

#### **Additional Benefits**

* **Pet care insurance and discounts** to help support your pets' health and well-being.
* The opportunity to make a difference through **N2GIVES**, our program dedicated to fighting human trafficking and supporting other impactful causes.

  

**Apply Today to Join Our Team!**

At The N2 Company, we believe attitude matters just as much as skills. Our team thrives in a culture built on trust, respect, and humility. We're proud to foster an emotionally healthy, collaborative environment where people genuinely enjoy working together and are passionate about their roles.

We prioritize professional growth and consistently invest in the development of our team members, promoting from within whenever possible. While we take immense pride in the work we do, we believe our culture is what truly sets us apart.

If you're looking for a supportive, drama-free workplace that values both excellence and kindness, we'd love to hear from you. (Brilliant jerks need not apply.)

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
jobs.description:
**About High Camp**
-------------------

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

**Head of Growth & Marketing**
------------------------------

### **About the job**

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you'll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You'll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

### **What you'll do**

* **Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.** Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
* **Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.** Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
* **Lead paid growth strategy.** Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
* **Run creative as a performance lever.** Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
* **Grow organic reach.** Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
* **Own retention and lifecycle.** Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You'll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you'll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
* **Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.** Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
* **Make marketing show up for the whole company.** Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
* **Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.** Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
* **Build the team.** Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

### **Key requirements**

* **Owned the number.** You've owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
* **Came up as an operator.** You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you've since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
* **Proven creative testing**. You've directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
* **Planned around real constraints**. You've forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
* **Retention results.** You've grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
* **Hands-on measurement.** You've run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You're fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer's or agency's plan.
* **Built growth teams.** You've built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
* **Tools.** Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
* **Location:** Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
* **Travel:** Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* You've supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
* Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
* Incrementality testing and media-mix mode

jobs.description:

Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

jobs.title: Acquisition Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.

We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Paid Media Strategist / Account Strategist who can own client accounts from strategy through execution.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical clients
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Solve account issues proactively to support stability and growth

*Meta Campaign Management*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables
* Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
* Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
* Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging

*Tracking & Technical Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results

  
**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Direct-response advertising

How You Work

You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.

You're organized, detail-oriented, and able to move quickly across multiple accounts without losing sight of the outcome. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people sharing responsibility for it.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus
