jobs.title: Social Media Associate
jobs.description:
**About us:**

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested **over $2 billion** in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than **100 countries** and **over 5 million** borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

#### **Kiva's values:**

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

**Role overview:**

The **Social Media Associate** plays a pivotal role in amplifying Kiva’s mission, advancing its brand, and maximizing engagement across digital channels. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive social media strategy that resonates with Kiva’s diverse audiences and supports cross-functional goals.

Partnering closely with the Sr. Manager of Growth and Lifecycle, this individual will oversee day-to-day content planning, creation, and scheduling; leverage data and trends to optimize channel performance; and ensure Kiva’s digital presence is consistent, engaging, and aligned with organizational priorities. With a mix of creativity, data-savviness, and cross-team collaboration, this role ensures Kiva remains at the forefront of digital storytelling and community engagement.

Kiva’s primary social media channels are Instagram & Facebook. Once onboarded, the Social Media Associate will make recommendations for potential channel expansions to YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, TikTok, or others.

This role works closely with the Creative team to plan engaging and informative content to share on our channels. The Social Media Associate will not be expected to design art assets for our channels, although design skills would be a plus.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

**Key responsibilities include:**

**Strategy and Content Management– 40%**

* Help define our strategy for oursocial media profiles, bringing them all into compliance with best practices and recommending a scheduling cadence for each.
* Work with Sr. Manager to build a program to maintain relationships with paid influencers, encouraging organic participation and deepening partnerships.
* Work closely with Sr. Manager to support our paid social media goals through our organic channels and gain efficiencies in content creation across paid and owned social.
* Plan, pitch, and manage the design and copywriting process of new content for our organic social media channels.
* Build organic strategy for expanding to new channels in partnership with Sr. Manager, in service of our growth and lifecycle goals.
* Coordinate with the Creative team Project Manager to source evergreen assets, with the Communications Manager to source Kiva blogs, thought leadership narratives, and impact report assets, and use all content types to build and execute content schedules across platforms.
* Participate in annual marketing campaign planning such as Giving Tuesday and donation drives, adapting campaign content to Kiva’s social media channels.
* Maintain an understanding of each channel’s algorithm changes, ensuring that we adapt our content and strategies as the platforms evolve.
* Keep each social profile organized, up-to-date and presentable, including managing pinned or featured posts, about sections, and developing new content that makes it easy for new users to understand who Kiva is.

**Social Publishing & Scheduling – 30%**

* Serve as the administrator of Kiva’s Sprout social account to manage social media post scheduling, trend tracking, and performance reporting.
* Document planned posts on the Growth & Lifecycle team’s content calendar, ensuring clear communication across our various marketing channels.
* Ensure correct copy, tagging, formatting, links, and accessibility best practices (e.g., alt text).
* Maintain accuracy in publishing calendar and flag gaps or inconsistencies.

**Community Monitoring & Engagement – 10%**

* Monitor Sprout Smart Inbox daily for comments, messages, and mentions.
* Respond to routine inquiries and comments in alignment with brand voice and guidelines.
* Engage with relevant page interactions to support visibility and audience growth.
* Consult with the Communications team when needed to escalate comments or DMs to the correct person at Kiva.

**Performance Reporting – 20%**

* Compile monthly social performance reports across platforms.
* Track core metrics (reach, engagement, follower growth, CTR, top-performing posts).
* Share insights with the Growth & Lifec

jobs.title: Asst./Assoc. Copywriter, Creative Marketing - A&F Co. (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

The role of Assistant or Associate Copywriter on the Abercrombie Kids team will focus on developing creative marketing concepts and copy across weekly emails, site content, paid media, and podcast scripts. The ability to create a concise narrative is required—conveying a fashion perspective that reflects the brand’s effortless and elevated positioning, while resonating with the appropriate audience. In addition to writing, this role collaborates closely with design, strategy and merchandising teams to understand customer insights, ensure accuracy of product priorities and demonstrate brand/product differentiators. Successful candidates will have a relentless passion for fashion as well as for our brands, a strong knowledge of copywriting and applicable experience in marketing, preferably retail. All A&F copywriters must possess near-perfect editing and grammar skills and be able to write succinct, clever, on-brand copy that has a clear point of view and a recognizable voice. The ideal applicant is curious, optimistic and highly collaborative while also maintaining a self-starter mindset.

**What will you be doing?**

* Writing weekly marking emails for abercrombie kids and baby/toddler
* Creating consistent editorial copy and incorporating voice across all touchpoints
* Balancing editorial copy with technical product copy, promo language, navigational copy
* Working closely with seasonal team to ensure follow-through from campaign messaging
* Maintaining constant communication with weekly team to ensure quality and consistency
* Ensuring legal compliance of product claims in copy + meeting customer expectations
* Writing longer-form script copy for podcasts, paid media, and video platforms
* Helping create unique, ownable product names for kids OPM (on-product marketing)
* Writing editorial/romanticized language to define collections and key items on-product
* Staying on top of fashion trends and language, including competitor sites/emails
* Editing copy based on leadership feedback, changes to product, trends, performance, etc.
* Staying curious and up-to-date on fashion trends and industry standard language
* Performing and sharing competitive research with the team to inform copy going forward
* Participating in team collaborations to strengthen the culture, share knowledge and serve as the subject matter expert for email marketing

**What will you need to bring?**

* All A&F copywriters must possess near-perfect editing and grammar skills and be able to write short, smart, snappy copy that has a clear point of view and a recognizable voice
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in English, Creative Writing or Advertising/ Copywriting, or related experience
* Basic knowledge of marketing principles
* A relentless passion for fashion and working knowledge of retail/product terminology
* 1+ years of copywriting experience, preferably retail
* A portfolio showcasing your creative writing, technical ability, relentless attention to detail and grammar proficiency - please include any relevant samples of your work
* Strong written/verbal communication & exceptional editing skills
* Seamless ability to operate autonomously with strong time management skills
* Ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
* Open to constructive criticism in collaborative environments and can quickly action upon
* An ongoing interest in fashion and familiarity with our brand/competitors
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, and Teams is mandatory, experience with Mural, AirTable and Figma is helpful but not required

**Benefits & Perks**

As an Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A&F is committed to providing simple, competitive, and comprehensive benefits that align with our Company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward:

* Incentive bonus program
* 401(K) savings plan with company match
* Annual companywide review process
* Flexible spending accounts
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance
* Associate assistance program
* Paid parental and adoption leave
* Access to fertility and adoption benefits through Carrot
* Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace
* Paid Caregiver Leave
* Mobile Stipend
* Paid time off & one paid volunteer day per year, allowing you to give back to your community
* Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles & six work from anywhere weeks per year)
* Seven associate wellness half days per year
* Onsite fitness center
* Merchandise discount on all of our brands
* Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within
* Access to multiple Associate Resource Groups
* Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

**Company Description**

Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (A&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.

The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie brands and Hollister brands, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. operates stores under these brands across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East, as well as the e-commerce sites abercrombie.com, abercrombiekids.com and hollisterco.com.

Learn more about A&F Co. by visiting our corporate website here.

**ABERCROMBIE & FITCH CO. IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.**

jobs.title: Marketing & Publicity Associate - YA
jobs.description:
Love YA books and talking about them? We’re looking for a rising publishing pro who wants to create compelling campaigns to reach new readers and turn must-read teen books into bestsellers. Sourcebooks, home to award-winning and bestselling children’s books, is looking for a **Marketing and Publicity Associate** to join our dynamic team.  
  
This is a perfect next step for someone currently working at the assistant or coordinator level in publishing who is eager to take on more ownership, creativity, and strategic collaboration. As a Marketing and Publicity Associate, you’ll join marketing and publicity efforts for our YA list across imprints. From long-range campaigns to digital marketing and influencer outreach, you’ll help books thrive in the marketplace and reach readers in meaningful ways.  
  
You’ll gain visibility into every part of the publishing and marketing pipeline, working closely with sales, digital, retail, and editorial teams. You’ll also build strong relationships with authors and the broader children’s book community through events, media placements, and grassroots promotions.  
  
This is an hourly, non-exempt position with a pay range of $23.25 - $25.96. We determine starting pay based on a thorough evaluation of job-related factors, including geographic location, market conditions, relevant experience, training, and education. This process ensures a fair and competitive salary that aligns with both the company and the candidate’s qualifications.  
  
The location for this position can be hybrid or remote in New York or Naperville, Illinois or remote based in any of the following states: Arizona, Connecticut, Illinois, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington D.C., and Wisconsin.  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Create digital content for Sourcebooks frontlist and backlist YA titles
* Support planning and execute social media marketing initiatives
* Own and grow influencer program for mailings, events, and other partnerships
* Coordinate newsletter features
* Represent marketing efforts to authors, help them develop their social media presence and branding
* Develop press materials and pitch for seasonal and round-up opportunities
* Attend select reader conventions throughout the year
* Collaborate with the marketing and publicity teams to form creative, full-rounded campaigns

**What You Bring:**  
We’re looking for someone who’s ready to level up and lead, with a mix of creative vision and tactical execution.

* 2-3+ years of experience in book publishing, digital marketing, publicity, or a related field
* Strong writing skills and confidence in creating engaging social content
* Adept at designing online graphics and using tools such as Canva and Photoshop
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with attention to detail
* Keen understanding of the importance of teen books
* Enthusiasm for collaboration on multi-faceted campaigns
* Comfort presenting your ideas and plans to internal and external partners
* Love for books and belief in their power to change lives

**Why** **Sourcebooks****?**  
As Newsweek’s #2 Most Loved Workplace in 2024 and a recognized leader in innovation by Fast Company (2024 Most Innovative Companies, 2023 Best Workplaces for Innovators), we use a mission-driven, data-centered approach to drive success for our authors and their books. We’re a thriving entrepreneurial company that creates books that transcend categories and defy odds, and we’ve been honored with hundreds of national bestsellers and awards. We are passionate book lovers dedicated to connecting books to readers in innovative ways. Story by story, book by book, we have changed more than 300 million lives. Join us as we change 300 million more!  
  
**Ready to Apply:**  
Please submit your resume, salary requirements, and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in this role. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. Show us your passion and creativity — we’re looking for someone who’s as enthusiastic about this opportunity as we are!  
  
Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program. Our range of benefits include, but are not limited to, Medical/Prescription drug insurance, Dental, Vision, Health Care, Dependent Care, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account 401(k), Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life/AD&D Insurance, & generous paid time off.  
  
Sourcebooks values the array of talents and perspectives that a diverse workforce brings. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

jobs.title: Volunteer Director of Social Media
jobs.description:
**Redeem These Ashes** is seeking a **Volunteer Director of social media.**

**About Redeem These Ashes**  
Redeem These Ashes is a 501C3 nonprofit Christian ministry that emerged from the transformative journey of former Radio Host and Pastor, Joey Krol. After years of battling with pornography, which ultimately led to his arrest for a sex crime, Krol experienced a profound transformation while incarcerated. He found redemption and healing through Christ and dedicated himself to helping others break free from the devastating effects of sexual sin. Today, as a changed man, our Founder ministers to men and their families who have been impacted by this pervasive sin.

**Vision**  
*We envision a society free from the grip of pornography.*

**Mission Statement**  
*Our mission is to educate on the dangers of pornography, advocate for its removal, and offer hope and healing through Jesus Christ, who empowers us to live a life of freedom.*

**What We Do**

* **Free Accountability App:** We are developing *In the Light*, a free app to help individuals remain accountable as they navigate freedom from pornography.
* **Education and Awareness:** Our founder shares his powerful testimony at churches and events, equipping others to find freedom in Christ.
* **Support for Fallen Pastors:** We minister to pastors and ministry leaders who have experienced moral failure, helping them rediscover hope, redemption, and a restored relationship with Christ.

**About the Role**

This is not a simple “post once a day” position. The Volunteer Director of social media provides leadership over Redeem These Ashes’ social media presence and helps shape how our message is communicated online. You will set the strategy, guide content direction, and ensure our platforms consistently reflect our mission and expand our reach. You will lead the team of two.

**The vision for our social platform is simple:** *Tactfully educating on the dangers of sexual sin, celebrate stories of redemption, restoration and hope..and pointing people to Christ.*

You will collaborate with leadership to align messaging with ministry priorities and ensure content is both effective and faithful to our mission.

Key focus areas include:

· Developing and executing a clear social media strategy across platforms

· Creating or overseeing content that educates, encourages, and equips

· Building a consistent brand voice rooted in truth and grace

· Highlighting testimonies, ministry resources, and calls to action

· Monitoring engagement and adjusting strategy based on performance

**Time Commitment**

**Location:** Hybrid office locations include Hebron, KY / Cincinnati, OH and Mt. Juliet / Nashville, TN. Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate (must reside in the U.S.).

**Company Overview**  
Would you enjoy helping a growing national consultancy tell its story, pursue new opportunities, and strengthen how it connects with clients?  
  
Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.  
  
Our marketing function plays an important role in positioning Connico for new work by developing strong proposals, communicating our technical expertise, and supporting business development efforts across our markets.

**The Role**

This is a growth-oriented position for someone who already has a strong proposal and communication foundation and is ready to take on increasing responsibility. You will work closely with our Senior Marketing Specialist, technical professionals, and leadership across proposals and pursuits, opportunity research, project information, marketing content, digital communications, and broader business development support.

**Preferred Experience**

jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

Avalon Healthcare Solutions is the nation’s leader in diagnostic intelligence, uniquely focused on transforming the role of diagnostic testing across the healthcare ecosystem. Our proprietary Diagnostic Insights Platform delivers evidence-based policies, curated lab networks, and real-time analytics that simplify complex diagnostics, accelerate innovation adoption, and optimize diagnostic investments.

Supporting over 30 health plans and 100 million members nationwide, Avalon partners with payers and providers to ensure diagnostic testing is performed appropriately, efficiently, and at the right time. Our flexible solutions span routine and genetic testing management, automated adherence, and end-to-end diagnostics support—driving measurable value, reduced waste, and improved clinical outcomes.

With unmatched scientific rigor, deep clinical expertise, and a performance-based model, Avalon is redefining how diagnostics power personalized care and healthcare value. It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Commerce7: We believe that above price and product, the number one reason why a consumer chooses a brand is customer experience. Customer experiences that are customer-centric lead to loyalty, customer happiness, and ultimately drive sales and profit. Our mission at Commerce7 is to empower wineries with the tools and insights needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences and succeed in DTC.

  

As the **Demand Generation Manage** r at Commerce7, you'll own the pipeline engine for new winery acquisition: building and running the campaigns, outbound programs, and paid strategies that attract, engage, and convert qualified wineries onto the platform. You'll operate inside the Create/Capture/Convert (3C) demand gen framework, working closely with Sales to hit pipeline and demo targets, and with RevOps to act on the attribution and performance data they provide. You bring structure and accountability to demand gen execution — planning campaigns with precision, working from shared pipeline reporting, and continuously improving performance based on what converts.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### 

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

#### **Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

**You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.

*6-month self-employed probation, then a permanent employed role*

Strive Online is a UK Meta-ads agency for trades and home improvement businesses. We run their Facebook and Instagram ads, build their landing pages and send them booked quotes. You’ll run the day-to-day of the agency, so the founder can focus on sales and growth. You’ll own the team, client delivery and the systems that hold it together. This is a hands-on role: you’ll be in the systems, the client data and the team chats, not managing from a distance.

**How the role works**

* **6-month probation:** you work with us on a self-employed basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax and National Insurance.
* **After probation:** you move to a permanent, employed contract with PAYE, holiday pay and a workplace pension.

**What you’ll do**

*Team*

* Manage our media buyer, client success manager, Tech VA, sales setter and video contractors.
* Run team meetings, set priorities and hold people to deadlines.
* Help hire, onboard and train new team members as we grow.

*Client delivery*

* Own client onboarding from signed deal to ads live.

* Track retention and churn, spot at-risk clients early and act before they leave.

* Plan and run our in-person filming service: book videographers, prepare shot lists, brief clients and get footage into editing.

*Commercial*

* Keep an eye on margins, contractor costs and ad account health.

**What we’re looking for**

*Essential*

* At least 2 years in an operations, account management or delivery lead role at a marketing or ads agency.
* Experience managing a small team, including remote or offshore staff.
* Highly organised. You build systems, document everything and nothing falls through the cracks.

* Fully remote working.

* Tracking and reporting on link quality, referring domains, and what’s actually moving rankings, not just volume

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply is a strategic, commercially focused role responsible for developing and advancing supplier-funded marketing partnerships that strengthen Classic Vacations' position in the luxury travel marketplace. Serving as the primary marketing account manager for assigned hotel and tourism board partners across Hawaii, the South Pacific, Asia, Australia, the Americas, and other designated destinations, this position connects meaningful partner relationships with innovative marketing opportunities, measurable commercial outcomes, and sustainable revenue growth.

At the intersection of supplier relationship management, marketing strategy, and commercial development, the Marketing Account Manager – Supply leads partner discovery, annual co-op marketing planning, customized campaign recommendations, presentations, negotiations, and ongoing account engagement. By understanding each partner's objectives, commercial priorities, booking patterns, and destination needs, this role develops thoughtful marketing strategies that create mutual value while reinforcing Classic Vacations' luxury positioning and commitment to its Travel Advisor community.

The role also plays an important collaborative part in supporting Classic's European supplier marketing initiatives. Working alongside the Europe Supply team, the Marketing Account Manager contributes marketing expertise, campaign proposals, pricing and deliverable guidance, presentation development, execution coordination, and performance reporting. This partnership ensures European marketing initiatives benefit from consistent marketing expertise while maintaining clear regional relationship ownership within the Europe Supply organization.

Beyond relationship management, the Marketing Account Manager owns assigned co-op revenue goals, marketing pipeline development, forecasting, contractual coordination, and the successful transition of partner commitments into executable marketing campaigns. Working closely with Supply, Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Creative, Digital, and Finance, this role ensures supplier investments translate into well-coordinated initiatives that support advisor engagement, supplier production, and Classic's broader commercial objectives.

This is a relationship-driven, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on bringing people, ideas, and opportunities together. Success requires commercial curiosity, creativity, strong organizational discipline, trusted partnerships, and the ability to influence outcomes across departments through clarity, collaboration, accountability, and shared purpose.

Why This Role Matters

At Classic Vacations, our supplier partnerships are more than business relationships. They are an essential part of how we create extraordinary travel experiences, strengthen our value to Travel Advisors, and bring exceptional destinations, properties, and experiences to life. Behind every successful marketing campaign is an opportunity to connect the right partner, the right message, and the right audience in a way that creates lasting value.

The Marketing Account Manager – Supply helps transform those opportunities into meaningful commercial results. By developing thoughtful, customized co-op marketing strategies, this role ensures that our supplier partners are not simply purchasing advertising placements. They are investing in purposeful campaigns that support their business objectives, reach Classic's Travel Advisor community, and contribute to measurable growth.

new_jobs.title: Growth Marketing Director
new_jobs.description:
nicity is a health intervention company. We connect people with the products, the app, and the community that together can genuinely change their health — starting with our yerba maté formulated to support fasting and a fibre drink that slows carb absorption at mealtime, brought together in the Feel Great program. Our customers don't just buy a supplement; they start a program that reshapes how they eat, how they feel, and how they live. That means the experience we build — from the first page someone lands on, through checkout, into the app, and across every week after — is what determines whether a customer actually transforms their health or drifts away.  
  
About the Role  
We're hiring a Director of Growth to own the entire e-commerce funnel, acquisition *and* retention - from a customer's first visit through checkout, first-purchase activation, and long-term repeat revenue. You'll lead two initiatives (Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle) and be accountable for how they work as one system rather than two silos handing customers back and forth.  
  
This is a builder-operator role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone with hundreds of reps running structured experiments, who reads a funnel like a P&L, and who has personally shipped the tests, not just approved someone else's roadmap. You'll set the growth strategy and then implement it.  
  
We are in the middle of redefining our tech stack, and you’ll collaborate directly with the Director of Product and Tech Leads to make sure your team has the tools it needs to succeed.  
  
What You'll Own

* The full funnel, as one number. Conversion, AOV, activation, repeat rate, and customer LTV — one connected model, not a web metric and an email metric that never meet. You'll know exactly where visitors drop off across the entire lifecycle and why.
* A high-velocity testing program. Build and run the experimentation engine across landing pages, product pages, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle email/SMS. Prioritize by expected impact, ship weekly, and hold the team to a real read on what won and what didn't. Our traffic comes with high built-in intent rather than from paid ads — so tests have to be designed for the volume and audience we actually have.
* First-purchase acquisition. Maximize the yield of every visit: page experience, offer structure, and first-purchase conversion. Our customers arrive with intent already established, so the job is to convert that intent — not manufacture it.
* Retention and lifecycle. Oversee our email/SMS team, onboarding, activation into the Feel Great app, re-order, winback, and reactivation. Grow repeat revenue and LTV as deliberately as first-purchase conversion.
* The promo and launch calendar. Ship the site pages, offers, and lifecycle flows behind product launches and promotions, coordinating timelines across marketing and design.
* Instrumentation and truth. Own tracking and reporting so the whole company sees the same funnel weekly, and turn it into a visible, prioritized hypothesis backlog. Bring the qualitative "why" — reviews, support tickets, surveys, session replays — because we can't lean on paid-channel data for audience insight.
* The team. Manage, coach, and raise the bar for the employees on the team (currently 4 people across Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle); hire to fill gaps; set the operating cadence (weekly test reviews, roadmap, reporting).

  

What We're Looking For

* 6+ years in growth, CRO, lifecycle, or e-commerce, with 2+ years leading people — ideally at a high-performing DTC or subscription brand.
* A serious testing track record: you can talk through dozens of specific experiments you designed, the hypotheses, and what you learned when they lost.
* Full-funnel range — you've owned or worked hands-on across *both* acquisition/CRO and retention/lifecycle, not just one side.
* Fluency in the numbers: you build your own analysis, size opportunities before you test them, and understand statistical significance well enough to not fool yourself. SQL a strong plus; GA4/analytics and an experimentation tool (Optimizely, VWO, Convert, or similar) expected.
* Comfortable in the tools of the funnel — enough HTML/CSS to unblock a test, and hands-on experience with an ESP/lifecycle platform (Iterable, Klaviyo or similar).
* A leader who stays close to the work — sets direction and still reads the test results line by line.
* Genuine interest in metabolic health, fasting, or wellness is a plus, not a requirement.

  

Nice to Have

* Experience with affiliate-, influencer-, or referral-driven e-commerce (where attribution is different and on-site experience matters more).
* Shopify or comparable platform depth.
* Subscription/re-order or app-activation experience — moving people into a connected digital product, not just re-selling a SKU.
* Experience building a testing culture on a team, not just running tests yourself.

**About the role**  
You will support the lead on SEO and GEO strategy for a portfolio of agency clients, supporting delivery from first audit to reporting. This is a hands-on role for a strategist who can move between keyword research, technical fixes, AI search visibility and one that would grow into more client-facing involvement as your skillset advances. Clients span B2B and B2C, national and local, and regulated and consumer industries, so curiosity and adaptability matter as much as any single tool.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**On-page SEO and content strategy**

* Build content strategies that earn qualified organic traffic and turn it into leads, sales or bookings, not just clicks.
* Map keywords to the right content type and intent, and plan multiple pieces across different areas of a site so each one has a clear job in the buyer journey.
* Recommend on-page changes and page-template updates that give important pages room for richer, more useful content.
* Use internal linking, topical depth and site context to strengthen the pages that matter most.
* Plan content for national, regional or local footprints based on each client's industry and service area, including location pages and Google Business Profile optimization.

**Measurement and reporting**

**What you bring**  
**Must-haves**

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with at least 1 in an agency or multi-client environment.

* Working fluency in Semrush (or Ahrefs), Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and GA4.

**What you’ll get:**

* Remote and hybrid working flexibility
* A wellness subsidy
* A manager who provides consistent 1:1 check-ins, feedback, and growth opportunities
* Culture-building events and cross-team collaboration
* Career advancement opportunities within a growing agency

**What you’ll be a part of:**

* A global team of experts who support each other and strive to achieve excellent results for clients.
* A culture that promotes diversity, work-life balance, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  
**Where will you work?**  
Anywhere in the U.S. We're a remote-first workplace with optional in-office days in Boston, Chicago, Detroit, LA, Nashville, New York, Portland, Washington DC, and more.  
  
**Anticipated Salary:** $70,000 - $85,000

While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to those with whom we have a greater interest.

new_jobs.title: Paid Media Lead
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

Modena Health ("MH") and Modena Allergy & Asthma ("MAA") are leading and rapidly growing medical practices specializing in allergy, asthma, and immunology care, with clinics across Southern California and Arizona—and ambitious plans for national expansion. We are physician-led, hospitality-focused, and technology-enabled, committed to transforming allergy care while advancing clinical research and expanding access to cutting-edge medicine.

Known for our high standard of excellence, we provide compassionate, patient-centered care for both pediatric and adult patients. Our model combines hospitality-driven service with innovative technology solutions that streamline operations, improve clinical outcomes, and enhance the experience for both patients and providers.

At Modena, we aim to hire great people, treat them well, and help them find meaning and purpose in our mission. Our dedicated team values collaboration, positivity, and growth while striving to improve lives through expert diagnosis, treatment, and research. We are looking for high-energy, kind, and collaborative individuals eager to grow personally and professionally while making a meaningful impact in the lives of others.

**About the Role**

This is a hands-on content and social media role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You'll help manage and grow Modena's digital presence across social platforms, create engaging content, support clinic launches and events, and help position Modena as a leading voice in the healthcare space, with a focus on the food allergy space.

You should be equal parts creative and execution-oriented, comfortable developing content ideas one minute and coordinating a shoot or schedule of posts the next.

**What You'll Do**

* Plan, create, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other emerging platforms
* Capture and edit photo/video content in clinics, at events, and with providers/patients
* Develop engaging educational, lifestyle, and behind-the-scenes healthcare content
* Write captions, social copy, blog posts, app content, website/email content, and print marketing materials
* Create a cohesive content calendar that takes into account multiple clinic locations and additional openings throughout the year
* Support new clinic launches, community events, and partnerships
* Collaborate with physicians and leadership to turn medical topics into patient-friendly content
* Monitor social media trends, platform updates, and opportunities for growth
* Assist with influencer/community outreach and local partnerships
* Track engagement metrics and help optimize content performance
* Maintain brand consistency across all digital touchpoints
* Help create and update marketing materials like flyers, banners and program materials

**What We're Looking For**

* 1-2 years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital marketing, or a related role
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and short-form video trends
* Excellent writing and communication skills
* Comfortable filming and editing content on iPhone and/or professional cameras
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar editing tools
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Self-starter mentality with the ability to move quickly and manage multiple projects
* Creative eye for branding, aesthetics, and storytelling
* Comfortable working in a collaborative, startup-like healthcare environment
* Basic graphic design experience

**Pay:** From $65,000.00 per year

### **Physical Requirements**

Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the clinic, if applicable, for extended periods; occasionally lift objects up to 25 lbs., bend, stoop, or reach as needed. Frequent use of hands and fingers for patient care and equipment operation. Must have normal (or corrected) vision and hearing and be able to respond quickly in a fast-paced clinical environment, if applicable.

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and professional development opportunities. Full-time employees are eligible for Modena Health's benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.
  + Paid time off (PTO), sick time, floating holidays, and holiday pay are also available to eligible full-time employees in accordance with company policy.

* Opportunity to shape the future of a thriving allergy and asthma practice in beautiful San Diego (and across our expanding network)
* A supportive, mission-focused culture where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes and team growth

If this role excites you, please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you're passionate about joining our team. We look forward to hearing from enthusiastic candidates ready to drive our success!

**California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Notice**  
Modena Health ("MH") and Modena Allergy & Asthma ("MAA") complies with the California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA"). Personal information provided in the job application process will be collected, used, and retained in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Candidates may request additional information regarding the categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which it is used during the hiring process.

new_jobs.title: Websites & Ecommerce Marketing Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Monin is a global company with more than 100 years of history, but we're always looking for better ways to work, create, and grow. We value collaboration, curiosity, and people who take ownership and make things happen.

  

**About the Opportunity**

Do you enjoy solving problems, improving online shopping experiences, and finding ways to make things work better? Are you detail-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and excited by the opportunity to delight customers and make a measurable impact?

  

We're looking for a proactive, customer-focused Websites & Ecommerce Marketing Specialist to help grow Monin's websites and ecommerce channels. In this role, you'll own day-to-day ecommerce operations, improve customer experiences, analyze performance, and bring digital initiatives to life across our Shopify-based ecommerce ecosystem. You'll work closely with teams across Monin and external partners to solve problems, support business growth, and continuously improve how customers interact with our brand online.

  

**What You'l Do:**

* Website and Ecommerce Management:

* + Own day-to-day operations, performance, and ongoing optimization of assigned websites and ecommerce channels, initially focused on Monin.ca, with responsibilities evolving based on business needs. Monitor website performance, user experience, and site functionality.

* + Partner with developers to investigate, document, prioritize, test, and resolve technical issues and implement enhancements.
  + Ensure content accuracy and compliance with US and Canada laws, policy, and best practices and coordinate with appropriate internal teams and external partners to implement applicable requirements.
* Customer Experience Optimization:
  + Lead personalization, retention and upsell strategic projects, including reviews, search, recommendations, loyalty, subscriptions, gift bundles, to improve customer satisfaction, engagement, product discovery, and sales
  + Implement A/B testing and usability studies to optimize website elements, including landing pages, checkout, and product pages.
  + Serve as the primary ecommerce point of contact for customer service to investigate and resolve issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Data Analysis and Performance Management:
  + Monitor and analyze sales, traffic, conversion, customer behavior, customer experience KPIs to identify trends, risks, opportunities and prioritize action plans for maximizing success and performance improvement.
  + Own monthly ecommerce performance reporting against goals and provide actionable insights and recommendations.
  + Collaborate with internal teams to prioritize actions based on data insights.
* Ecommerce Marketing Execution:
  + Understand and support ecommerce marketing strategies to drive traffic, increase sales, and improve conversion rates.
  + Coordinate and execute website promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and content updates, including setup, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and post-launch monitoring in partnership with communications and other teams.
  + Execute SEO, AEO, GEO improvements in coordination with website developers, communications, content teams.
  + Maintain brand consistency across all ecommerce touchpoints.
* Collaboration and Coordination:
  + Work closely with cross-functional teams, including communications, IT, sales, product, and customer service, to align ecommerce priorities, resolve operational issues, and support overall business goals.
  + Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for external vendors, fulfillment partners, operators and distributors to grow Monin’s ecommerce footprint.
  + Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and cross-functional communications, maintaining project timelines, status updates, and task tracking to ensure timely execution and resolution of issues.

**Your Secret Ingredients**

* Walk in Others' Shoes—You take pride in recognizing and understanding another person's feelings and thoughts.Pay Attention to the Details—Your goal is to get things right the first time.
* Listen to Understand — You give your undivided attention to better understand your tasks.
* Find a Way — You are willing to do whatever it takes to accomplish the job.
  + Look Ahead and Anticipate— You believe preventing issues is better than fixing them.

  

**Other Qualifications & Considerations**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Ecommerce, or related field.
* 2+ years of experience in ecommerce marketing or website management.
* Proficiency in Shopify and ecommerce tools (personalization, search, recommendations, reviews, loyalty, customer support, subscriptions).
* Familiarity with standard web behavior analytics tools
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project management tools (ClickUp preferred)

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Solid understanding of SEO, AEO, GEO, SEM, and ecommerce best practices.
* Proficiency in web analytics tools such as Google Looker, and KPI dashboards.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and web design principles.
* Familiarity with AI marketing tools and emerging ecommerce technologies including: Clerk, Yotpo, Zendesk, Shopify Translate, Adapt, & more.
* Bilingual in English and French.

**What We Offer**— Because Monin hires the best people, we work hard to offer our employees benefits that improve their lives.

  

**The Sweet Stuff:**

* A fun, dynamic working environment with a growing, energetic, and passionate team
* A diverse and inclusive environment where everyone is welcome
* Breakrooms stocked with our delicious products
* Management that uplifts and nurtures talent & provides continuing education
* Promotion of health and wellness
* Company-sponsored fun events

  

**Benefits:**

* A 401(k) plan in which the company matches dollar for dollar

Pivot has four practice areas, including broadband marketing, broadband CX, broadband vendors, and nonprofits.

**Job Summary**  
  
The Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across paid search, social media, and emerging digital channels. **Responsibilities**

* Research, develop, execute, optimize, and analyze paid social and search engine marketing campaigns across multiple ad accounts and platforms, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Nextdoor Ads, MNTN Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other digital advertising platforms.
* Set up, monitor, and analyze conversion tracking for paid advertising campaigns using tools such as Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics.
* Identify, develop, and evaluate social media and search engine marketing strategies based on knowledge of established objectives, market characteristics, and cost factors for B2B and B2C audiences
