* Maintain an understanding of the emerging digital trends as they relate to social media and/or search engine marketing effectiveness
* Develop expertise in generative search optimization (GSO) and AI-powered marketing tools, including understanding how AI platforms like ChatGPT and similar technologies impact search behavior and content strategy
* Develop educational resources for the Pivot team
* Participate in creative brainstorming sessions and contribute to strategy development for digital marketing campaigns and client initiatives.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Excellent understanding of social media platforms, including their respective strengths and demographics (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest, Snapchat, TikTok, Nextdoor, YouTube).
* Ability to navigate both the creative and analytical sides of social media content development and publication
* Knowledge and a foundational understanding of SEO audits, optimization, and reporting are preferred
* Experience working with multiple clients simultaneously
* Strong understanding of customer and market dynamics and requirements
* Proven ability to build strong relationships with clients

* Must be able to work accurately with great attention to detail
* Must be a good communicator, working with other departments that provide services
* Experience with non-profits is a plus

* Ability to encourage and persuade clients to try something new

**About the Team**
------------------

The B2B Growth Marketing team supports DoorDash for Business, Commerce Platform, merchant acquisition, and Ads, with paid media as a key source of growth. We are a small, collaborative team that tests quickly and cares about results as much as we enjoy working together. On the DoorDash for Business side, we help offices, events, and organizations discover a better way to order catering.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring an Associate Manager, Paid Marketing, DoorDash for Business, to run a paid media program from start to finish that accelerates catering growth. You will lead with paid search across Google, Bing, and Performance Max, then expand into Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn, using a consumer-style performance approach with business buyers in mind. Success is measured by customer acquisition cost, cost per acquisition, lifetime value, payback, and conversion rates.

You will report into Senior Manager, Performance marketing on our B2B Growth Marketing team in our Growth Marketing organization.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) and business outcomes of the catering paid media program, including budget, customer acquisition cost, cost per acquisition, lifetime value, and payback.

* Help grow into newer markets for DoorDash for Business and increase market penetration for new products with paid marketing.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We're partnering with a growing beverage company in the Buffalo, NY area on a confidential search for a Senior Marketing Manager. Our client is preparing to bring a new beverage brand to market and needs a hands-on marketing leader to own it from strategy through shelf.

You'll set the brand's direction, run agency partners, steer packaging development, and build the launch activation and marketing plan. This is a build-it role: you'll be the senior marketer in the room, working side by side with operations, R&D, quality, sales, and finance at the client's Buffalo-area facility.

What You'll Do

**Brand Strategy**

* Define and own brand positioning, architecture, target consumer, and value proposition, grounded in consumer, category, and competitive insight.
* Build the annual brand plan, KPIs, and marketing budget; track spend and report on ROI.
* Serve as the brand's guardian, ensuring every touchpoint is consistent with brand identity and standards.

**Agency Relationships**

* Lead creative, design, digital/social, PR, and research agencies: write briefs, run creative reviews, manage scopes, timelines, and budgets.
* Hold agencies accountable to on-strategy, on-time, on-budget delivery; recommend changes to the agency roster as needs evolve.

**Commercialization**

* Partner with Sales and Finance to set pricing, pack/price architecture, channel strategy, and go-to-market priorities.
* Build sell-in materials and selling stories for retail, distributor, and foodservice customers.
* Coordinate the cross-functional launch timeline (stage-gate) from concept to first ship.

**Packaging Development Oversight**

* Own the packaging brief and design process end to end, from concept through final artwork.
* Work with R&D, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and suppliers on structure, materials, labeling and nutrition-panel compliance, and line feasibility.
* Manage artwork approval and routing so packaging is production-ready on schedule.

**Launch Activation & Marketing Plan**

* Build and execute the integrated launch plan: digital, social, influencer, PR, sampling, events, in-store/shopper marketing, and trade programs.
* Set launch success metrics (awareness, trial, velocity, distribution) and report results to leadership.
* Turn post-launch learnings into the ongoing brand and growth plan.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* 7+ years of brand or product marketing experience, including at least 3 years in beverage, food, or CPG.
* Proven experience taking a new product or brand to market, including packaging development.
* Track record of managing creative and marketing agencies and budgets.
* Strong commercial acumen; comfortable with pricing, P&L basics, and retail/distributor sales dynamics.
* Excellent communicator who can influence across operations, sales, and senior leadership.
* **Ability to work onsite at the client's Buffalo, NY-area location five days per week** (see onsite requirement below).
* Occasional travel (about 10–15%) to agencies, customers, and trade events may be required.

**Salary Range: 110-140k**

Pay: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Camco Manufacturing:**
------------------------------

Camco Manufacturing, founded in 1966, has evolved from a humble beginning with one employee and a single product to become a powerhouse in the outdoor recreation market. With a rich history spanning over 50 years, Camco has grown exponentially, boasting a workforce of over 1,000 employees, 140+ patents, and an extensive product line exceeding 5,600 offerings.  
  
The company’s commitment to innovation is evident through its best-in-class, in-house development team, specializing in creating cutting-edge products for the RV, marine, ATV, and other outdoor recreation industries.  
  
Headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina, Camco operates eight separate manufacturing and warehousing facilities encompassing one million square feet. This extensive infrastructure allows Camco to efficiently meet the diverse needs of its customers, solidifying its position as a leading aftermarket parts and accessories manufacturer in the fast-growing outdoor recreation market.  
  
Focused on the RV, Marine, and Camping sectors, Camco’s influence in these industries is significant, as it continues to lead the charge with a relentless pursuit of excellence and a commitment to delivering top-notch products and services.  
  
Our products reach customers nationwide through partnerships with major retailers such as Walmart, Lowe’s, Amazon, and Camping World, alongside a growing network of dealers — giving our Ecommerce team a direct hand in how those products are discovered, purchased, and supported online.

**Location:** Greensboro, NC

**Position Type**: Marketing

**Overview:**
-------------

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Ecommerce Marketing Manager to lead Camco’s digital commerce efforts across our digital ecosystem including: corporate site experience, direct-to-consumer (D2C) strategy, dealer portal support, and product content management (PIM/DAM). This position is ideal for someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution — establishing performance baselines, driving cross-functional projects, and scaling Camco’s ecommerce presence.  
  
This candidate will own the strategy and execution for CAMCO.net, dealer portal marketing support, D2C channel growth, and unified product data across ERP, PIM, and DAM systems, partnering closely with Marketing, IT and Sales to deliver measurable results. A strong analytical mindset, project management discipline, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives are key to success in this role.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Own and execute Camco’s ecommerce strategy across four pillars: corporate site experience, D2C, dealer portal support, and content management (PIM/DAM)
* Conduct full audits of CAMCO.net, the dealer portal, and existing D2C activity to establish KPI baselines for sessions, bounce rate, conversion rate, and revenue
* Lead SEO strategy and execution to grow organic traffic and improve search rankings for priority product categories
* Build and maintain analytics dashboards to track ecommerce performance and report ROI to leadership
* Develop Camco’s direct-to-consumer (D2C) strategy, including consumer journey mapping, email/warranty-based data capture, and D2C revenue tracking
* Partner with the dealer network and internal teams to improve dealer portal self-service capabilities, including ordering, product lookup, account management, and warranty/claims support
* Support dealer marketing programs, including co-branded assets, seasonal campaigns, and new product alerts
* Lead product information and digital asset management (PIM/DAM) initiatives — auditing product data, closing content gaps, and coordinating with retail partners such as Amazon and Walmart on enriched product content
* Collaborate cross-functionally with IT, Sales, and Marketing to align data flows between ERP, PIM, DAM, and ecommerce/retailer channels
* Stay current on ecommerce, SEO, and digital commerce trends and the competitive landscape

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Ecommerce, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or D2C strategy roles
* Proven experience with SEO, web analytics (Google Analytics), and building performance dashboards
* Experience with PIM/DAM platforms and product data management is a strong plus
* Familiarity with B2B dealer/distributor portals or B2B2C business models is a plus
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with IT, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and reporting skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Compensation and Benefits:**
------------------------------

* We offer a wide range of career opportunities with excellent benefits. Above all, we are looking for passionate, talented, hard-working, nice people with great taste to help us build this brand we love.
* Competitive salary
* 401k with company match
* Participation in company health (medical, dental) insurance plans. Supplemental insurance offered
* Promote work/life balance including paid time off and paid holidays
* Flexible schedule options available

*Camco is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.*

new_jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Associate Director of Marketing

**REPORTS TO:** Executive Director of Marketing

**EXPECTED SALARY RANGE:** $65,000 – 75,000; plus The University of Vermont Foundation’s progressive benefits package, which includes a comprehensive health plan; dental, vision, and life insurance; a robust paid time off package; a 403(b) plan with immediate vesting and contributions; and tuition remission.

**EFFECTIVE DATE:** November 15, 2026, or a mutually agreed-upon start date

**FTE:** Full-Time

**LOCATION:** Burlington, Vermont

**JOB-TYPE/HOURS:** Hybrid. The UVM Foundation operates on a 3-2 hybrid schedule which allows employees to work 2 days per week from a local remote location. Specific schedules are discussed with and approved by supervisors.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Associate Director of Marketing for Digital Communication Platforms manages the organization's website, email marketing, and text messaging platforms to advance the philanthropic and alumni engagement missions of the UVM Foundation and UVM Alumni Association. This role serves as the organization's primary subject matter expert for digital communications platforms, ensuring content is strategic, audience-focused, data-informed, and aligned with organizational goals.

Reporting to the Executive Director of Marketing, the Associate Director is responsible for the administration, optimization, governance, and ongoing enhancement of the Foundation's digital communication channels, including the website, email marketing platform, and texting platform. The position provides strategic guidance and technical support to colleagues across the organization while leveraging analytics and best practices to improve engagement, user experience, and campaign performance.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**40%** Manage, Update, and Optimize the UVM Foundation website

* Serve as primary administrator for the UVM Foundation website, overseeing content updates, site structure, accuracy, functionality, accessibility, and user experience while aligning with brand standards.
* Collaborate with marketing colleagues and content owners across the organization to create, update, and publish website content across the organization.
* Monitor website performance and user behavior using Google Analytics and platform reporting tools; collect data and provide recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Lead ongoing efforts to enhance website usability, accessibility, search engine optimization (SEO), and overall user experience.
* Develop and maintain website governance processes, content standards, workflows, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, donation pathways, event registration experiences, and other high-priority user journeys.
* Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with vendors or technical partners as needed to ensure optimal platform performance.

**40%** Manage, Maintain, and Optimize Email Marketing

* Serve as primary administrator and subject matter expert for the organization's email marketing platform.
* Develop and maintain email marketing standards, templates, processes, and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Build and deploy email communications and sequences while providing guidance and strategic support to staff responsible for creating and sending their own messages.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Brand Manager for our Pallas Textiles division who will work from KI’s Corporate Office in Green Bay, Wisconsin. This position is responsible for shaping and elevating the Pallas brand through strategic marketing, compelling storytelling, and innovative product positioning. This role develops and executes integrated marketing initiatives that bring textile collections to life, translating design inspiration, color stories, and brand vision into meaningful customer experiences. Working closely with the VP of Pallas, design, sales, and cross-functional teams, the Brand Manager drives brand strategy, product launches, portfolio positioning, and marketing campaigns that strengthen brand awareness, support business growth, and deepen engagement within the commercial design community. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and creative marketer who thrives at the intersection of design, branding, and relationship-driven collaboration.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring the Pallas brand and collections to life through compelling storytelling, visual content, and customer experiences.
* Lead the creation of marketing campaigns, product launches, and content strategies across digital, print, social, and industry channels.
* Partner closely with designers to translate collection inspiration, color stories, and creative vision into impactful market positioning and brand narratives.
* Drive the development of product imagery, catalogs, sales tools, and branded marketing materials that support customer engagement and sales growth.
* Own and evolve the Pallas brand strategy, ensuring a consistent and distinctive brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
* Collaborate with sales, leadership, operations, and external partners to align marketing initiatives with business objectives and product launches.
* Transform customer, sales, and market insights into compelling product positioning and portfolio strategies that strengthen market relevance.
* Lead major brand initiatives from concept through execution, managing timelines, priorities, resources, and deliverables.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging design influences to identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and continuously refine strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and market impact.

What you Need to Succeed
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field.
* 5-7 year’ experience in marketing, brand management or related role, preferably in the design/creative industry.
* Proven experience in developing and executing brand strategies that drive business growth.
* Strong leadership and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Creative thinker with a keen eye for design and detail.
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools, content management systems, graphic design software, and analytics platforms.

What KI Offers You
  

* Participation in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): As an employee, you will have stock ownership in the company.
* Competitive Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for your well-being.
* A 401(k) Plan with Company Match: A retirement savings plan with employer contributions.
* Paid Vacation, Sick Days, & Holidays: Time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones.
* Wellness Resources: Access to an on-site fitness center, fitness reimbursement program, and on-site nurse.
* Onsite Cafe: Enjoy a full breakfast and lunch menu right at work.
* Employee Product Discounts: Special pricing on company products.
* Educational Reimbursement Program: Support for degree programs and certifications.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Job Type: [Full-Time]**

**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and creative Marketing Coordinator to join our team. This individual will oversee the development and execution of marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility and drive customer engagement. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, a keen eye for detail, and a passion for the culinary industry. Additionally, the Marketing Coordinator will take on creative director responsibilities, guiding the overall visual and thematic direction of marketing materials and content.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Strategic Planning**

* **Market Research**: Analyze industry trends, customer preferences, and competitor strategies. Conduct surveys or focus groups to gather insights.
* **Target Audience Identification**: Define customer personas based on demographics, psychographics, and dining behaviors.
* **Marketing Goals**: Establish short-term and long-term marketing objectives (e.g., increase brand awareness, boost sales by X%, launch a new menu).

**2. Brand Management**

* **Brand Development**: Ensure brand consistency across all restaurant locations. Create brand guidelines for logos, colors, and tone of voice.
* **Reputation Management**: Monitor online reviews and social media presence. Engage with customers and address their concerns promptly.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* **Website Management**: Optimize the restaurant group’s website for user experience and SEO. Ensure menus, locations, and promotions are updated.
* **Social Media Strategy**: Develop a content calendar for platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Post engaging content, including behind-the-scenes, promotions, and user-generated content.
* **Email Marketing**: Create newsletters to inform customers about upcoming events, new dishes, and special offers. Segment the audience for personalized campaigns.

**4. Content Creation**

* **Visual and Written Content**: Produce high-quality content for various platforms, including blog posts, social media updates, videos, and promotional materials. Ensure all content aligns with brand voice and strategy.
* **Creative Development**: Lead the creative direction for marketing materials, including ad videos and detailed flyers. Collaborate with designers, videographers, and copywriters to create compelling content that resonates with the target audience.

**5. Promotional Campaigns**

* **Seasonal Promotions**: Plan and execute seasonal campaigns (e.g., holiday specials, summer menus). Collaborate with chefs to create unique offerings.
* **Loyalty Programs**: Develop a loyalty program to encourage repeat business. Use customer data to tailor rewards and promotions.
* **Events and Collaborations**: Organize events, such as tastings, cooking classes, or partnerships with local businesses (e.g., breweries, farms).

**6. Advertising**

* **Media Planning**: Identify appropriate channels for advertising (online, print, radio). Allocate budget effectively.
* **Creative Development**: Oversee the production of compelling ads that resonate with the target audience, ensuring alignment with overall marketing strategy.

**7. Analytics and Reporting**

* **Performance Metrics**: Track KPIs such as customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value, and social media engagement.
* **Regular Reporting**: Prepare monthly/quarterly reports on marketing performance. Analyze what worked and what didn’t and adjust strategies accordingly.

**8. Collaboration and Team Management**

* **Cross-Department Collaboration**: Work closely with the culinary team to ensure promotions align with menu offerings. Collaborate with operations to maintain service quality during promotional periods.

**Example Campaign Ideas**

* **“Taste of the Month”**: Feature a different dish each month, highlighting local ingredients.
* **Social Media Challenges**: Encourage customers to post their dining experiences with a specific hashtag for a chance to win a gift card.
* **Community Involvement**: Partner with local charities for fundraising events, offering a percentage of sales on specific days.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Opportunities for professional development.
* Employee discounts at restaurant locations

A Proposal Specialist supports the process of business development for their firm segment by creating opportunity-specific marketing materials (proposals, quals, or presentations), researching clients and prospects, and identifying promotional opportunities to reach intended audiences.  
  
Please include a cover letter that demonstrates your writing ability and a resume that demonstrates your graphic design ability. Including a portfolio of graphic design and layout experience is a plus.

**Duties:**

* In coordination with the Pursuit Manager, searches for RFPs and channels them to appropriate firm audiences.  
  Participates in pre-proposal & pre-interview planning with technical teams to help develop and apply the established win strategy.
* Coordinates, writes, edits and produces pursuit marketing materials (qualifications packages, proposals, presentations/interviews, etc.) with minimal oversight  
  Solicits and coordinates information from sub consultants and other team members for inclusion in proposal and presentation materials.
* Participates in pre-interview planning and presentation rehearsal and provides coaching as necessary  
  Gathers, formats and maintains accurate, up-to-date segment marketing information including staff bios, project descriptions and statistics, and other information for marketing purposes.
* Researches target opportunities as directed, sharing relevant information with other teams as required  
  Engages Content Strategists to capture opportunities for award submissions, case studies, photography, or other ways to “package” segment expertise.
* Collaborates with the Brand Manager on the development of standard collateral and marketing pieces for segment’s audiences.
* Identifies and manages opportunities for tradeshows, industry events, speaking engagements, or other advertising and sponsorships that reach segment’s target audiences.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design or similar
* 3+ years of experience in A/E/C marketing or business development
* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Office, and CRM systems (Deltek Vantagepoint preferred)
* Travel as required to build positive working relationships with stakeholders
* Excellent time management, project management, and presentation skills

Salary Range: $50,000 - $85,000

The specific salary offered may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate's relevant experience, education, and work location.

Director of Sales & Marketing

**Full-Service Conference Hotel | Midwest, USA**

**Company:** Blue Horse Management Inc.  
**Position:** Director of Sales & Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Leadership Position  
**Location:** Midwest, United States  
**Industry:** Hospitality | Full-Service Hotel | Conference & Events

Position Overview

Blue Horse Management Inc. is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Director of Sales & Marketing** to lead revenue growth, business development, group sales, and marketing initiatives for a full-service conference hotel in the Midwest.

We are looking for an accomplished hospitality sales professional with a **proven track record at major hotel brands, extensive conference hotel experience, and a demonstrated history of career stability and long-term professional commitment.**

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in generating corporate, association, government, SMERF, and group business while maximizing revenue opportunities from guest rooms, meetings, conferences, banquets, catering, and food and beverage operations.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for an individual who understands that successful hotel sales require consistent prospecting, relationship building, strategic account management, and measurable results.

**We are seeking a sales leader who can build business, not simply manage incoming leads.**

* Proactively generate new business through direct sales calls, outside sales visits, networking, prospecting, and strategic partnerships.
* Develop strategies to improve weekday corporate demand, weekend group business, and shoulder-period occupancy.
* Collaborate with the General Manager and Revenue Management team to optimize pricing, group displacement decisions, and revenue opportunities.

Conference, Group & Catering Sales

* Negotiate group contracts, corporate agreements, and event packages while protecting hotel profitability.
* Coordinate closely with banquet, catering, food and beverage, and hotel operations teams to ensure successful execution of contracted events.
* Identify repeat-business opportunities and develop long-term relationships with high-value accounts.
* Monitor group booking pace, definite and tentative business, conversion rates, and future booking opportunities.

Business Development & Market Positioning

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with major employers, chambers of commerce, convention and visitors bureaus, universities, hospitals, government agencies, and regional organizations.
* Identify demand generators, upcoming developments, major events, and business opportunities within the market.
* Develop and maintain a strategic account portfolio with clear production goals.
* Represent the hotel at trade shows, industry events, networking functions, and community business meetings.
* Develop partnerships that increase hotel visibility and position the property as a preferred destination for meetings, conferences, and accommodations.

Marketing & Brand Management

* Develop and implement marketing strategies consistent with the hotel's brand standards and overall business objectives.
* Oversee digital marketing initiatives, including website visibility, social media, email campaigns, and targeted promotions.
* Leverage major hotel brand distribution channels, loyalty programs, national sales resources, and marketing platforms to increase demand.
* Coordinate promotional campaigns for corporate travel, group business, conferences, catering, and special events.
* Monitor online reputation, guest feedback, and competitive positioning in partnership with hotel leadership.
* Evaluate marketing expenditures and measure return on investment.

Sales Systems, Reporting & Accountability

* Maintain accurate and timely sales activity records, account production, and business opportunities within the hotel's CRM and sales management systems.
* Prepare weekly sales activity reports, monthly production reports, forecasts, and quarterly business reviews.
* Track key performance indicators, including:
* Group room nights and revenue production
* Corporate negotiated account production
* Conference and meeting space revenue
* Catering and banquet revenue
* Sales pipeline and lead conversion
* Booking pace and future group business
* ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, and market share
* Analyze STR reports, competitive market performance, and business trends to identify revenue opportunities.
* Ensure accurate forecasting, effective account management, and disciplined follow-up on all sales leads.

* Lead, coach, and develop sales team members while fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Conduct regular sales meetings, pipeline reviews, and performance evaluations.

new_jobs.title: Brand Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Brand Manager**

**Farmer Group | Cortland, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in office) | Full-time, Exempt**

**Pay range:** $65,000 to $85,000 per year

**About Us**

Farmer Group is a fast-growing cannabis company and the home of five in-house brands: Florist Farms, Head & Heal, Blotter, Tune, and Hudson. We take pride in being a legitimate, well-run company in an industry where that's often missing, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an organized, collaborative Brand Manager to bring our brands to life. Reporting to the Brand Director, you'll turn brand priorities into well-run projects. You'll work closely with Sales, Creative, Product Development, and Production to deliver the materials and support our teams need.

The role combines marketing project management, brand content, retail merchandising, and vendor coordination. If you like bringing structure to a busy environment, communicate clearly, and see projects through from first brief to final delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll DoBrand Execution & Project Management**

* Lead brand initiatives and product launches, turning business needs into clear briefs, timelines, and deliverables
* Own the shared marketing calendar for launches, promotions, events, and merchandising, and plan around creative and production lead times
* Run multiple projects across teams. Keep owners, deadlines, and priorities visible, and flag blockers early
* Partner with Sales to develop marketing materials and sales tools that support our retail accounts
* Coordinate label copy and product information between the Print Shop and Creative so labels are approved on time
* Support Product Development as new products move toward launch
* Coordinate brand materials and logistics for trade shows, retail activations, and events
* Keep tasks, approvals, and handoffs current in Asana

**Content & Brand Assets**

* Write and coordinate product copy, strain descriptions, promotional emails, catalogs, and educational materials in each brand's voice
* Route creative, product information, and claims to the right reviewers before release
* Maintain an organized library of approved brand assets and media kits

**Retail Merchandising, Swag & Vendors**

* Write briefs for packaging updates, retail merchandising, swag, and staff merchandise
* Manage vendor relationships, balancing quality, cost, and timelines
* Oversee sourcing, samples, purchase orders, and delivery with Accounting and Warehouse
* Track merchandising inventory and keep retail guidance current for the Sales team

**Budget & Process**

* Track marketing spend against plan, report regularly, and recommend priorities to the Brand Director
* Build and improve the workflows, SOPs, templates, and checklists that keep execution consistent

**What You Bring**

* 5 to 7+ years of progressive brand marketing experience in CPG or a similar consumer products industry, including at least 3 years directly managing a brand or portfolio of brands
* Experience owning brand strategy, annual plans, and marketing budgets
* A track record of building or growing brands, with specific examples of your decisions and their business impact
* Experience leading product launches from positioning through creative, sales coordination, and post-launch evaluation
* Experience with retail channels, including packaging development, merchandising, and trade marketing
* Experience writing creative briefs and directing creative teams, with good judgment about whether work meets brand goals
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple brands, deadlines, and partners
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Proficiency with Asana or similar tools, email platforms, website and ecommerce content, spreadsheets, and digital asset libraries
* Familiarity with AI tools for content or workflow support, used with careful review

*Cannabis experience is welcome but not required.*

**What We Value**

* **Selfless Collaboration:** We work as one team and step up for one another.
* **Data-Driven, Nimble Problem Solvers:** We're curious and flexible, and we let data guide our decisions.
* **Real Integrity:** We build trust through honesty and consistency.
* **Driven, Passionate Innovators:** We love what we do and keep looking for ways to improve.
* **Positive Mindset:** We bring energy, humor, and resilience.
* **We Are a Real Company:** Structure keeps us accountable and helps us succeed.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Gym membership
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cortland, NY 13045

new_jobs.title: Social Media & Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
About InSeng Taekwondo

InSeng Taekwondo is a premier Olympic-style Taekwondo school located in downtown Boulder, Colorado. Led by world-class instructors with Olympic and USA National Team coaching experience, we offer high-quality training for beginners, recreational students, and competitive athletes.

Our mission extends beyond martial arts. We believe in developing confident, disciplined, and resilient individuals who become leaders both inside and outside the ring.

In addition to our local programs, we actively participate in and host Taekwondo competitions, seminars, and training events throughout the United States.

We're looking for a creative, motivated individual to help share our story, grow our online presence, and introduce more people to our community.

About the Role

We're seeking a part-time Social Media & Marketing Coordinator to manage our social media presence, create engaging content, and support the growth of our school.

At a minimum, we're looking for someone who can visit our studio a few times per month to capture high-quality photos and videos, create engaging Instagram and Facebook content, and maintain a consistent social media presence.

For candidates with additional experience, this role offers the opportunity to take ownership of broader marketing initiatives, including lead generation, brand development, event promotion, and membership growth.

**We're open to candidates at different experience levels**, from talented student content creators to experienced marketing professionals.

Core Responsibilities — Social Media & Content Creation

* Visit our Boulder studio approximately 2–4 times per month to capture photos and videos of classes, training sessions, athletes, and events.
* Create engaging short-form videos, including Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other video content.
* Manage content creation, scheduling, and publishing across Instagram and Facebook, with opportunities to expand to additional platforms.
* Capture compelling moments that showcase our athletes, instructors, training environment, and community.
* Edit photos and videos into polished, engaging content that reflects our brand.
* Develop creative content ideas and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
* Create a balance of athlete highlights, training content, community stories, and promotional material.
* Help maintain a consistent brand identity and voice across our social media channels.
* Monitor social media performance and recommend opportunities to improve engagement and reach.

Travel & Event Coverage Opportunities

InSeng Taekwondo participates in and hosts competitions, training camps, and special events throughout the United States.

Depending on interest, availability, and experience, this position may include opportunities to travel with our team to:

* Capture photography and videography at national and regional Taekwondo competitions.
* Produce behind-the-scenes content featuring athletes, coaches, and tournament experiences.
* Create event recap videos, athlete highlights, and social media coverage.
* Help promote and document tournaments, seminars, and special training events.
* Gain hands-on experience with live sports content production and event marketing.

**Travel is not required for the core position**, but opportunities may be available for candidates interested in sports media, event production, and athletics.

Approved business travel expenses will be covered by InSeng Taekwondo, with compensation and travel arrangements discussed in advance.

Additional Opportunities — Marketing & Business Growth

For candidates with stronger marketing or business development experience, responsibilities may also include:

**Lead Generation & Membership Growth**

* Develop social media campaigns to attract prospective students and families.
* Create strategies that convert social media engagement into trial class bookings and new memberships.
* Assist with responding to and following up with prospective members.
* Track inquiries, trial bookings, and marketing conversions.
* Develop and manage paid advertising campaigns through Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, and other platforms.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

**Marketing & Brand Management**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies for InSeng Taekwondo.
* Strengthen our brand identity and messaging across online and offline channels.
* Create promotional campaigns for programs, tournaments, training camps, and community events.
* Design or coordinate flyers, advertisements, and other promotional materials.
* Identify opportunities for local partnerships, community outreach, and cross-promotions.
* Help grow awareness of our school and its programs within Boulder and surrounding communities.
* Develop marketing initiatives that support membership growth and event participation.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Experience creating engaging social media content through professional, personal, or academic projects.
* Ability to capture quality photos and videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Familiarity with Instagram and Facebook content formats, including Reels, Stories, and feed posts.
* Experience editing short-form videos.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar tools.
* Strong communication, creativity, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Availability to visit our Boulder studio several times per month.

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience managing social media accounts for businesses or organizations.
* Photography, videography, or graphic design experience.
* Experience covering sporting events or producing athlete-focused content.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social media advertising, or SEO.
* Experience with lead generation, customer relationship management, or marketing analytics.
* Experience developing marketing campaigns or brand strategies.
* Interest in fitness, athletics

new_jobs.description:

The Director of Growth and Digital Marketing leads measurable guest and revenue growth across Hai Hospitality’s multi-brand, multi-market portfolio. This role owns the growth strategy and performance of paid media, digital discovery, brand websites, online conversion, and marketing activity across third-party ordering platforms. The Director also leads the CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty function through agency support with the future to bring function in-house, connecting acquisition with repeat visits and guest value. This leader turns brand and business priorities into coordinated digital plans, builds clear measurement, and partners closely with Brand Management, Social, Creative Services, Operations, Finance, and agency partners.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Growth Strategy and Performance Marketing**

* Set the portfolio growth and digital marketing roadmap, translating annual brand plans, market priorities, and openings into measurable channel plans.

* Own paid and performance media strategy, budget allocation, agency/vendor direction, channel mix, audience strategy, testing, and optimization across search, paid social, and relevant platforms.

* Partner with the Head of Social and Content on creative inputs and trafficking for paid campaigns; Growth owns media investment, targeting, placements, testing, and results.

* Build a testing culture that improves incremental revenue, guest acquisition, conversion, return on ad spend, and cost efficiency; distinguish channel attribution from business incrementality where data allows.
  

**Web, search, and digital guest experience**

* Own the portfolio website roadmap and ongoing web redesign, new web launches, and ongoing management, including vendor direction, content publishing workflows, technical health, UX, accessibility, conversion, and online-ordering pathways.

* Lead SEO and local digital discovery strategy, including location pages, listings, review-platform visibility, and tools such as Marqii, establish standards and audit accuracy with Operations and restaurant teams.

* Work with Brand Managers and Creative Services to translate brand positioning and approved creative into useful, current digital experiences.
  

**CRM, lifecycle, and loyalty leadership**

* Lead the CRM, Lifecycle & Loyalty Efforts and agency relationship; set portfolio strategy, priorities, budget, service expectations, and measurement for guest data capture, segmentation, email/SMS, automation, retention, and loyalty.

* Ensure the day-to-day campaign execution, calendar coordination, list health, testing, automation, and loyalty program operations, in partnership with Brand Managers on brand voice, offers, and guest value.

* For Uchi’s 801 program, partner with the Uchi Brand Manager on proposition and brand experience and maintenance of the program.

* Connect acquisition and retention programs through a shared view of guest behavior, repeat rate, frequency, and lifetime value; maintain appropriate consent, data quality, and platform governance.
  

**Third Party and Off Premise Marketing and Leadership:**

* In partnership with Brand Managers, support the marketing and commercial partnership plan for third-party ordering and digital off-premise channels, including platform visibility, sponsored placements, digital merchandising, promotional plans, and marketing partner relationships.

* Manage the CRM function and agency partners through clear goals, feedback, prioritization, and accountability.
  

**DESIRED EDUCATION and QUALIFICATIONS**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in growth, performance, or digital marketing; experience leading multi-brand, multi-location, hospitality, restaurant, or consumer businesses strongly preferred.

* Demonstrated ownership of paid media budgets and measurable growth outcomes, with strong fluency in analytics, attribution, experimentation, and forecasting.

* Experience with website management, SEO/local search, digital conversion, online ordering or e-commerce, and agency/vendor management.

* Experience leading CRM or lifecycle teams and partnering across brand, creative, social, operations, and finance functions.

new_jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### 

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

#### **Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

**You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

new_jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### 

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

#### **Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

**You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.

* Mentor analysts and Marketing Operations teammates on SQL, dbt, data modeling, and responsible use of AI in analytics.

We're not going to out-spend our way to an audience. We're going to out-think, out-create, and out-connect everyone else in this space.

The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented assistant to support the day-to-day execution of our email marketing campaigns across multiple brands.

This is primarily an execution and operations role, not a copywriting or strategy role. Your responsibility will be to ensure campaigns are loaded, checked, scheduled, and sent accurately and on time.

* Load and schedule 7 Future Finance campaigns per week on ActiveCampaign / Iterable (free newsletter).

**Requirements**

What do we offer

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually

new_jobs.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus
