new_jobs.title: Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
***ABOUT GO CAR WASH***

GO Car Wash opened its first tunnel in 2019 with one goal: to create a better car wash experience rooted in community, powered by people, and built on trust. Today, we're one of the fastest-growing car wash companies in the country, with 156 sites across 10 states — and we're just getting started. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and built on five core values: teamwork, integrity, caring, fun, and continuous improvement. We're looking for people who are energized by growth, take pride in their work, and genuinely enjoy the ride.

***POSITION:*** Marketing Operations Manager
  
***POSITION REPORTS TO:*** Chief Marketing Officer

***LOCATION:*** Remote position with up to 15% travel within the US. Preferred locations include Kansas City, New York, Austin, and San Antonio due to travel requirements and proximity to major airports. Candidates must reside in Kansas, Missouri, New York, or Texas.

***JOB DESCRIPTION***  
The Marketing Operations Manager is the engine behind GO's marketing team — the person who makes things happen. You'll own the coordination, execution, and follow-through that keep campaigns, field programs, and launches running on time and on brand. This role touches everything: cross-functional teams, vendors, field operators, and leadership. The ideal candidate doesn't wait to be told what to do — they figure out what needs to happen and make it happen. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving problems in a fast-moving environment, this role was built for you.

***WHO THRIVES HERE***  
This role works best for someone who's energized by variety, comfortable switching from a vendor call to a field escalation to a creative review — sometimes all before lunch. You'll have real autonomy and ownership, but you'll also need to build trust quickly across teams that move fast. If you do your best work when you have clear problems to solve and the freedom to solve them your way, you'll fit right in here.

***JOB RESPONSIBILITIES***  
PROJECT MANAGEMENT & EXECUTION

* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, launch schedules, and implementation recommendations.
* Coordinate execution across Marketing, Operations, Customer Experience, vendors, and field teams.
* Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, and milestones across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Ensure projects move from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Maintain visibility into project status and proactively communicate updates.
* Spot problems before they become fires and come to the table with solutions, not just flags.

FIELD MARKETING SUPPORT

* Serve as the primary marketing contact for field teams.
* Navigate signage requirements, print production, and compliance considerations across multiple states and markets.
* Ensure field teams receive marketing materials and communications prior to launch.
* Keep field teams informed on request status, delivery timelines, and next steps.
* Support grand openings, local marketing programs, community partnerships, and promotional events.

MARKETING OPERATIONS

* Manage marketing systems, workflows, and operational processes.
* Maintain marketing calendars, launch schedules, and execution guides.
* Oversee print portals, ordering processes, field resource libraries, and operational marketing tools.
* Keep marketing materials, assets, and resources organized and easy for field teams to find and use.
* Build and continuously improve the processes that keep the marketing team running smoothly.

AGENCY & VENDOR MANAGEMENT

* Develop clear project briefs and requirements.
* Manage agency and vendor budgets, timelines, deliverables, and approvals.
* Hold deliverables to a high standard — reviewing for quality, accuracy, and launch readiness before anything goes out the door.
* Ensure external partners operate as an extension of the marketing team.

LOCAL LISTINGS & DIGITAL PRESENCE

* Own the accuracy of local listings and digital presence across 156+ sites.
* Coordinate updates to local SEO platforms and business listings.
* Support execution of local digital initiatives and campaigns.
* Drive platform adoption across the organization and follow through until it sticks.

REPORTING & ANALYSIS

* Track campaign execution and project performance.
* Monitor marketing budgets, invoices, and vendor spending.
* Turn data into clear, actionable reporting that gives leadership visibility into what's working and what needs attention.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, execution, and field support processes.

***WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE***

* Campaigns, promotions, and field initiatives launch on time and as planned.
* Field teams feel supported, informed, and set up for success before every launch.
* Project timelines, dependencies, and risks are actively managed.
* Leadership has visibility into project status and key milestones.
* Vendors and agencies are managed effectively and held accountable to deliverables.
* Problems never come as surprises — they come with a recommended solution already in hand.
* Projects move forward through ownership and initiative rather than waiting for direction.

***QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS***

* 3–5 years of marketing, marketing operations, project management, or related experience.

new_jobs.title: Technical Marketing, Growth Manager
new_jobs.description:
**A****BOUT ROOTSTOCK**

Rootstock Software builds Cloud ERP for manufacturers, distributors, and supply chain teams, native to the Salesforce Platform. Our customers run inventory, production, and supply chain operations on Rootstock, and we are investing heavily in AI across the product and our go-to-market.

**THE ROLE**

We are hiring a technical, hands-on marketer to own paid acquisition and the growth engine behind roughly half of our top-of-funnel pipeline.

This role is built around budget ownership. You will run hundreds of thousands of dollars in Google Ads and AdRoll spend, decide where every dollar goes, and scale what works. You will also be the builder behind it: shipping pages, experiments, and automation in Claude Code, and running technical SEO, without waiting on an engineering queue.

It is a great fit for a digital or growth marketer a few years into their career who already owns paid budgets and leans technical, or for an associate-level consultant who has run strategy and execution for clients and wants to own it in-house.

***This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.***  
*Please, no agencies/recruiters.*

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Own paid performance.** Run Google Ads and AdRoll against our ICP terms and target accounts, scale spend into the hundreds of thousands, and make incremental spend decisions backed by data.
* **Drive technical SEO and conversion.** Find which terms and accounts convert to MQLs, run constant experiments, and grow top-of-funnel conversion week over week.
* **Build in Claude Code.** Ship and iterate on web pages, integrations, and automation that power the growth engine.
* **Measure what works.** Track performance across every channel, build the reporting you need to make spend decisions, and present results to leadership with confidence.
* **Shape AI and review-site discoverability.** Manage our presence on G2 and similar review sites, including how Rootstock gets surfaced and recommended by AI tools.
* **Support content and campaigns.** Contribute to case studies, sales enablement collateral, and persona-basedoutbound email and LinkedIn sequences as needed.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

The profile below is what we would like to see, but we are open to the right candidate. Strong analytical ability, theability to learn quickly, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and contribute from day one matter more thanchecking every box.

* Ideally 3 to 5 years in growth, digital, paid, or performance marketing at a startup or B2B software company, or in an associate-level consulting role focused on marketing strategy and execution
* Direct ownership of ad spend and paid budgets in Google Ads, AdRoll, or similar, with accountability for results
* A technical, builder mindset: you are already experimenting with Claude Code or similar AI tools, and you are comfortable with automation, spreadsheets, SQL, or scripting
* Technical SEO experience, including keyword strategy and conversion optimization
* An analytical brain: you make spend decisions from data, not instinct
* A scrappy, high-ownership approach; you are comfortable running many experiments at once and grinding through the daily numbers
* Executive presence: you can own a number that matters to leadership and communicate results clearl

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Agency, consulting, or freelance experience managing paid budgets across multiple clients
* A founder or first-marketing-hire background at a startup
* Experience with ERP, supply chain, inventory, or manufacturing software
* Incrementality or A/B testing on paid channels
* Experience with G2 or other product review platforms
* Familiarity with Salesforce or Hubspot

**FIRST 90 DAYS**

The headline goal: scale our digital ad investment and prove it pays off.

* **Day 30:** Audit current paid, SEO, and conversion performance, learn the ICP and target accounts, and get your reporting baseline in place.
* **Day 60:** Launch your first wave of experiments across Google Ads, AdRoll, and technical SEO, and start reallocating spend toward what converts.
* **Day 90:** Run a scaled, measurable ad program with a clear line from spend to MQLs, and a roadmap for what you will build next.

**STEP 1:** Hiring Managers  
**STEP 2**: BDR Manager  
**STEP 3**: Sales Leadership  
**STEP 4:** CRO/Executive  
**STEP 5:** Case study/Panel interview

* **Location**: Remote, US-based
* **Work Authorization:** This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Rootstock is not able to sponsor, extend, or transfer work visas for this position now or in the future — this includes but is not limited to H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, and OPT/STEM OPT extensions. Candidates who will require sponsorship at any point during their employment will not be considered.

Base pay offered is based on market location and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

new_jobs.title: Director, Demand Generation
new_jobs.description:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.

Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

**Why This Role Exists**

Automotive retail is consolidating, and the groups leading it are choosing the partners they'll run on for the next decade. More of their research now starts inside AI answer engines, and KPA's growth is concentrated in those multi-rooftop groups and in clients who already trust us adding coverage. That calls for a deliberate growth model, not a busier campaign calendar.

This role sets that model. You'd own the vision and strategy for demand generation across the company: the go-to-market model Marketing, Sales, and Client Success run together, the playbook behind it, the plan and investment case for the pipeline number, and the multi-year build-out of the team, technology, and measurement that will carry it at scale. While the team help you run the engine, you decide what it's built to do, where it points, and how big it gets.

*If you've built a demand function before and want to design the next one from the model up, with the mandate to make it the way the whole company grows, this is it.*

**The Role**

The Director, Demand Generation owns KPA's demand strategy and marketing's contribution to lead pipeline and revenue. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer, sit on the marketing leadership team, and lead the demand team and its agency partners.

The mandate runs in order: make the funnel measurable, make the engine repeatable, then scale it. The team is lean, so you'll definitely be hands-on and in the trenches, and will stay close enough to the work to pressure-test it. But your leverage is the model, the people, and the decisions.

Success is measured in pipeline against the company plan, a funnel all commercial functions trust, and an engine that gets more efficient as it grows, with a clear answer to where the next dollar goes and where we should be consistently testing and learning.

**What You'll Do**

**Set the Vision and the Go-to-Market Model**

* Define KPA's demand generation vision and multi-year strategy, and turn it into an annual plan the company aligns to: targets, budget, channel mix, and capacity.
* Design the go-to-market model by segment: single-rooftop dealers, multi-rooftop groups, fleet and adjacent segments; new logo, account-based, and expansion. Decide which plays each gets and what each should return.
* Own the demand playbook as a company standard: the plays, the stage definitions, and the handoffs and service levels between Marketing and Sales (and Client Success). Codify it so it outlasts the current team.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product so every launch has a pipeline plan, not just an announcement.

**Own the Pipeline Number and the Investment Case**

* Own marketing's sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue targets and the forecast behind them. Report against them candidly - including when the number is short.
* Own the demand budget and make the case for it: reverse-funnel models, scenarios, and a defensible return on every line across channels, agencies, events, and technology.
* Represent marketing performance to the executive team and the board with numbers that hold up under questioning.

**Set the Measurement Standard**

* Decide KPA's funnel definitions (lead, MQL, SAL, SQL, opportunity) and attribution approach with Revenue Operations and Sales, align the organization, and hold every team to them.
* Move KPA from counting engagements to counting true net-new demand, and be candid with leadership about what changes when the denominator does.
* Define the reporting the business runs on (pipeline, velocity, CAC, CPL, and payback by segment, motion, and program) and the roadmap to a proper BI layer.

**Build the Engine to Scale**

* Write the multi-year build-out plan: team structure and hiring sequence, what we build in-house versus buy from agencies, and the order in which new capabilities are deployed.
* Set the marketing technology roadmap with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations: what the stack must do at twice our size, what we consolidate, and what we retire.
* Set the operating model for AI in demand gen, including where it helps compound output, where a person stays in the loop, and guardrails on accuracy, claims, brand voice, and data handling that a compliance company can defend.

**Lead the Account-Based and Expansion Strategy**

* Set the strategy for the multi-rooftop groups consolidating the market: tiering, named-account coverage with Sales, and one coordinated marketing and SDR motion against each account.
* Build the expansion strategy with Sales and Client Success. Growing coverage among the more than 15,000 clients who already trust KPA is the largest near-term growth lever we have.
* With the Product, Product Marketing, Consulting, and Revenue Operations, turn KPA's field and incident data into proof the market can see: what our consultants found and the outcomes we helped prevent, stated in numbers.

**Lead the Team and the Partnerships**

* Develop and retain a small team, starting with the Manager, Demand Generation and the Marketing Operations Manager. Set clear ownership, clear numbers, and a high bar for execution.
* Direct the agency roster as the strategy owner with the CMO: set the brief and t

new_jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Head of Growth & Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**About High Camp**
-------------------

High Camp was born from a love of craft cocktails and the great outdoors. What began as a Kickstarter campaign has grown into a brand known for premium, beautifully designed products that are built to last and made to share.

We design Fortified Barware for people who care about what they pour, wherever they pour it. We make it easy to craft and carry your favorite drinks everywhere from the backyard to the backcountry.

We're a lean team that has grown primarily through a strong direct-to-consumer business. Now we're building toward true omni-channel growth across DTC, wholesale/B2B, corporate gifting, and marketplaces. This hire is one of the most important seats in the company.

**Head of Growth & Marketing**
------------------------------

### **About the job**

As Head of Growth & Marketing, you'll own High Camp's acquisition, retention, and revenue performance across our direct-to-consumer business, our largest revenue channel, while supporting marketing needs across the broader company. You'll lead our creative and performance marketing team, translate brand direction into marketing that performs across every channel, and oversee the partners and systems that power growth and e-commerce. This role is a deliberate middle ground between a pure growth operator and a CMO: strong growth fundamentals come first, with enough marketing range to serve the whole company.

This role reports to our CEO & you'll lead an in-house team across creative, performance, and organic, and direct a roster of agency and contract partners covering media buying, email and SMS, video and design, web development, and emerging channels. You'll own a seven-figure media budget, the partner relationships behind it, and the decisions about how this capability is resourced as we scale.

### **What you'll do**

* **Own DTC growth and e-commerce performance.** Hold the DTC revenue target and contribution margin, not just top-line revenue. Whoever executes the work, the outcome sits with you.
* **Partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting.** Build the annual and peak-season paid media budget and an inventory-aware DTC forecast, set efficiency targets, and review performance against plan regularly.
* **Lead paid growth strategy.** Own risk analysis and go/no-go calls on paid and marketplace spend, using incrementality testing to know where the next marginal dollar earns the most.
* **Run creative as a performance lever.** Direct our in-house creative team and creative vendors, and build the creative testing program and creator/UGC pipeline that feed paid performance.
* **Grow organic reach.** Set direction for social, PR, affiliates and brand partnerships, and make sure they build demand that paid and retention can convert.
* **Own retention and lifecycle.** Set email and SMS strategy, calendar and LTV goals, and own the repeat purchase and LTV targets that come with them. You'll work through a mix of in-house and partner resources, and you'll shape how that mix evolves as the business scales.
* **Own go-to-market, launches and promotions.** Plan launches around when product actually lands and around wholesale and corporate timelines, own the promotional calendar, and translate brand direction from the founders into channel execution.
* **Make marketing show up for the whole company.** Make sure the content engine produces assets our wholesale and corporate custom teams can use, and that paid supports where DTC and B2B overlap, like corporate gifting in Q4. When channels compete for the same product, creative or spend, make the call that's right for the company.
* **Own the analytics and marketing tech stack.** Make sure tracking and reporting can be trusted, decide what to keep or retire, and direct the technical resources who run it.
* **Build the team.** Shape the growth and marketing functions as the business scales, deciding what to build in-house and what to contract or partner. We expect AI and automation to be a real part of that answer, so the function grows on leverage rather than headcount alone.

### **Key requirements**

* **Owned the number.** You've owned a DTC P&L or contribution margin line at a brand doing $20M or more, and can describe the efficiency targets you were accountable for.
* **Came up as an operator.** You started as a media buyer or close to it, and you've since managed media buyers or agencies rather than only executing buys yourself.
* **Proven creative testing**. You've directed a creative team or vendors producing high-volume, fast-iteration content, and built a testing or creator/UGC program whose results changed where spend went.
* **Planned around real constraints**. You've forecast demand where supply was limited (long lead times, seasonal peaks, constrained launches) and adjusted spend to match.
* **Retention results.** You've grown repeat purchase or LTV through email and SMS, including work with outside partners.
* **Hands-on measurement.** You've run a tracking or analytics implementation and can walk us through it. You're fluent in growth math (MER, CAC, contribution margin, incrementality) and can pressure-test any buyer's or agency's plan.
* **Built growth teams.** You've built and led growth teams, decided when to hire, contract or partner, and directed technical or e-commerce platform resources.
* **Tools.** Deep Shopify literacy, hands-on with Meta, Google and TikTok ads, and working knowledge of modern attribution tools.
* **Location:** Remote-friendly across the U.S., with hybrid co-working options available in Bozeman, MT; San Rafael, CA; or Golden, CO.
* **Travel:** Two team retreat/collaboration trips per year to a hub location, plus 2–3 additional business trips per year as needed.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* You've supported B2B, wholesale, retail or corporate gifting alongside DTC.
* Experience on both sides of the agency table, or running an agency selection or transition.
* Incrementality testing and media-mix mode

new_jobs.title: Paid Media Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Location  
Fully Remote

Schedule  
Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours - Monday to Friday, US Eastern business hours. In South Africa that is roughly 3pm to 11pm, and 4pm to midnight from November to March.

Compensation  
$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month, based on experience, with review at 90 days

Reports to  
Chief Marketing Officer

Engagement type  
Full-time independent contractor

**About RevSpark Media**  
RevSpark Media is a performance marketing agency built for healthcare and franchise brands. We're based in the US, specializing in health and medical clients, including men's health clinics, compounding pharmacies, med spas, and wellness practices. We build brand awareness and lead generation systems that turn qualified prospects into booked patients and customers.

**About the Role**  
As our Paid Media Strategist, you'll own the strategic and testing side of paid media across our client portfolio. You'll design the tests, define what success looks like before anything launches, call the results, and bring ideas for what we should be trying next. You'll work closely with our Meta and Google media buyers, setting the standards they execute against and providing technical direction on structure, targeting, and tracking. The buyers own their campaigns day to day. You own the methodology behind them and the strategic thinking that makes them better. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thinks in tests and systems, not just campaigns. When an account needs it, you will get inside it yourself and diagnose the problem, not only set standards for others.

**Your First Focus**  
Much of our portfolio is a multi-location franchise network. Every location runs similar campaigns inside its own strict geographic territory, and every owner sets their own budget. Your first priority is Google efficiency across that network: finding where spend is wasted, diagnosing the locations that are underperforming, and turning what works in one territory into tests for the others.

**What You'll Do**  
**Testing Strategy**

* Design tests with a clear baseline, success metric, timeline, and decision point before launch.
* Call tests won, lost, or inconclusive, and communicate the reasoning.
* Maintain test documentation so results are traceable and repeatable across clients.
* Bring new testing ideas and hypotheses to the table, not just evaluate existing ones.

**Account Structure and Quality Standards**

* Set standards for Google account structure: match type strategy, negative keyword management, brand search handling, conversion tracking.
* Set standards for Meta: campaign architecture, audience hygiene, naming conventions, pixel and CAPI integrity.
* Audit accounts against those standards on a defined cadence.
* Catch tracking and attribution issues before they affect reporting accuracy.

**Strategic Direction**

* Provide technical direction to media buyers on structure, targeting, and bidding and budget approach.
* Review campaign builds against defined standards before launch.
* Recommend how each owner's budget should split across Google and Meta, and where to push or pull back, always within that owner's budget and territory.
* Share what's working across the portfolio so wins on one account inform others.

**Performance Analysis**

* Review performance across the portfolio to spot patterns individual accounts won't show.
* Partner with media buyers on diagnosis when an account needs a second set of eyes.
* Surface at-risk accounts early with a recommendation attached.
* Look past lead volume to lead quality, so spend goes toward leads that become booked patients.

**Client Support, As Needed**

* Join client calls that require senior paid media depth, particularly technical reviews and performance deep dives.
* Explain methodology, structure decisions, and test results to client-side stakeholders.

**Why Work With Us**

* Real ownership of testing strategy across a full portfolio, not one account.
* Work with capable, experienced media buyers on Meta and Google, plus designers, copywriters and account managers, so you are never a one-person team.
* Direct access to the CMO and influence over how we approach paid media.
* Variety across healthcare and franchise brands, including multi-location and territory-constrained accounts.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads at an agency or multi-account level.
* Demonstrated ability to structure and evaluate performance tests, not just run campaigns.
* Deep familiarity with Google account structure: match types, negative keywords, brand search, conversion tracking.
* A track record of bringing down Google cost per conversion in small or constrained geographic markets.
* Experience with conversion tracking and server-side event tracking, including Meta CAPI.
* Comfortable working across multiple ad accounts simultaneously.
* Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both non-technical stakeholders and sophisticated client-side counterparts.
* Strong written communication and documentation habits.

**Nice to have**

* Health, medical, or wellness advertising experience and familiarity with the associated compliance landscape.
* Experience with franchise or multi-location advertising, including geographic territory constraints.
* Familiarity with GoHighLevel.
* Experience mentoring or giving direction to other media buyers.

new_jobs.title: Acquisition Marketing Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.

We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Paid Media Strategist / Account Strategist who can own client accounts from strategy through execution.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical clients
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Solve account issues proactively to support stability and growth

*Meta Campaign Management*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables
* Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
* Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
* Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging

*Tracking & Technical Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results

  
**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Direct-response advertising

How You Work

You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.

You're organized, detail-oriented, and able to move quickly across multiple accounts without losing sight of the outcome. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people sharing responsibility for it.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Social Media Associate
new_jobs.description:
**About us:**

Kiva is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested **over $2 billion** in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than **100 countries** and **over 5 million** borrowers

As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.

#### **Kiva's values:**

Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.

Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.

Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.

Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.

Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.

Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.

**Role overview:**

The **Social Media Associate** plays a pivotal role in amplifying Kiva’s mission, advancing its brand, and maximizing engagement across digital channels. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive social media strategy that resonates with Kiva’s diverse audiences and supports cross-functional goals.

Partnering closely with the Sr. Manager of Growth and Lifecycle, this individual will oversee day-to-day content planning, creation, and scheduling; leverage data and trends to optimize channel performance; and ensure Kiva’s digital presence is consistent, engaging, and aligned with organizational priorities. With a mix of creativity, data-savviness, and cross-team collaboration, this role ensures Kiva remains at the forefront of digital storytelling and community engagement.

Kiva’s primary social media channels are Instagram & Facebook. Once onboarded, the Social Media Associate will make recommendations for potential channel expansions to YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, TikTok, or others.

This role works closely with the Creative team to plan engaging and informative content to share on our channels. The Social Media Associate will not be expected to design art assets for our channels, although design skills would be a plus.

At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately we cannot provide visa sponsorship.

**Key responsibilities include:**

**Strategy and Content Management– 40%**

* Help define our strategy for oursocial media profiles, bringing them all into compliance with best practices and recommending a scheduling cadence for each.
* Work with Sr. Manager to build a program to maintain relationships with paid influencers, encouraging organic participation and deepening partnerships.
* Work closely with Sr. Manager to support our paid social media goals through our organic channels and gain efficiencies in content creation across paid and owned social.
* Plan, pitch, and manage the design and copywriting process of new content for our organic social media channels.
* Build organic strategy for expanding to new channels in partnership with Sr. Manager, in service of our growth and lifecycle goals.
* Coordinate with the Creative team Project Manager to source evergreen assets, with the Communications Manager to source Kiva blogs, thought leadership narratives, and impact report assets, and use all content types to build and execute content schedules across platforms.
* Participate in annual marketing campaign planning such as Giving Tuesday and donation drives, adapting campaign content to Kiva’s social media channels.
* Maintain an understanding of each channel’s algorithm changes, ensuring that we adapt our content and strategies as the platforms evolve.
* Keep each social profile organized, up-to-date and presentable, including managing pinned or featured posts, about sections, and developing new content that makes it easy for new users to understand who Kiva is.

**Social Publishing & Scheduling – 30%**

* Serve as the administrator of Kiva’s Sprout social account to manage social media post scheduling, trend tracking, and performance reporting.
* Document planned posts on the Growth & Lifecycle team’s content calendar, ensuring clear communication across our various marketing channels.
* Ensure correct copy, tagging, formatting, links, and accessibility best practices (e.g., alt text).
* Maintain accuracy in publishing calendar and flag gaps or inconsistencies.

**Community Monitoring & Engagement – 10%**

* Monitor Sprout Smart Inbox daily for comments, messages, and mentions.
* Respond to routine inquiries and comments in alignment with brand voice and guidelines.
* Engage with relevant page interactions to support visibility and audience growth.
* Consult with the Communications team when needed to escalate comments or DMs to the correct person at Kiva.

**Performance Reporting – 20%**

* Compile monthly social performance reports across platforms.
* Track core metrics (reach, engagement, follower growth, CTR, top-performing posts).
* Share insights with the Growth & Lifec

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

new_jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Performance marketing agency experience
* Direct-response advertising

**NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)** Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays

* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Performance Bonus

new_jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.  
  
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

#### 

#### **The Role**

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You'll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You'll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You'll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you've turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You'll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

  

#### **You Will**

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

* Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
* Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
* Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
* Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
* Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
* Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
* Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
* Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

#### **Day-to-day:**

* Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
* Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
* Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
* Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
* Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
* Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
* Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

  

**You Have**

* Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
* Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
* Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
* Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
* AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
* Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
* Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. ==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**Data Management & Availability**

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.

* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.

**About Firework**

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

**Summary**

We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Operations & Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the systems, automation, and processes that power our global go-to-market team.

Salesforce will be at the center of your work. You will own its ongoing architecture, development, and optimization, ensuring it evolves with the business and helps our global sales team operate effectively. You will also manage HubSpot and marketing automation, develop custom integrations, and build AI agents that improve productivity across sales and marketing.

This role is ideal for someone with startup experience who combines strong technical skills with a practical understanding of how sales and marketing teams generate pipeline, convert opportunities, and drive revenue.

### **What you'll be doing**

**Own and scale Sales Operations**

* Own Salesforce architecture, administration, development, and continuous improvement to support a growing global sales organization
* Translate business needs into reliable technical solutions, balancing speed, usability, and long-term maintainability
* Design and build scalable data models, workflows, custom objects, validation rules, and approval processes
* Build dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, sales activity, and revenue performance
* Develop custom functionality using Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components where appropriate
* Manage system access, permissions, data quality, documentation, testing, and releases

* Work closely with sales leaders and representatives across regions to identify operational gaps, improve daily workflows, drive adoption through practical training, clear documentation, and responsive support
* Optimize lead routing, account and opportunity management, pipeline tracking, forecasting, and reporting

**Manage marketing operations and automation**

* Own HubSpot operations, including campaign workflows, segmentation, lead scoring, nurture programs, and lifecycle management
* Maintain reliable Salesforce–HubSpot synchronization, with clear field mappings, ownership rules, and processes for resolving errors
* Partner with key stakeholders to improve lead capture, qualification, sales handoffs, campaign tracking, and attribution
* Monitor funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve lead quality, conversion, and campaign execution

**Build integrations and AI agents**

* Design, build, and maintain custom integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, and other go-to-market platforms using APIs, webhooks, and integration tools
* Build custom AI agents for customer engagement and sales and marketing workflows, such as lead research, qualification, outreach support, and follow-up
* Connect AI agents to relevant systems and data, with appropriate access controls, human review, and performance monitoring
* Troubleshoot integration failures and automation issues to maintain accurate, dependable data across systems

### **We'll be excited if you have**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience across sales operations, marketing operations, revenue operations, or go-to-market systems, including fast-growing startup experience
* Demonstrated Salesforce architecture and development experience, with ownership of complex implementations or substantial system improvements. Salesforce certifications preferred.
* Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce configuration, Salesforce Flow, Apex, SOQL, and custom development
* Strong experience with HubSpot and marketing automation, including lead scoring, segmentation, nurture workflows, lifecycle stages, and campaign reporting
* Proven experience building custom integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, and integration platforms or custom code
* Hands-on experience building and deploying custom AI agents connected to business systems and workflows
* A strong understanding of sales and marketing processes, from lead acquisition and qualification through opportunity management and closed revenue

new_jobs.title: SEO Specialist
new_jobs.description:
We’re a global online booking platform operating across multiple country-specific domains, with a custom-built website (not WordPress or a template CMS) and a large, growing footprint of landing pages, country pages, city pages, and long-form blog content spanning dozens of markets.

We’re looking for an SEO specialist who’s comfortable working across both the technical and authority-building sides of SEO, roughly a 30/70 split: **30% basic backend and on-page technical work**, **70% quality backlink creation and content marketing**.

**What you’ll actually work on:**

*Technical & on-page (about 50%)*

* Working with our custom backend to fix on-page issues: meta tags, schema markup, canonical tags, hreflang across multiple country domains
* Coordinating with developers on indexing, crawl efficiency, Core Web Vitals, and page speed issues
* Auditing and cleaning up duplicate or thin content across a large, multi-domain site structure
* Comfortable reading audit tool output (Search Console, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar) and translating it into clear, prioritized fixes

*Backlinks & content marketing (about 50%)*

* Building genuine, relevant backlinks through outreach, guest content, and digital PR, not bulk or low-quality link networks
* Identifying and vetting link opportunities by real traffic and topical relevance, not just a domain authority number
* Repurposing and promoting content across the right channels to support both links and visibility
* Tracking and reporting on link quality, referring domains, and what’s actually moving rankings, not just volume

**What we’re looking for:**

* Real experience with both technical SEO fundamentals and hands-on link building, we need one person who can genuinely do both, not two half-skills
* Comfortable working on a custom-built website without a typical CMS plugin ecosystem to lean on
* Experience with multi-domain or multi-country SEO is a strong plus, understanding hreflang, regional targeting, and avoiding content cannibalization across markets
* Familiarity with Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics
* Someone who can explain their reasoning plainly, we care about understanding why something is being done, not just that it was done

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in travel, booking, or e-commerce SEO specifically
* Familiarity with AI search visibility and structured data for answer engines (schema, FAQ markup, and similar)

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote
